BH00001

1

بسمه الحاکم علی ما کان و ما یکون

Bismihi al-Ḥākim ʿalā mā kāna wa-mā yakūn.

In His name, the Ruler over all that has been and all that will be.

2

انّ اوّل ما کتب اللّه علی العباد عرفان مشرق وحیه و مطلع امره الّذی کان مقام نفسه فی عالم الأمر و الخلق من فاز به قد فاز بکلّ الخیر و الّذی منع انّه من اهل الضّلال ولو یأتی بکلّ الأعمال اذا فزتم بهذا المقام الأسنی و الأفق الأعلی ینبغی لکلّ نفسٍ ان یتّبع ما امر به من لدی المقصود لأنّهما معا لا یقبل احدهما دون الآخر هذا ما حکم به مطلع الألهام

Inna awwala mā kataba Allāhu ʿalā al-ʿibād ʿirfānu mashriqi waḥyihi wa-maṭlaʿi amrihi alladhī kāna maqāma nafsihi fī ʿālami al-amri wa-al-khalq. Man fāza bihi qad fāza bi-kulli al-khayr wa-alladhī muniʿa innahu min ahli al-ḍalāl wa-law yaʾtī bi-kulli al-aʿmāl. Idhā fuztum bi-hādhā al-maqāmi al-asnā wa-al-ufuqi al-aʿlā yanbaghī li-kulli nafsin an yattabiʿa mā umira bihi min ladā al-Maqṣūd li-annahumā maʿan lā yuqbalu aḥaduhumā dūna al-ākhar. Hādhā mā ḥakama bihi maṭlaʿu al-ilhām.

The first duty God has prescribed for His servants is to recognize the Dayspring of His revelation and the Dawning Place of His Cause, who represents His own Self in the world of command and creation. Whoever attains this has attained all good, and whoever is deprived of it is among those who have gone astray, even if he performs every deed. Once you have attained this most exalted station and highest horizon, every soul must follow what has been commanded by the Desired One, for these two belong together: neither is accepted without the other. This is what the Dawning Place of inspiration has decreed.

3

انّ الّذین اوتوا بصآئر من اللّه یرون حدود اللّه السّبب الأعظم لنظم العالم و حفظ الأمم و الّذی غفل انّه من همج رعاع انّا امرناکم بکسر حدودات النّفس و الهوی لا ما رقم من القلم الأعلی انّه لروح الحیوان لمن فی الأمکان قد ماجت بحور الحکمة و البیان بما هاجت نسمة الرّحمن اغتنموا یا اولی الألباب انّ الّذین نکثوا عهد اللّه فی اوامره و نکصوا علی اعقابهم اولٓئک من اهل الضّلال لدی الغنیّ المتعال

Inna alladhīna ūtū baṣāʾira min Allāh yarawna ḥudūda Allāhi al-sababa al-aʿẓama li-naẓmi al-ʿālami wa-ḥifẓi al-umam wa-alladhī ghafala innahu min hamajin raʿāʿ. Innā amarnākum bi-kasri ḥudūdāti al-nafsi wa-al-hawā lā mā ruqima mina al-qalami al-aʿlā. Innahu la-rūḥu al-ḥayawān li-man fī al-imkān. Qad mājat buḥūru al-ḥikmati wa-al-bayān bi-mā hājat nasmatu al-Raḥmān. Ightanimū yā ulī al-albāb. Inna alladhīna nakathū ʿahda Allāhi fī awāmirihi wa-nakaṣū ʿalā aʿqābihim ulāʾika min ahli al-ḍalāl ladā al-Ghaniyyi al-Mutaʿāl.

Those endowed by God with insight see God’s laws as the greatest means of ordering the world and safeguarding its peoples. Whoever is heedless belongs among the ignorant rabble. We have commanded you to break the bounds of self and desire, not what has been inscribed by the Most Exalted Pen. It is indeed the spirit of life for all who dwell in the realm of existence. The oceans of wisdom and utterance have surged as the breeze of the All-Merciful has stirred. Seize this opportunity, people of understanding. Those who have broken God’s covenant concerning His commandments and turned back on their heels are among those who have gone astray in the sight of the Self-Sufficient, the Most Exalted.

4

یا ملاء الأرض اعلموا انّ اوامری سرج عنایتی بین عبادی و مفاتیح رحمتی لبریتی کذلک نزّل الأمر من سمآء مشیة ربّکم مالک الأدیان لو یجد احد حلاوة البیان الّذی ظهر من فم مشیة الرّحمن لینفق ما عنده ولو یکون خزائن الأرض کلّها لیثبت امراً من اوامره المشرقة من افق العنایة و الألطاف

Yā malaʾa al-arḍ iʿlamū anna awāmirī suruju ʿināyatī bayna ʿibādī wa-mafātīḥu raḥmatī li-bariyyatī. Kadhālika nuzzila al-amru min samāʾi mashīʾati rabbikum Māliki al-adyān. Law yajidu aḥadun ḥalāwata al-bayāni alladhī ẓahara min fami mashīʾati al-Raḥmān la-yunfiqu mā ʿindahu wa-law yakūnu khazāʾina al-arḍi kullahā li-yuthbita amran min awāmirihi al-mushriqati min ufuqi al-ʿināyati wa-al-alṭāf.

People of the earth, know that My commandments are the lamps of My loving care among My servants and the keys to My mercy for My creatures. Thus has the command been sent down from the heaven of the will of your Lord, the Master of religions. If anyone were to taste the sweetness of the utterance that has issued from the mouth of the will of the All-Merciful, he would expend all he possesses, even if it were all the treasures of the earth, to establish a single one of His commandments that shine from the horizon of loving care and favor.

5

قل من حدودی یمرّ عرف قمیصی و بها تنصب اعلام النّصر علی القنن و الأتلال قد تکلّم لسان قدرتی فی جبروت عظمتی مخاطباً لبریتی ان اعملوا حدودی حبّاً لجمالی طوبی لحبیب وجد عرف المحبوب من هذه الکلمة الّتی فاحت منها نفحات الفضل علی شأنٍ لا توصف بالأذکار لعمری من شرب رحیق الأنصاف من ایادی الألطاف انّه یطوف حول اوامری المشرقة من افق الأبداع

Qul min ḥudūdī yamurru ʿarfu qamīṣī wa-bihā tunṣabu aʿlāmu al-naṣri ʿalā al-qunani wa-al-atlāl. Qad takallama lisānu qudratī fī jabarūti ʿaẓamatī mukhāṭiban li-bariyyatī an iʿmalū ḥudūdī ḥubban li-jamālī. Ṭūbā li-ḥabībin wajada ʿarfa al-Maḥbūbi min hādhihi al-kalimati allatī fāḥat minhā nafaḥātu al-faḍli ʿalā shaʾnin lā tūṣafu bi-al-adhkār. La-ʿamrī man shariba raḥīqa al-inṣāfi min ayādī al-alṭāf innahu yaṭūfu ḥawla awāmirī al-mushriqati min ufuqi al-ibdāʿ.

Say: From My laws comes the fragrance of My garment, and through them the banners of victory are raised upon peaks and hills. The Tongue of My power has spoken in the dominion of My grandeur, addressing My creatures: “Observe My laws out of love for My beauty.” Blessed is the lover who has caught the fragrance of the Beloved from this utterance, from which the breezes of grace have wafted in a manner beyond description. By My life, whoever drinks the choice wine of fairness from the hands of loving favor will circle around My commandments that shine from the horizon of creation.

6

لا تحسبنّ انّا نزّلنا لکم الأحکام بل فتحنا ختم الرّحیق المختوم باصابع القدرة و الأقتدار یشهد بذلک ما نزّل من قلم الوحی تفکّروا یا اولی الأفکار

Lā taḥsabanna annā nazzalnā lakumu al-aḥkām bal fataḥnā khatma al-raḥīqi al-makhtūmi bi-aṣābiʿi al-qudrati wa-al-iqtidār. Yashhadu bi-dhālika mā nuzzila min qalami al-waḥy. Tafakkarū yā ulī al-afkār.

Do not think that We have revealed mere laws to you. Rather, with the fingers of power and might, We have broken the seal of the sealed choice wine. What has been sent down by the Pen of revelation bears witness to this. Reflect, people of thought.

7

قد کتب علیکم الصّلوة تسع رکعات للّه منزل الآیات حین الزّوال و فی البکور و الآصال و عفونا عدّة اخری امراً فی کتاب اللّه انّه لهو الأمر المقتدر المختار و اذا اردتم الصّلوة ولّوا وجوهکم شطری الأقدس المقام المقدّس الّذی جعله اللّه مطاف الملاء الأعلی و مقبل اهل مدائن البقآء و مصدر الأمر لمن فی الأرضین و السّموات و عند غروب شمس الحقیقة و التّبیان المقرّ الّذی قدّرناه لکم انّه لهو العزیز العلاّم

Qad kutiba ʿalaykumu al-ṣalātu tisʿa rakaʿātin li-Allāhi Munzili al-āyāt ḥīna al-zawāli wa-fī al-bukūri wa-al-āṣāl. Wa-ʿafawnā ʿiddatan ukhrā amran fī kitābi Allāh. Innahu la-huwa al-Āmiru al-Muqtadiru al-Mukhtār. Wa-idhā aradtumu al-ṣalāta wallū wujūhakum shaṭrī al-aqdasa al-maqāma al-muqaddasa alladhī jaʿalahu Allāhu maṭāfa al-malaʾi al-aʿlā wa-muqbila ahli madāʾini al-baqāʾ wa-maṣdara al-amri li-man fī al-araḍīna wa-al-samāwāt. Wa-ʿinda ghurūbi shamsi al-ḥaqīqati wa-al-tibyān al-maqarra alladhī qaddarnāhu lakum. Innahu la-huwa al-ʿAzīzu al-ʿAllām.

Obligatory prayer has been prescribed for you, consisting of nine units, offered to God, the Revealer of verses, at noon, in the morning, and in the late afternoon. We have exempted you from another number, as a decree in the Book of God. He is indeed the Ordainer, the All-Powerful, who freely chooses. When you wish to perform obligatory prayer, turn your faces toward My Most Holy presence, the sacred Station that God has made the center around which the Concourse on high circles, the point toward which the inhabitants of the cities of eternity turn, and the source of command for all in the earth and the heavens. At the setting of the Sun of truth and explanation, turn toward the place We have appointed for you. He is indeed the Almighty, the All-Knowing.

8

کلّ شئ تحقّق بامره المبرم اذا اشرقت من افق البیان شمس الأحکام لکلٍ ان یتّبعوها ولو بامرٍ تنفطر عنه سموات افئدة الأدیان انّه یفعل ما یشآء و لا یسئل عمّا شآء و ما حکم به المحبوب انّه لمحبوب و مالک الاختراع انّ الّذی وجد عرف الرّحمن و عرف مطلع هذا البیان انّه یستقبل بعینه السّهام لاثبات الأحکام بین الأنام طوبی لمن اقبل و فاز بفصل الخطاب

Kullu shayʾin taḥaqqaqa bi-amrihi al-mubram. Idhā ashraqat min ufuqi al-bayāni shamsu al-aḥkām li-kullin an yattabiʿūhā wa-law bi-amrin tanfaṭiru ʿanhu samāwātu afʾidati al-adyān. Innahu yafʿalu mā yashāʾ wa-lā yusʾalu ʿammā shāʾ wa-mā ḥakama bihi al-Maḥbūbu innahu la-maḥbūb wa-Māliki al-ikhtirāʿ. Inna alladhī wajada ʿarfa al-Raḥmān wa-ʿarafa maṭlaʿa hādhā al-bayān innahu yastaqbilu bi-ʿaynihi al-sihāma li-ithbāti al-aḥkāmi bayna al-anām. Ṭūbā li-man aqbala wa-fāza bi-faṣli al-khiṭāb.

Everything has come into being through His irrevocable command. When the Sun of laws shines from the horizon of utterance, everyone must follow them, even if a command should cause the heavens of the hearts of religions to split apart. He does whatever He wills and is not questioned about what He wills. Whatever the Beloved decrees is indeed beloved, by the Lord of creation! Whoever has caught the fragrance of the All-Merciful and recognized the Dawning Place of this utterance will face arrows with his own eyes to establish the laws among humanity. Blessed is the one who has turned toward Him and attained the decisive word.

9

یقرء ما نزّل قبلها والاّعفا اللّه عنه انّه له قد فصّلنا الصّلوة فی ورقةٍ اخری طوبی لمن عمل بما امر به من لدن مالک الرّقاب قد نزّلت فی صلوة المیت ستّ تکبیرات من اللّه منزل الایات و الّذی عنده علم القرآئة له ان و العزیز الغفّار

Yaqraʾu mā nuzzila qablahā wa-illā ʿafā Allāhu ʿanhu [corrupted text] qad faṣṣalnā al-ṣalāta fī waraqatin ukhrā ṭūbā li-man ʿamila bi-mā umira bihi min ladun Māliki al-riqāb. Qad nuzzilat fī ṣalāti al-mayyiti sittu takbīrātin min Allāhi Munzili al-āyāt wa-alladhī ʿindahu ʿilmu al-qirāʾati [corrupted text] al-ʿAzīzu al-Ghaffār.

He reads what was revealed before it; otherwise, God has pardoned him. [corrupted original text] We have set out the obligatory prayer in detail on another sheet. Blessed is the one who acts according to what he has been commanded by the Master of all people. Six repetitions of “God is Most Great” have been revealed for the prayer for the dead by God, the Revealer of verses, and the one who knows how to read [corrupted original text] the Almighty, the All-Forgiving.

10

لا یبطل الشّعر صلوتکم و لا ما منع عن الرّوح مثل العظام و غیرها البسوا السّمور کما تلبسون الخزّ و السّنجاب و ما دونهما انّه ما نهی فی الفرقان ولکن اشتبه علی العلمآء انّه لهو العزیز العلاّم

Lā yubṭilu al-shaʿru ṣalātakum wa-lā mā muniʿa ʿani al-rūḥi mithla al-ʿiẓāmi wa-ghayrihā. Ilbasū al-sammūra kamā talbasūna al-khazza wa-al-sinjāba wa-mā dūnahumā. Innahu mā nahā fī al-Furqān wa-lākin ishtabaha ʿalā al-ʿulamāʾ. Innahu la-huwa al-ʿAzīzu al-ʿAllām.

Hair does not invalidate your prayer, nor does anything devoid of life, such as bones and the like. Wear sable as you wear silk, squirrel fur, and other materials. He did not forbid this in the Qur’an, but the scholars misunderstood. He is indeed the Almighty, the All-Knowing.

11

قد فرض علیکم الصّلوة و الصّوم من اوّل البلوغ امراً من لدی اللّه ربّکم و ربّ ابائکم الأولین من کان فی نفسه ضعف من المرض او الهرم عفا اللّه عنه فضلاً من عنده انّه لهو الغفور الکریم قد اذن اللّه لکم السّجود علی کل شئً طاهرٍ و رفعنا عنه حکم الحدّ فی الکتاب انّ اللّه یعلم و انتم لا تعلمون من لم یجد المآء یذکر خمس مرّاتٍ بسم اللّه الأطهر الأطهر ثمّ یشرع فی العمل هذا ما حکم به مولی العالمین و البلدان الّتی طالت فیها اللّیالی و الایام فلیصلّوا بالسّاعات و المشاخص الّتی منها تحدّدت الأوقات انّه لهو المبین الحکیم

Qad furiḍa ʿalaykumu al-ṣalātu wa-al-ṣawmu min awwali al-bulūgh amran min ladā Allāhi rabbikum wa-rabbi ābāʾikumu al-awwalīn. Man kāna fī nafsihi ḍaʿfun mina al-maraḍi aw al-haram ʿafā Allāhu ʿanhu faḍlan min ʿindihi innahu la-huwa al-Ghafūru al-Karīm. Qad adhina Allāhu lakumu al-sujūda ʿalā kulli shayʾin ṭāhirin wa-rafaʿnā ʿanhu ḥukma al-ḥaddi fī al-kitāb. Inna Allāha yaʿlamu wa-antum lā taʿlamūn. Man lam yajidi al-māʾa yadhkuru khamsa marrātin bismi Allāhi al-Aṭhari al-Aṭhar thumma yashraʿu fī al-ʿamal. Hādhā mā ḥakama bihi Mawlā al-ʿālamīn. Wa-al-buldānu allatī ṭālat fīhā al-layālī wa-al-ayyām fa-li-yuṣallū bi-al-sāʿāti wa-al-mashākhiṣi allatī minhā taḥaddadati al-awqāt. Innahu la-huwa al-Mubīnu al-Ḥakīm.

Prayer and fasting have been made obligatory for you from the onset of maturity, as a command from God, your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers. Whoever is weakened by illness or old age has been exempted by God as a grace from Him. He is indeed the All-Forgiving, the Generous. God has permitted you to prostrate yourselves on any clean surface, and We have removed from the Book the restriction that applied to it. God knows, and you do not know. Whoever cannot find water is to repeat five times, “In the name of God, the Most Pure, the Most Pure,” and then proceed with the act. This is what the Lord of the worlds has decreed. In lands where nights and days are long, they are to pray according to clocks and instruments by which the times are determined. He is indeed the Expounder, the All-Wise.

12

قد عفونا عنکم صلوة الآیات اذا ظهرت اذکروا اللّه بالعظمة و الأقتدار انّه هو السّمیع البصیر قولوا العظمة للّه ربّ ما یری و ما لا یری ربّ العالمین

Qad ʿafawnā ʿankum ṣalāta al-āyāt. Idhā ẓaharat udhkurū Allāha bi-al-ʿaẓamati wa-al-iqtidār. Innahu huwa al-Samīʿu al-Baṣīr. Qūlū al-ʿaẓamatu li-Allāhi rabbi mā yurā wa-mā lā yurā rabbi al-ʿālamīn.

We have exempted you from the prayer of the signs. When they appear, remember God with grandeur and power. He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing. Say: “Grandeur belongs to God, Lord of all that is seen and unseen, Lord of the worlds.”

13

کتب علیکم الصّلوة فرادی قد رفع حکم الجماعة الاّ فی صلوة المیت انّه لهو الأمر الحکیم

Kutiba ʿalaykumu al-ṣalātu furādā qad rufiʿa ḥukmu al-jamāʿati illā fī ṣalāti al-mayyit. Innahu la-huwa al-Āmiru al-Ḥakīm.

You have been required to perform obligatory prayer individually. The ordinance of congregational prayer has been abolished, except for the prayer for the dead. He is indeed the Ordainer, the All-Wise.

14

قد عفا اللّه عن النّسآء حین ما یجدن الدّم الصّوم و الصّلوة و لهنّ ان یتوضّأن و یسبّحن خمساً و تسعین مرّة من زوالٍ الی زوالٍ سبحان اللّه ذی الطّلعة و الجمال هذا ما قدّر فی الکتاب ان انتم من العالمین

Qad ʿafā Allāhu ʿani al-nisāʾi ḥīna mā yajidna al-dama al-ṣawma wa-al-ṣalāta wa-lahunna an yatawaḍḍaʾna wa-yusabbiḥna khamsan wa-tisʿīna marratan min zawālin ilā zawālin subḥāna Allāhi dhī al-ṭalʿati wa-al-jamāl. Hādhā mā quddira fī al-kitābi in antum mina al-ʿālimīn.

God has exempted women from fasting and obligatory prayer during menstruation. They are to perform ablutions and repeat ninety-five times, from one noon to the next, “Glory be to God, the Possessor of radiance and beauty.” This is what has been ordained in the Book, if you are among those who know.

15

و لکم و لهنّ فی الاسفار اذ انزلتم و استرحتم المقام الأمن مکان کلّ صلوة سجدة واحدة و اذکروا فیها سبحان اللّه ذی العظمة و الاجلال و الموهبة و الافضال و الّذی عجز یقول سبحان اللّه انّه یکفیه بالحق انّه لهو الکافی الباقی الغفور الرّحیم و بعد اتمام السّجود لکم و لهنّ ان تقعدوا علی هیکل التّوحید و تقولوا ثمانی عشرة مرّة سبحان اللّه ذی الملک و الملکوت کذلک یبین اللّه سبل الحقّ و الهدی و انّها انتهت الی سبیل واحد و هو هذا الصّراط المستقیم اشکروا اللّه بهذا الفضل العظیم احمدوا اللّه بهذه الموهبة الّتی احاطت السّموات و الأرضین اذکروا اللّه بهذه الرّحمة الّتی سبقت العالمین

Wa-lakum wa-lahunna fī al-asfāri idhā nazaltum wa-istaraḥtumu al-maqāma al-amna makāna kulli ṣalātin sajdatun wāḥidatun wa-udhkurū fīhā subḥāna Allāhi dhī al-ʿaẓamati wa-al-ijlāli wa-al-mawhibati wa-al-ifḍāl. Wa-alladhī ʿajaza yaqūlu subḥāna Allāh innahu yakfīhi bi-al-ḥaqq innahu la-huwa al-Kāfī al-Bāqī al-Ghafūru al-Raḥīm. Wa-baʿda itmāmi al-sujūdi lakum wa-lahunna an taqʿudū ʿalā haykali al-tawḥīdi wa-taqūlū thamāniya ʿashrata marratan subḥāna Allāhi dhī al-mulki wa-al-malakūt. Kadhālika yubayyinu Allāhu subula al-ḥaqqi wa-al-hudā wa-innahā intahat ilā sabīlin wāḥidin wa-huwa hādhā al-ṣirāṭu al-mustaqīm. Ushkurū Allāha bi-hādhā al-faḍli al-ʿaẓīm. Iḥmadū Allāha bi-hādhihi al-mawhibati allatī aḥāṭati al-samāwāti wa-al-araḍīn. Udhkurū Allāha bi-hādhihi al-raḥmati allatī sabaqati al-ʿālamīn.

For you and for women, when traveling, upon stopping and resting in a safe place, a single prostration is to replace each obligatory prayer. During it say, “Glory be to God, the Possessor of grandeur and majesty, bounty and grace.” Anyone unable to do this says, “Glory be to God”; this will indeed suffice. He is indeed the All-Sufficing, the Everlasting, the All-Forgiving, the Merciful. After completing the prostrations, you and women are to sit in the posture of unity and say eighteen times, “Glory be to God, the Possessor of the earthly and heavenly kingdoms.” Thus God makes clear the ways of truth and guidance, and they have converged in a single way: this straight path. Thank God for this great grace. Praise God for this bounty that has encompassed the heavens and the earth. Remember God for this mercy that has preceded all the worlds.

16

قل قد جعل اللّه مفتاح الکنز حبّی المکنون لو انتم تعرفون لولا المفتاح لکان مکنوناً فی ازل الازال لو انتم توقنون قل هذا لمطلع الوحی و مشرق الأشراق الّذی به اشرقت الآفاق لو انتم تعلمون انّ هذا لهو القضآء المثبت و به ثبت کلّ قضآءٍ محتوم

Qul qad jaʿala Allāhu miftāḥa al-kanzi ḥubbī al-maknūna law antum taʿrifūn. Lawlā al-miftāḥu la-kāna maknūnan fī azali al-āzāl law antum tūqinūn. Qul hādhā la-maṭlaʿu al-waḥyi wa-mashriqu al-ishrāqi alladhī bihi ashraqati al-āfāqu law antum taʿlamūn. Inna hādhā la-huwa al-qaḍāʾu al-muthbatu wa-bihi thabata kullu qaḍāʾin maḥtūm.

Say: God has made My hidden love the key to the treasure, if only you would recognize it. Without the key, it would have remained concealed for all eternity, if only you were certain. Say: This is indeed the Dawning Place of revelation and the Dayspring of radiance through which the horizons have been illumined, if only you knew. This is indeed the established decree, and through it every irrevocable decree has been established.

17

یا قلم الأعلی قل یا ملاء الأنشآء قد کتبنا علیکم الصّیام ایاماً معدودات و جعلنا النّیروز عیداً لکم بعد اکمالها کذلک اضآئت شمس البیان من افق الکتاب من لدن مالک المبدء و المأب و اجعلوا الأیام الزّآئدة عن الشّهور قبل شهر الصّیام انّا جعلناها مظاهر الهآء بین اللّیالی و الأیّام لذا ما تحدّدت بحدود السّنة و الشّهور ینبغی لأهل البهآء ان یطعموا فیها انفسهم و ذوی القربی ثمّ الفقرآء و المساکین و یهلّلنّ و یکبّرنّ و یسبّحنّ و یمجّدنّ ربّهم بالفرح و الأنبساط و اذا تمّت ایام الاعطآء قبل الامساک فلیدخلنّ فی الصّیام کذلک حکم مولی الأنام لیس علی المسافر و المریض و الحامل و المرضع من حرجٍ عفا اللّه عنهم فضلاً من عنده انّه لهو العزیز الوهّاب

Yā qalama al-aʿlā qul yā malaʾa al-inshāʾ qad katabnā ʿalaykumu al-ṣiyāma ayyāman maʿdūdātin wa-jaʿalnā al-nayrūza ʿīdan lakum baʿda ikmālihā. Kadhālika aḍāʾat shamsu al-bayāni min ufuqi al-kitābi min ladun Māliki al-mabdaʾi wa-al-maʾāb. Wa-ijʿalū al-ayyāma al-zāʾidata ʿani al-shuhūri qabla shahri al-ṣiyām. Innā jaʿalnāhā maẓāhira al-hāʾi bayna al-layālī wa-al-ayyām li-dhā mā taḥaddadat bi-ḥudūdi al-sanati wa-al-shuhūr. Yanbaghī li-ahli al-Bahāʾi an yuṭʿimū fīhā anfusahum wa-dhawī al-qurbā thumma al-fuqarāʾa wa-al-masākīna wa-yuhallilanna wa-yukabbiranna wa-yusabbiḥanna wa-yumajjidanna rabbahum bi-al-faraḥi wa-al-inbisāṭ. Wa-idhā tammat ayyāmu al-iʿṭāʾi qabla al-imsāk fa-li-yadkhulanna fī al-ṣiyām. Kadhālika ḥakama Mawlā al-anām. Laysa ʿalā al-musāfiri wa-al-marīḍi wa-al-ḥāmili wa-al-murḍiʿi min ḥaraj. ʿAfā Allāhu ʿanhum faḍlan min ʿindihi innahu la-huwa al-ʿAzīzu al-Wahhāb.

Most Exalted Pen, say: People of creation, We have prescribed fasting for you for a specified number of days and have made Naw-Rúz a festival for you upon their completion. Thus has the Sun of utterance shone from the horizon of the Book, from the Lord of the beginning and the return. Place the days in excess of the months before the month of fasting. We have made them manifestations of the letter Há among the nights and days; thus they have not been bounded by the limits of the year and the months. During them, the people of Bahá should provide food for themselves and their relatives, as well as the poor and needy, and with joy and gladness proclaim the oneness and greatness of their Lord, praise Him, and glorify Him. When the days of giving that precede abstinence have ended, let them enter the fast. Thus has the Lord of humanity decreed. Travelers, the sick, pregnant women, and nursing mothers are under no obligation. God has exempted them as a grace from Him. He is indeed the Almighty, the Bestower.

18

هذه حدود اللّه الّتی رقمت من القلم الأعلی فی الزّبر و الألواح تمسّکوا باوامر اللّه و احکامه و لا تکونوا من الّذین اخذوا اصول انفسهم و نبذوا اصول اللّه ورآئهم بما اتّبعوا الظّنون و الأوهام کفّوا انفسکم عن الأکل و الشّرب من الطّلوع الی الأفول ایّاکم ان یمنعکم الهوی عن هذا الفضل الّذی قدّر فی الکتاب

Hādhihi ḥudūdu Allāhi allatī ruqimat mina al-qalami al-aʿlā fī al-zuburi wa-al-alwāḥ. Tamassakū bi-awāmiri Allāhi wa-aḥkāmihi wa-lā takūnū mina alladhīna akhadhū uṣūla anfusihim wa-nabadhū uṣūla Allāhi warāʾahum bi-mā ittabaʿū al-ẓunūna wa-al-awhām. Kuffū anfusakum ʿani al-akli wa-al-shurbi mina al-ṭulūʿi ilā al-ufūl. Iyyākum an yamnaʿakumu al-hawā ʿan hādhā al-faḍli alladhī quddira fī al-kitāb.

These are the laws of God inscribed by the Most Exalted Pen in the scriptures and Tablets. Hold fast to God’s commandments and ordinances, and do not be among those who have adopted principles of their own and cast God’s principles behind them, following conjectures and vain imaginings. Refrain from eating and drinking from sunrise to sunset. Beware lest desire deprive you of this grace ordained in the Book.

19

قد کتب لمن دان باللّه الدّیان ان یغسل فی کلّ یومٍ یدیه ثمّ وجهه و یقعد مقبلاً الی اللّه و یذکر خمساً و تسعین مرّةً اللّه ابهی کذلک حکم فاطر السّمآء اذ استوی علی اعراش الأسماء بالعظمة و الأقتدار کذلک توضّأوا للصّلوة امراً من اللّه الواحد المختار

Qad kutiba li-man dāna bi-Allāhi al-Dayyāni an yaghsila fī kulli yawmin yadayhi thumma wajhahu wa-yaqʿuda muqbilan ilā Allāhi wa-yadhkura khamsan wa-tisʿīna marratan Allāhu Abhā. Kadhālika ḥakama Fāṭiru al-samāʾi idh istawā ʿalā aʿrāshi al-asmāʾi bi-al-ʿaẓamati wa-al-iqtidār. Kadhālika tawaḍḍaʾū li-al-ṣalāti amran min Allāhi al-Wāḥidi al-Mukhtār.

Everyone who believes in God, the Judge, has been required each day to wash his hands and then his face, sit facing God, and repeat ninety-five times, “God is Most Glorious.” Thus has the Creator of heaven decreed as He sat upon the thrones of names in grandeur and power. Likewise, perform ablutions for obligatory prayer, as a command from God, the One, who freely chooses.

20

قد حرّم علیکم القتل و الزّنا ثمّ الغیبة و الافترآء اجتنبوا عمّا نهیتم عنه فی الصّحآئف و الألواح

Qad ḥurrima ʿalaykumu al-qatlu wa-al-zinā thumma al-ghībatu wa-al-iftirāʾ. Ijtanibū ʿammā nuhītum ʿanhu fī al-ṣaḥāʾifi wa-al-alwāḥ.

Murder, adultery, backbiting, and slander have been forbidden to you. Avoid whatever you have been forbidden in the scriptures and Tablets.

21

قد قسمنا المواریث علی عدد الزّآء منها قدّر لذرّیاتکم من کتاب الطّآء علی عدد المقت و للأزواج من کتاب الحآء علی عدد التّآء و الفآء و للابآء من کتاب الزّآء علی عدد التّآء و الکاف و للأمّهات من کتاب الواو علی عدد الرّفیع و للأخوان من کتاب الهآء عدد الشّین و للأخوات من کتاب الدّال عدد الرّآء و المیم و للمعلّمین من کتاب الجیم عدد القاف و الفآء کذلک حکم مبشّری الّذی یذکرنی فی اللّیالی و الأسحار انّا لمّا سمعنا ضجیج الذّرّیات فی الأصلاب زدنا ضعف مالهم و نقصنا عن الاخری انّه لهو المقتدر علی ما یشآء یفعل بسلطانه کیف اراد

Qad qasamnā al-mawārītha ʿalā ʿadadi al-zāʾ. Minhā quddira li-dhurriyyātikum min kitābi al-ṭāʾ ʿalā ʿadadi al-maqt, wa-li-l-azwāji min kitābi al-ḥāʾ ʿalā ʿadadi al-tāʾ wa-l-fāʾ, wa-li-l-ābāʾi min kitābi al-zāʾ ʿalā ʿadadi al-tāʾ wa-l-kāf, wa-li-l-ummahāti min kitābi al-wāw ʿalā ʿadadi al-rafīʿ, wa-li-l-ikhwāni min kitābi al-hāʾ ʿadada al-shīn, wa-li-l-akhawāti min kitābi al-dāl ʿadada al-rāʾ wa-l-mīm, wa-li-l-muʿallimīna min kitābi al-jīm ʿadada al-qāf wa-l-fāʾ. Kadhālika ḥakama mubashshirī alladhī yadhkurunī fī al-layālī wa-l-asḥār. Innā lammā samiʿnā ḍajīja al-dhurriyyāti fī al-aṣlāb zidnā ḍiʿfa mā lahum wa-naqaṣnā ʿani al-ukhrā. Innahu la-huwa al-muqtadiru ʿalā mā yashāʾ, yafʿalu bi-sulṭānihi kayfa arād.

We have divided inheritances according to the number of Zāʾ. Of these, your offspring have been allotted from the Book of Ṭāʾ according to the number of maqt; spouses, from the Book of Ḥāʾ according to the number of Tāʾ and Fāʾ; fathers, from the Book of Zāʾ according to the number of Tāʾ and Kāf; mothers, from the Book of Wāw according to the number of rafīʿ; brothers, from the Book of Hāʾ, the number of Shīn; sisters, from the Book of Dāl, the number of Rāʾ and Mīm; and teachers, from the Book of Jīm, the number of Qāf and Fāʾ. Thus decreed My Herald, who remembers Me in the night and at dawn. When We heard the clamor of the offspring still in their fathers’ loins, We doubled their share and reduced those of the others. He indeed has power over whatever He wills; through His sovereignty He does as He wishes.

22

من مات و لم یکن له ذرّیة ترجع حقوقهم الی بیت العدل لیصرفوها امنآء الرّحمن فی الأیتام و الارامل و ما ینتفع به جمهور النّاس لیشکروا ربّهم العزیز الغفّار

Man māta wa-lam yakun lahu dhurriyyatun tarjiʿu ḥuqūquhum ilā bayti al-ʿadl li-yaṣrifūhā umanāʾu al-Raḥmān fī al-aytāmi wa-l-arāmili wa-mā yantafiʿu bihi jumhūru al-nās li-yashkurū rabbahumu al-ʿazīza al-ghaffār.

If someone dies without offspring, their shares revert to the House of Justice, so that the trustees of the All-Merciful may spend them on orphans, widows, and whatever benefits the general public, that they may give thanks to their Lord, the Almighty, the Ever-Forgiving.

23

و الّذی له ذرّیة و لم یکن مادونها عمّا حدّد فی الکتاب یرجع الثّلثان ممّا ترکه الی الذّرّیة و الثّلث الی بیت العدل کذلک حکم الغنی المتّعال بالعظمة و الأجلال

Wa-alladhī lahu dhurriyyatun wa-lam yakun mā dūnahā ʿammā ḥuddida fī al-kitāb yarjiʿu al-thuluthāni mimmā tarakahu ilā al-dhurriyyati wa-l-thuluthu ilā bayti al-ʿadl. Kadhālika ḥakama al-ghaniyyu al-mutaʿāl bi-l-ʿaẓamati wa-l-ijlāl.

If someone has offspring but none of the other heirs specified in the Book, two-thirds of what he leaves revert to the offspring and one-third to the House of Justice. Thus has the Self-Sufficient, the Most Exalted, decreed in majesty and glory.

24

و الّذی لم یکن له من یرثه و کان له ذو القربٰی من ابنآء الأخ و الأخت و بناتهما فلهم الثّلثان والاّ للأعمام و الأخوال و العمّات و الخالات و من بعدهم و بعدهنّ لابنآئهم و ابنآئهنّ و بناتهم و بناتهنّ و الثلث یرجع الی مقرّ العدل امراً فی الکتاب من لدی اللّه مالک الرّقاب

Wa-alladhī lam yakun lahu man yarithuhu wa-kāna lahu dhawū al-qurbā min abnāʾi al-akhi wa-l-ukhti wa-banātihimā fa-lahumu al-thuluthān, wa-illā fa-li-l-aʿmāmi wa-l-akhwāli wa-l-ʿammāti wa-l-khālāt, wa-min baʿdihim wa-baʿdihinna li-abnāʾihim wa-abnāʾihinna wa-banātihim wa-banātihinna, wa-l-thuluthu yarjiʿu ilā maqarri al-ʿadl, amran fī al-kitābi min ladā Allāhi māliki al-riqāb.

If someone has none to inherit from him but has relatives among the sons and daughters of his brother or sister, two-thirds go to them; otherwise, to his paternal and maternal uncles and aunts, and after them to their sons and daughters. One-third reverts to the Seat of Justice, as an ordinance in the Book from God, the Master of all people.

25

من مات و لم یکن له احد من الّذین نزّلت اسمائهم من القلم الأعلی ترجع الأموال کلّها الی المقرّ المذکور لتصرف فیما امر اللّه به انّه لهو المقتدر الأمّار

Man māta wa-lam yakun lahu aḥadun mina alladhīna nuzzilat asmāʾuhum mina al-qalami al-aʿlā tarjiʿu al-amwālu kulluhā ilā al-maqarri al-madhkūr li-tuṣrafa fīmā amara Allāhu bihi. Innahu la-huwa al-muqtadiru al-ammār.

If someone dies leaving none of those whose names have been sent down by the Most Exalted Pen, all the property reverts to the aforementioned Seat, to be spent on what God has ordained. He indeed is the All-Powerful, the Supreme Ordainer.

26

و جعلنا الدّار المسکونة و الالبسة المخصوصه للذّرّیة من الذّکران دون الأناث و الورّاث انّه لهو المعطی الفیاض

Wa-jaʿalnā al-dāra al-maskūnata wa-l-albisata al-makhṣūṣata li-l-dhurriyyati mina al-dhukrāni dūna al-ināthi wa-l-wurrāth. Innahu la-huwa al-muʿṭī al-fayyāḍ.

We have assigned the residence and personal clothing to the male offspring, to the exclusion of the female offspring and other heirs. He indeed is the Giver, the Most Bountiful.

27

انّ الّذی مات فی ایام والده و له ذرّیة اولٓئک یرثون ما لأبیهم فی کتاب اللّه اقسموا بینهم بالعدل الخالص کذلک ماج بحر الکلام و قذف لئالی الأحکام من لدن مالک الأنام

Inna alladhī māta fī ayyāmi wālidihi wa-lahu dhurriyyatun ulāʾika yarithūna mā li-abīhim fī kitābi Allāh. Iqsimū baynahum bi-l-ʿadli al-khāliṣ. Kadhālika māja baḥru al-kalāmi wa-qadhafa laʾāliʾa al-aḥkāmi min ladun māliki al-anām.

If someone dies during his father’s lifetime and leaves offspring, they inherit their father’s share as prescribed in the Book of God. Divide it among them with pure justice. Thus has the ocean of utterance surged and cast forth the pearls of ordinances from the Lord of all people.

28

و الّذی ترک ذرّیةً ضعافاً سلّموا مالهم الی امین لیتجرّ لهم الی ان یبلغوا رشدهم او الی محلّ الشّراکة ثمّ عینوا للأمین حقّاً ممّا حصل من التّجارة و الأقتراف

Wa-alladhī taraka dhurriyyatan ḍiʿāfan sallimū mālahum ilā amīnin li-yattajira lahum ilā an yablughū rushdahum aw ilā maḥalli al-shirāka. Thumma ʿayyinū li-l-amīni ḥaqqan mimmā ḥaṣala mina al-tijārati wa-l-iqtirāf.

If someone leaves offspring who are minors, entrust their property to a trustworthy person to trade on their behalf until they reach maturity or the age of partnership. Then assign the trustee a share of the proceeds from trade and earnings.

29

کلّ ذلک بعد ادآء حقّ اللّه و الدّیون لو تکون علیه و تجهیز الأسباب للکفن و الدّفن و حمل المیت بالعزّة و الاءعتزاز کذلک حکم مالک المبدء و المأب

Kullu dhālika baʿda adāʾi ḥaqqi Allāhi wa-l-duyūni law takūnu ʿalayhi wa-tajhīzi al-asbābi li-l-kafani wa-l-dafni wa-ḥamli al-mayyiti bi-l-ʿizzati wa-l-iʿtizāz. Kadhālika ḥakama māliku al-mabdaʾi wa-l-maʾāb.

All this follows payment of the Right of God and any debts owed by the deceased, provision for shrouding and burial, and the conveyance of the deceased with dignity and honor. Thus has the Lord of the beginning and the return decreed.

30

قل هذا لهو العلم المکنون الّذی لن یتغیر لانّه بدء بالطّآء المدلّة علی الأسم المخزون الظّاهر الممتنع المنیع و ما خصّصناه للذّرّیات هذا من فضل اللّه علیهم لیشکروا ربّهم الرّحمن الرّحیم تلک حدود اللّه لا تعتدوها باهوآء انفسکم اتّبعوا ما امرتم به من مطلع البیان و المخلصون یرون حدود اللّه ماء الحیوان لاهل الأدیان و مصباح الحکمة و الفلاح لمن فی الأرضین و السّموات

Qul hādhā la-huwa al-ʿilmu al-maknūnu alladhī lan yataghayyara li-annahu budiʾa bi-l-ṭāʾi al-mudillati ʿalā al-ismi al-makhzūni al-ẓāhiri al-mumtaniʿi al-manīʿ. Wa-mā khaṣṣaṣnāhu li-l-dhurriyyāti hādhā min faḍli Allāhi ʿalayhim li-yashkurū rabbahumu al-Raḥmāna al-raḥīm. Tilka ḥudūdu Allāhi lā taʿtadūhā bi-ahwāʾi anfusikum. Ittabiʿū mā umirtum bihi min maṭlaʿi al-bayān. Wa-l-mukhliṣūna yarawna ḥudūda Allāhi māʾa al-ḥayawāni li-ahli al-adyāni wa-miṣbāḥa al-ḥikmati wa-l-falāḥi li-man fī al-arḍīna wa-l-samāwāt.

Say: This is indeed the hidden knowledge that will never change, for it began with Ṭāʾ, which points to the treasured Name, the Manifest, the Inaccessible, the Unassailable. What We have set aside for the offspring is a grace bestowed on them by God, that they may thank their Lord, the All-Merciful, the Compassionate. These are God’s limits; do not transgress them at the prompting of your own desires. Follow what you have been commanded by the Dawning-Place of utterance. The sincere see God’s ordinances as the water of life for the followers of religions and the lamp of wisdom and salvation for all in the earth and the heavens.

31

قد کتب اللّه علی کلّ مدینةٍ ان یجعلوا فیها بیت العدل و یجتمع فیه النّفوس علی عدد البهآء و ان ازداد لا بأس و یرون کانّهم یدخلون محضر اللّه العلی الأعلی و یرون من لا یری و ینبغی لهم ان یکونوا امنآء الرّحمن بین الاءمکان و وکلاء اللّه لمن علی الأرض کلّها و یشاوروا فی مصالح العباد لوجه اللّه کما یشاورون فی امورهم و یختاروا ما هو المختار کذلک حکم ربّکم العزیز الغفّار ایاکم ان تدعوا ما هو المنصوص فی اللّوح اتّقوا اللّه یا اولی الانظار

Qad kataba Allāhu ʿalā kulli madīnatin an yajʿalū fīhā bayta al-ʿadli wa-yajtamiʿa fīhi al-nufūsu ʿalā ʿadadi al-Bahāʾ, wa-in izdāda lā baʾs. Wa-yarawna ka-annahum yadkhulūna maḥḍara Allāhi al-ʿaliyyi al-aʿlā wa-yarawna man lā yurā. Wa-yanbaghī lahum an yakūnū umanāʾa al-Raḥmāni bayna al-imkāni wa-wukalāʾa Allāhi li-man ʿalā al-arḍi kullihā wa-yushāwirū fī maṣāliḥi al-ʿibādi li-wajhi Allāhi kamā yushāwirūna fī umūrihim wa-yakhtārū mā huwa al-mukhtār. Kadhālika ḥakama rabbukumu al-ʿazīzu al-ghaffār. Iyyākum an tadaʿū mā huwa al-manṣūṣu fī al-lawḥ. Ittaqū Allāha yā ulī al-anẓār.

God has prescribed that a House of Justice be established in every city, in which souls numbering the numerical value of Bahāʾ shall gather; if the number is greater, there is no objection. They should regard themselves as entering the presence of God, the Most High, the Most Exalted, and as seeing Him who cannot be seen. They should be the trustees of the All-Merciful among created beings and God’s representatives for all who dwell on earth. They should consult, for God’s sake, on the interests of His servants as they consult on their own affairs, and choose what is best. Thus has your Lord, the Almighty, the Ever-Forgiving, decreed. Beware of abandoning what is expressly stated in the Tablet. Be mindful of God, you who possess insight.

32

یا ملاء الأنشآء عمّروا بیوتاً باکمل ما یمکن فی الامکان باسم مالک الأدیان فی البلدان و زینوها بما ینبغی لها لا بالصّور و الامثال ثمّ اذکروا فیها ربّکم الرّحمن بالرّوح و الرّیحان الا بذکره تستنیر الصّدور و تقرّ الأبصار

Yā malaʾa al-inshāʾ, ʿammirū buyūtan bi-akmali mā yumkinu fī al-imkāni bi-smi māliki al-adyāni fī al-buldāni wa-zayyinūhā bi-mā yanbaghī lahā lā bi-l-ṣuwari wa-l-amthāl. Thumma udhkurū fīhā rabbakumu al-Raḥmāna bi-l-rūḥi wa-l-rayḥān. Alā bi-dhikrihi tastanīru al-ṣudūru wa-taqarru al-abṣār.

People of creation! Build houses throughout the lands in the name of the Lord of religions, as perfectly as is possible in the world of being, and adorn them with what befits them, not with images and statues. Then remember within them your Lord, the All-Merciful, with joy and gladness. Truly, through remembrance of Him hearts are illumined and eyes are cheered.

33

قد حکم اللّه لمن استطاع منکم حجّ البیت دون النّسآء عفا اللّه عنهنّ رحمة من عنده انّه لهو المعطی الوهّاب

Qad ḥakama Allāhu li-man istaṭāʿa minkum ḥajja al-bayti dūna al-nisāʾ. ʿAfā Allāhu ʿanhunna raḥmatan min ʿindihi. Innahu la-huwa al-muʿṭī al-wahhāb.

God has ordained pilgrimage to the House for those of you who are able, except women. God has exempted them as a mercy from Him. He indeed is the Giver, the All-Bountiful.

34

یا اهل البهآء قد وجب علی کلّ واحدٍ منکم الاشتغال بامر من الامور من الصّنآیع و الاقتراف و امثالها و جعلنا اشتغالکم بها نفس العبادة للّه الحق تفکّروا یا قوم فی رحمة اللّه و الطافه ثمّ اشکروه فی العشی و الأشراق لا تضیعوا اوقاتکم بالبطالة و الکسالة و اشتغلوا بما ینتفع به انفسکم و انفس غیرکم کذلک قضی الأمر فی هذا اللّوح الّذی لاحت من افقه شمس الحکمة و التّبیان ابغض النّاس عند اللّه من یقعد و یطلب تمسّکوا بحبل الأسباب متوکّلین علی اللّه مسبّب الأسباب

Yā ahla al-Bahāʾ, qad wajaba ʿalā kulli wāḥidin minkumu al-ishtighālu bi-amrin mina al-umūri mina al-ṣanāʾiʿi wa-l-iqtirāfi wa-amthālihā. Wa-jaʿalnā ishtighālakum bihā nafsa al-ʿibādati li-llāhi al-ḥaqq. Tafakkarū yā qawmi fī raḥmati Allāhi wa-alṭāfihi thumma ushkurūhu fī al-ʿashiyyi wa-l-ishrāq. Lā tuḍayyiʿū awqātakum bi-l-baṭālati wa-l-kasālati wa-ishtaghilū bi-mā yantafiʿu bihi anfusukum wa-anfusu ghayrikum. Kadhālika quḍiya al-amru fī hādhā al-lawḥi alladhī lāḥat min ufuqihi shamsu al-ḥikmati wa-l-tibyān. Abghaḍu al-nāsi ʿinda Allāhi man yaqʿudu wa-yaṭlub. Tamassakū bi-ḥabli al-asbābi mutawakkilīna ʿalā Allāhi musabbibi al-asbāb.

People of Bahāʾ! Every one of you is required to engage in an occupation, such as a craft, a trade, or the like. We have made your engagement in such work the very worship of God, the True One. Reflect, My people, on God’s mercy and favors, then thank Him in the evening and at daybreak. Do not waste your time in idleness and laziness, but occupy yourselves with what benefits you and others. Thus has the matter been decreed in this Tablet, from whose horizon the sun of wisdom and exposition has shone. The most detestable of people in God’s sight is one who sits and begs. Hold fast to the cord of means, placing your trust in God, the Originator of all means.

35

قد حرّم علیکم تقبیل الأیادی فی الکتاب هذا ما نهیتم عنه من لدن ربّکم العزیز الحکّام لیس لأحدٍ ان یستغفر عند احد توبُوا الی اللّه تلقآء انفسکم انّه لهو الغافر المعطی العزیز التّوّاب

Qad ḥurrima ʿalaykum taqbīlu al-ayādī fī al-kitāb. Hādhā mā nuhītum ʿanhu min ladun rabbikumu al-ʿazīzi al-ḥakkām. Laysa li-aḥadin an yastaghfira ʿinda aḥad. Tūbū ilā Allāhi tilqāʾa anfusikum. Innahu la-huwa al-ghāfiru al-muʿṭī al-ʿazīzu al-tawwāb.

Kissing hands has been forbidden to you in the Book. This is what your Lord, the Almighty, the Supreme Judge, has prohibited you from doing. No one may seek forgiveness in the presence of another. Turn to God in repentance on your own. He indeed is the Forgiver, the Giver, the Almighty, the Ever-Relenting.

36

یا عباد الرّحمن قوموا علی خدمة الأمر علی شأنٍ لا تأخذکم الأحزان من الّذین کفروا بمطلع الآیات لمّا جآء الوعد و ظهر الموعود اختلف النّاس و تمسّک کلّ حزبٍ بما عنده من الظّنون و الأوهام

Yā ʿibāda al-Raḥmān, qūmū ʿalā khidmati al-amri ʿalā shaʾnin lā taʾkhudhukumu al-aḥzānu mina alladhīna kafarū bi-maṭlaʿi al-āyāt. Lammā jāʾa al-waʿdu wa-ẓahara al-mawʿūdu ikhtalafa al-nāsu wa-tamassaka kullu ḥizbin bi-mā ʿindahu mina al-ẓunūni wa-l-awhām.

Servants of the All-Merciful! Arise to serve the Cause in such a way that those who disbelieve in the Dawning-Place of the verses cannot afflict you with sorrow. When the promise was fulfilled and the Promised One appeared, the people fell into disagreement, and every party clung to its own conjectures and imaginings.

37

من النّاس من یقعد صفّ النّعال طلباً لصدر الجلال قل من انت یا ایها الغافل الغرّار و منهم من یدّعی الباطن و باطن الباطن قل یا ایها الکذّاب تاللّه ما عندک انّه من القشور ترکناها لکم کما تترک العظام للکلاب تاللّه الحقّ لو یغسل احد ارجل العالم و یعبد اللّه علی الادغال و الشّواجن و الجبال و القنان و الشناخیب و عند کلّ حجر و شجر و مدر و لا یتضوّع منه عرف رضآئی لن یقبل ابداً هذا ما حکم به مولی الانام کم من عبد اعتزل فی جزائر الهند و منع عن نفسه ما احلّه اللّه له و حمل الرّیاضات و المشقّات و لم یذکر عند اللّه منزل الآیات لا تجعلوا الأعمال شرک الآمال و لا تحرموا انفسکم عن هذا المأل الّذی کان امل المقرّبین فی ازل الازال قل روح الاعمال هو رضائی و علّق کلّ شئ بقبولی اقرؤا الالواح لتعرفوا ما هو المقصود فی کتب اللّه العزیز الوهّاب من فاز بحبّی حقّ له ان یقعد علی سریر العقیان فی صدر الامکان و الّذی منع عنه لو یقعد علی التّراب انّه یستعیذ منه الی اللّه مالک الأدیان

Mina al-nāsi man yaqʿudu ṣaffa al-niʿāli ṭalaban li-ṣadri al-jalāl. Qul man anta yā ayyuhā al-ghāfilu al-gharrār. Wa-minhum man yaddaʿī al-bāṭina wa-bāṭina al-bāṭin. Qul yā ayyuhā al-kadhdhāb, ta-Allāhi mā ʿindaka innahu mina al-qushūri taraknāhā lakum kamā tutraku al-ʿiẓāmu li-l-kilāb. Ta-Allāhi al-ḥaqq, law yaghsilu aḥadun arjula al-ʿālami wa-yaʿbudu Allāha ʿalā al-adghāli wa-l-shawājini wa-l-jibāli wa-l-qināni wa-l-shanākhībi wa-ʿinda kulli ḥajarin wa-shajarin wa-madarin wa-lā yataḍawwaʿu minhu ʿarfu riḍāʾī lan yuqbala abadan. Hādhā mā ḥakama bihi mawlā al-anām. Kam min ʿabdin iʿtazala fī jazāʾiri al-Hindi wa-manaʿa ʿan nafsihi mā aḥallahu Allāhu lahu wa-ḥamala al-riyāḍāti wa-l-mashaqqāti wa-lam yudhkar ʿinda Allāhi munzili al-āyāt. Lā tajʿalū al-aʿmāla sharaka al-āmāli wa-lā taḥrimū anfusakum ʿan hādhā al-maʾāli alladhī kāna amala al-muqarrabīna fī azali al-āzāl. Qul rūḥu al-aʿmāli huwa riḍāʾī wa-ʿulliqa kullu shayʾin bi-qabūlī. Iqraʾū al-alwāḥa li-taʿrifū mā huwa al-maqṣūdu fī kutubi Allāhi al-ʿazīzi al-wahhāb. Man fāza bi-ḥubbī ḥaqqa lahu an yaqʿuda ʿalā sarīri al-ʿiqyāni fī ṣadri al-imkān, wa-alladhī muniʿa ʿanhu law yaqʿudu ʿalā al-turābi innahu yastaʿīdhu minhu ilā Allāhi māliki al-adyān.

Among the people is one who sits among the shoes in pursuit of the seat of honor. Say: Who are you, heedless deceiver? Among them is one who claims knowledge of the inner meaning and its innermost meaning. Say: Liar! By God, what you possess is only husks that We have left to you, as bones are left to dogs. By God, the True One, even if someone were to wash the feet of the whole world and worship God in thickets, ravines, mountains, peaks, and lofty summits, and beside every stone, tree, and clod of earth, yet the fragrance of My good pleasure did not waft from him, he would never be accepted. This is what the Lord of all people has decreed. How many a servant has withdrawn to the islands of India, denied himself what God has made lawful for him, and borne austerities and hardships, yet has not been remembered before God, the Revealer of the verses. Do not make your deeds a snare for your hopes, and do not deprive yourselves of this ultimate goal, which has been the hope of those brought near to God from all eternity. Say: The spirit of deeds is My good pleasure, and everything depends upon My acceptance. Read the Tablets, that you may know what is intended in the Books of God, the Almighty, the All-Bountiful. Whoever has attained My love is entitled to sit on a throne of pure gold in the seat of honor in the world of being. But if one who has been deprived of it should sit upon the dust, the dust would seek refuge from him with God, the Lord of religions.

38

من یدّعی امراً قبل اتمام الف سنةٍ کاملةٍ انّه کذّاب مفترٍ نسئل اللّه بان یؤیّده علی الرّجوع ان تاب انّه هو التّوّاب و ان اصرّ علی ما قال یبعث علیه من لا یرحمه انّه شدید العقاب من یأوّل هذه الآیة او یفسّرها بغیر ما نزّل فی الظّاهر انّه محروم من روح اللّه و رحمته الّتی سبقت العالمین خافوا اللّه و لا تتّبعوا ما عندکم من الاوهام اتّبعوا ما یأمرکم به ربّکم العزیز الحکیم سوف یرتفع النّعاق من اکثر البلدان اجتنبوا یا قوم و لا تتّبعوا کلّ فاجرٍ لئیمٍ هذا ما اخبرناکم به اذ کنّا فی العراق و فی ارض السّرّ و فی هذا المنظر المنیر

Man yaddaʿī amran qabla itmāmi alfi sanatin kāmilatin innahu kadhdhābun muftarin. Nasʾalu Allāha bi-an yuʾayyidahu ʿalā al-rujūʿ. In tāba innahu huwa al-tawwāb, wa-in aṣarra ʿalā mā qāla yabʿathu ʿalayhi man lā yarḥamuhu. Innahu shadīdu al-ʿiqāb. Man yuʾawwilu hādhihi al-āyata aw yufassiruhā bi-ghayri mā nuzzila fī al-ẓāhiri innahu maḥrūmun min rūḥi Allāhi wa-raḥmatihi allatī sabaqati al-ʿālamīn. Khāfū Allāha wa-lā tattabiʿū mā ʿindakum mina al-awhām. Ittabiʿū mā yaʾmurukum bihi rabbukumu al-ʿazīzu al-ḥakīm. Sawfa yartafiʿu al-nuʿāqu min akthari al-buldān. Ijtanibū yā qawmi wa-lā tattabiʿū kulla fājirin laʾīm. Hādhā mā akhbarnākum bihi idh kunnā fī al-ʿIrāqi wa-fī arḍi al-sirri wa-fī hādhā al-manẓari al-munīr.

Whoever claims a revelation before the completion of a full thousand years is a lying impostor. We ask God to help him turn back. If he repents, God is indeed the Ever-Relenting; but if he persists in what he has said, He will raise up against him one who will show him no mercy. He is indeed severe in punishment. Whoever interprets this verse or explains it contrary to its revealed, outward meaning is deprived of the Spirit of God and His mercy, which has encompassed all worlds. Fear God and do not follow your own imaginings. Follow what your Lord, the Almighty, the All-Wise, commands you. Clamor will soon arise from most lands. Shun it, My people, and do not follow any wicked, base person. This is what We told you when We were in Iraq, in the Land of Mystery, and in this radiant place.

39

یا اهل الأرض اذا غربت شمس جمالی و سترت سمآء هیکلی لا تضطربوا قوموا علی نصرة امری و ارتفاع کلمتی بین العالمین انّا معکم فی کلّ الأحوال و ننصرکم بالحقّ انّا کنّا قادرین من عرفنی یقوم علی خدمتی بقیامٍ لا تقعده جنود السّموات و الأرضین

Yā ahla al-arḍ, idhā gharabat shamsu jamālī wa-sutirat samāʾu haykalī lā taḍṭaribū. Qūmū ʿalā nuṣrati amrī wa-irtifāʿi kalimatī bayna al-ʿālamīn. Innā maʿakum fī kulli al-aḥwāli wa-nanṣurukum bi-l-ḥaqq. Innā kunnā qādirīn. Man ʿarafanī yaqūmu ʿalā khidmatī bi-qiyāmin lā tuqʿiduhu junūdu al-samāwāti wa-l-arḍīn.

People of the earth! When the sun of My beauty has set and the heaven of My person has been concealed, do not be troubled. Arise to champion My Cause and exalt My Word among the peoples of the world. We are with you in all circumstances and will assuredly aid you. We are indeed powerful. Whoever has recognized Me will arise to serve Me with such resolve that the hosts of the heavens and the earth cannot hold him back.

40

انّ الناس نیام لو انتبهوا سرعوا بالقلوب الی اللّه العلیم الحکیم و نبذوا ما عندهم ولو کان کنوز الدّنیا کلّها لیذکرهم مولیهم بکلمةٍ من عنده کذلک ینبّئکم من عنده علم الغیب فی لوحٍ ما ظهر فی الامکان و ما اطّلع به الاّ نفسه المهیمنة علی العالمین قد اخذهم سکر الهوی علی شأنٍ لا یرون مولی الوری الّذی ارتفع ندآئه من کلّ الجهات لا اله الاّ انا العزیز الحکیم

Inna al-nāsa niyāmun, law intabahū saraʿū bi-l-qulūbi ilā Allāhi al-ʿalīmi al-ḥakīmi wa-nabadhū mā ʿindahum wa-law kāna kunūza al-dunyā kullahā li-yadhkurahum mawlāhum bi-kalimatin min ʿindihi. Kadhālika yunabbiʾukum man ʿindahu ʿilmu al-ghaybi fī lawḥin mā ẓahara fī al-imkāni wa-mā iṭṭalaʿa bihi illā nafsuhu al-muhayminatu ʿalā al-ʿālamīn. Qad akhadhahum sukru al-hawā ʿalā shaʾnin lā yarawna mawlā al-warā alladhī irtafaʿa nidāʾuhu min kulli al-jihāt: lā ilāha illā anā al-ʿazīzu al-ḥakīm.

People are asleep. Were they to awaken, they would hasten in their hearts to God, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise, and cast away all they possess, even if it were all the treasures of the world, so that their Lord might remember them with a word from Him. Thus does He who possesses knowledge of the unseen inform you in a Tablet that has not appeared in the world of being and of which none but His own Self, the Guardian over all worlds, has knowledge. The intoxication of desire has so seized them that they do not see the Lord of creation, whose call has risen from every direction: “There is no God but Me, the Almighty, the All-Wise.”

41

قل لا تفرحوا بما ملکتموه فی العشی و فی الاءشراق یملکه غیرکم کذلک یخبرکم العلیم الخبیر قل هل رایتم لما عندکم من قرارٍ او وفاءٍ لا و نفسی الرّحمن لو انتم من المنصفین تمرّ ایام حیوتکم کما تمرّ الاریاح و یطوی بساط عزّکم کما طوی بساط الأوّلین تفکّروا یا قوم این ایّامکم الماضیة و این اعصارکم الخالیة طوبی لأیّام مضت بذکر اللّه و لاوقات صرفت فی ذکره الحکیم لعمری لا تبقی عزّة الاعزّآء و لا زخارف الاغنیآء و لا شوکة الاشقیآء سیفنی الکلّ بکلمة من عنده انّه لهو المقتدر العزیز القدیر لا ینفع النّاس ما عندهم من الاثاث و ما ینفعهم غفلوا عنه سوف ینتبهون و لا یجدون ما فات عنهم فی ایّام ربّهم العزیز الحمید لو یعرفون ینفقون ما عندهم لتذکر اسمائهم لدی العرش الا انّهم من المیتین

Qul lā tafraḥū bi-mā malaktumūhu fī al-ʿashī wa-fī al-ishrāq yamlikuhu ghayrukum. Kadhālika yukhbirukum al-ʿAlīm al-Khabīr. Qul hal raʾaytum li-mā ʿindakum min qarārin aw wafāʾin? Lā wa-nafsī al-Raḥmān law antum min al-munṣifīn. Tamurru ayyāmu ḥayātikum ka-mā tamurru al-aryāḥ wa-yuṭwā bisāṭu ʿizzikum ka-mā ṭuwiya bisāṭu al-awwalīn. Tafakkarū yā qawm ayna ayyāmukum al-māḍiya wa-ayna aʿṣārukum al-khāliya. Ṭūbā li-ayyāmin maḍat bi-dhikri Allāh wa-li-awqātin ṣurifat fī dhikrihi al-Ḥakīm. La-ʿamrī lā tabqā ʿizzatu al-aʿizzāʾ wa-lā zakhārifu al-aghniyāʾ wa-lā shawkatu al-ashqiyāʾ. Sa-yafnā al-kullu bi-kalimatin min ʿindihi innahu la-huwa al-Muqtadir al-ʿAzīz al-Qadīr. Lā yanfaʿu al-nāsa mā ʿindahum min al-athāth wa-mā yanfaʿuhum ghafalū ʿanhu. Sawfa yantabihūna wa-lā yajidūna mā fāta ʿanhum fī ayyāmi Rabbihim al-ʿAzīz al-Ḥamīd. Law yaʿrifūna yunfiqūna mā ʿindahum li-tudhkara asmāʾuhum ladā al-ʿarsh. Alā innahum min al-mayyitīn.

Say: Do not rejoice in what you possess in the evening, for at dawn someone else will possess it. Thus the All-Knowing, the All-Informed informs you. Say: Have you found any permanence or faithfulness in what you possess? No, by My own Self, the All-Merciful, if you judge fairly. The days of your lives pass like the winds, and the carpet of your glory will be rolled up as the carpet of those before you was rolled up. Reflect, people: where are your past days, and where are your bygone ages? Blessed are the days spent remembering God and the hours devoted to remembering Him, the All-Wise. By My life, neither the glory of the mighty, nor the finery of the rich, nor the power of the wicked will endure. All will perish at a word from Him. He is indeed the All-Powerful, the Almighty, the Omnipotent. People’s possessions do not benefit them, while they neglect what does benefit them. Soon they will awaken and will not find what they missed in the days of their Lord, the Almighty, the Praiseworthy. If they understood, they would spend all they possess so that their names might be mentioned before the Throne. Yet they are indeed among the dead.

42

من النّاس من غرّته العلوم و بها من اسمی القیّوم و اذا سمع صوت النّعال عن خلفه یری نفسه اکبر من نمرود قل این هو یا ایها المردود تاللّه انّه لفی اسفل الجحیم قل یا معشر العلمآء اما تسمعون صریر قلمی الأعلی و اما ترون هذه الشّمس المشرقة من الأفق الأبهی الی م اعتکفتم علی اصنام اهوائکم دعوا الأوهام و توجّهوا الی اللّه مولیکم القدیم

Min al-nāsi man gharrathu al-ʿulūm wa-bihā [corrupted text] ismī al-Qayyūm wa-idhā samiʿa ṣawta al-niʿāl ʿan khalfihi yarā nafsahu akbara min Nimrūd. Qul ayna huwa yā ayyuhā al-mardūd? Ta-Allāh innahu la-fī asfali al-jaḥīm. Qul yā maʿshara al-ʿulamāʾ a-mā tasmaʿūna ṣarīra qalamī al-aʿlā wa-a-mā tarawna hādhihi al-shamsa al-mushriqata min al-ufuq al-abhā? Ilā ma iʿtakaftum ʿalā aṣnāmi ahwāʾikum? Daʿū al-awhām wa-tawajjahū ilā Allāh mawlākum al-Qadīm.

Among the people is one whom learning has deluded, and through it [corrupted original text] My name, the Self-Subsisting. When he hears the sound of sandals behind him, he considers himself greater than Nimrod. Say: Where is he, you who have been rejected? By God, he is in the lowest depths of hell. Say: Scholars! Do you not hear the scratching of My Most Exalted Pen, and do you not see this Sun shining from the most glorious horizon? Why have you remained devoted to the idols of your desires? Abandon your imaginings and turn toward God, your ancient Lord.

43

قد رجعت الاوقاف المختصّة للخیرات الی اللّه مظهر الآیات لیس لأحد ان یتصرّف فیها الاّ بعد اذن مطلع الوحی و من بعده یرجع الحکم الی الأغصان و من بعدهم الی بیت العدل ان تحقّق امره فی البلاد لیصرفوها فی البقاع المرتفعة فی هذا الأمر و فیما امروا به من لدن مقتدر قدیر والاّ ترجع الی اهل البهآء الّذین لا یتکلّمون الاّ بعد اذنه و لا یحکمون الاّ بما حکم اللّه فی هذا اللّوح اولٓئک اولیآء النّصر بین السّموات و الأرضین لیصرفوها فیما حدّد فی الکتاب من لدن عزیز کریم

Qad rajaʿat al-awqāfu al-mukhtaṣṣatu li-l-khayrāt ilā Allāh muẓhir al-āyāt. Laysa li-aḥadin an yataṣarrafa fīhā illā baʿda idhni maṭlaʿ al-waḥy wa-min baʿdihi yarjiʿu al-ḥukmu ilā al-Aghṣān wa-min baʿdihim ilā Bayt al-ʿAdl in taḥaqqaqa amruhu fī al-bilād li-yaṣrifūhā fī al-biqāʿ al-murtafiʿa fī hādhā al-amr wa-fī-mā umirū bihi min ladun Muqtadir Qadīr. Wa-illā tarjiʿu ilā ahl al-Bahāʾ alladhīna lā yatakallamūna illā baʿda idhnihi wa-lā yaḥkumūna illā bi-mā ḥakama Allāh fī hādhā al-lawḥ. Ulāʾika awliyāʾu al-naṣr bayna al-samāwāt wa-l-araḍīn li-yaṣrifūhā fī-mā ḥuddida fī al-kitāb min ladun ʿAzīz Karīm.

Endowments dedicated to charitable purposes have reverted to God, the Revealer of signs. No one may dispose of them without permission from the Dawning Place of Revelation. After Him, authority passes to the Branches, and after them to the House of Justice, if it has been established in the lands, so that they may spend them on the places exalted in this Cause and on whatever they have been commanded by One who is All-Powerful and Omnipotent. Otherwise, they revert to the people of Bahá who speak only with His permission and judge only according to what God has decreed in this Tablet. These are the champions of victory between the heavens and the earth. They are to spend them as prescribed in the Book by One who is Almighty and Generous.

44

لا تجزعوا فی المصائب و لا تفرحوا ابتغوا امراً بین الأمرین هو التّذکّر فی تلک الحالة و التّنبّه علی ما یرد علیکم فی العاقبة کذلک ینبئکم العلیم الخبیر

Lā tajzaʿū fī al-maṣāʾib wa-lā tafraḥū. Ibtaghū amran bayna al-amrayn huwa al-tadhakkur fī tilka al-ḥāla wa-l-tanabbuh ʿalā mā yaridu ʿalaykum fī al-ʿāqiba. Kadhālika yunabbiʾukum al-ʿAlīm al-Khabīr.

Do not despair in adversity, nor rejoice. Seek a course between the two: remembrance in that condition and awareness of what will come to you in the end. Thus the All-Knowing, the All-Informed instructs you.

45

لا تحلقوا رؤسکم قد زینها اللّه بالشّعر و فی ذلک لآیات لمن ینظر الی مقتضیات الطّبیعة من لدن مالک البریه انّه لهو العزیز الحکیم و لا ینبغی ان یتجاوز عن حدّ الآذان هذا ما حکم به مولی العالمین

Lā taḥliqū ruʾūsakum qad zayyanahā Allāh bi-l-shaʿr wa-fī dhālika la-āyātun li-man yanẓuru ilā muqtaḍayāt al-ṭabīʿa min ladun Mālik al-bariyya. Innahu la-huwa al-ʿAzīz al-Ḥakīm. Wa-lā yanbaghī an yata jāwaza ʿan ḥadd al-ādhān. Hādhā mā ḥakama bihi Mawlā al-ʿālamīn.

Do not shave your heads. God has adorned them with hair, and in this are signs for anyone who considers the requirements of nature ordained by the Sovereign of creation. He is indeed the Almighty, the All-Wise. Hair should not extend beyond the ears. This is what the Lord of the worlds has decreed.

46

قد کتب علی السّارق النّفی و الحبس و فی الثّالث فاجعلوا فی جبینه علامةً یعرف بها لئلاّ تقبله مدن اللّه و دیاره ایّاکم ان تأخذکم الرّأفة فی دین اللّه اعملوا ما امرتم به من لدن مشفق رحیم انّا ربّیناکم بسیاط الحکمة و الأحکام حفظاً لانفسکم و ارتفاعاً لمقاماتکم کما یربّی الابآء ابنائهم لعمری لو تعرفون ما اردناه لکم من اوامرنا المقدّسة لتفدون ارواحکم لهذا الأمر المقدّس العزیز المنیع

Qad kutiba ʿalā al-sāriq al-nafy wa-l-ḥabs wa-fī al-thālith fa-jʿalū fī jabīnihi ʿalāmatan yuʿrafu bihā li-allā taqbalahu mudunu Allāh wa-diyāruhu. Iyyākum an taʾkhudhakum al-raʾfatu fī dīn Allāh. Iʿmalū mā umirtum bihi min ladun Mushfiq Raḥīm. Innā rabbaynākum bi-siyāṭ al-ḥikma wa-l-aḥkām ḥifẓan li-anfusikum wa-irtifāʿan li-maqāmātikum ka-mā yurabbī al-ābāʾ abnāʾahum. La-ʿamrī law taʿrifūna mā aradnāhu lakum min awāmirinā al-muqaddasa la-tafdūna arwāḥakum li-hādhā al-amr al-muqaddas al-ʿAzīz al-Manīʿ.

Exile and imprisonment have been prescribed for the thief. On the third offense, place a mark on his forehead by which he may be recognized, so that the cities and lands of God will not admit him. Do not let pity restrain you in carrying out God’s religion. Do what you have been commanded by One who is Compassionate and Merciful. We have trained you with the lashes of wisdom and laws to protect you and elevate your stations, just as fathers bring up their children. By My life, if you understood what We have intended for you through Our sacred commandments, you would sacrifice your lives for this holy, mighty, unassailable Cause.

47

من اراد ان یستعمل اوانی الذّهب و الفضّة لا بأس علیه ایّاکم ان تنغمس ایادیکم فی الصّحاف و الصّحان خذوا ما یکون اقرب الی اللّطافة انّه اراد ان یریکم علی آداب اهل الرّضوان فی ملکوته الممتنع المنیع تمسّکوا باللّطافة فی کلّ الأحوال لئلاّ تقع العیون علی ما تکرهه انفسکم و اهل الفردوس و الّذی تجاوز عنها یحبط عمله فی الحین و ان کان له عذر یعفو اللّه عنه انّه لهو العزیز الکریم

Man arāda an yastaʿmila awāniya al-dhahab wa-l-fiḍḍa lā baʾsa ʿalayhi. Iyyākum an tanghamisa ayādīkum fī al-ṣiḥāf wa-l-ṣiḥān. Khudhū mā yakūnu aqraba ilā al-laṭāfa. Innahu arāda an yuriyakum ʿalā ādāb ahl al-Riḍwān fī malakūtihi al-mumtaniʿ al-manīʿ. Tamassakū bi-l-laṭāfa fī kull al-aḥwāl li-allā taqaʿa al-ʿuyūnu ʿalā mā takrahuhu anfusukum wa-ahlu al-firdaws. Wa-alladhī tajāwaza ʿanhā yaḥbaṭu ʿamaluhu fī al-ḥīn wa-in kāna lahu ʿudhrun yaʿfū Allāh ʿanhu. Innahu la-huwa al-ʿAzīz al-Karīm.

Anyone who wishes to use vessels of gold and silver may do so. Take care not to plunge your hands into bowls and platters. Adopt what is most in keeping with refinement. He wishes to see you observe the manners of the people of Paradise in His inaccessible, unassailable Kingdom. Adhere to refinement in all circumstances, so that no eyes fall upon anything repugnant to you or to the people of Paradise. Whoever departs from it will have his deeds immediately brought to nothing; but if he has an excuse, God will pardon him. He is indeed the Almighty, the Generous.

48

لیس لمطلع الأمر شریک فی العصمة الکبری انّه لمظهر یفعل ما یشآء فی ملکوت الانشآء قد خصّ اللّه هذا المقام لنفسه و ما قدّر لأحد نصیب من هذا الشّأن العظیم المنیع هذا امر اللّه قد کان مستوراً فی حجب الغیب اظهرناه فی هذا الظّهور و به خرقنا حجاب الّذین ما عرفوا حکم الکتاب و کانوا من الغافلین

Laysa li-maṭlaʿ al-amr sharīkun fī al-ʿiṣma al-kubrā. Innahu la-maẓharu yafʿalu mā yashāʾ fī malakūt al-inshāʾ. Qad khaṣṣa Allāh hādhā al-maqāma li-nafsihi wa-mā qaddara li-aḥadin naṣīban min hādhā al-shaʾn al-ʿaẓīm al-manīʿ. Hādhā amru Allāh qad kāna mastūran fī ḥujub al-ghayb aẓharnāhu fī hādhā al-ẓuhūr wa-bihi kharaqnā ḥijāba alladhīna mā ʿarafū ḥukma al-kitāb wa-kānū min al-ghāfilīn.

The Dawning Place of the Cause has no partner in the Most Great Infallibility. He is indeed the manifestation of “He does whatever He wills” in the kingdom of creation. God has reserved this station for Himself and has allotted no one a share in this exalted, unassailable rank. This is God’s decree, formerly concealed behind the veils of the unseen. We have disclosed it in this Revelation, and through it We have torn apart the veil of those who did not understand the ruling of the Book and were among the heedless.

49

کتب علی کلّ اب تربیة ابنه و بنته بالعلم و الخطّ و دونهما عمّا حدّد فی اللّوح و الّذی ترک ما امر به فللأمنآء ان یأخذوا منه ما یکون لازماً لتربیتهما ان کان غنیاً والّا یرجع الی بیت العدل انّا جعلناه مأوی الفقرآء و المساکین انّ الّذی ربّی ابنه او ابناً من الأبنآء کأنّه ربّی احد ابنائی علیه بهائی و عنایتی و رحمتی الّتی سبقت العالمین

Kutiba ʿalā kull ab tarbiyatu ibnihi wa-bintihi bi-l-ʿilm wa-l-khaṭṭ wa-dūnihimā ʿammā ḥuddida fī al-lawḥ. Wa-alladhī taraka mā umira bihi fa-li-l-umanāʾ an yaʾkhudhū minhu mā yakūnu lāziman li-tarbiyatihimā in kāna ghaniyyan wa-illā yarjiʿu ilā Bayt al-ʿAdl. Innā jaʿalnāhu maʾwā al-fuqarāʾ wa-l-masākīn. Inna alladhī rabbā ibnahu aw ibnan min al-abnāʾ ka-annahu rabbā aḥada abnāʾī. ʿAlayhi bahāʾī wa-ʿināyatī wa-raḥmatī allatī sabaqat al-ʿālamīn.

Every father is required to educate his son and daughter in knowledge and writing, and in the other subjects prescribed in the Tablet. If anyone neglects what he has been commanded, the trustees may take from him what is needed for their education if he is wealthy; otherwise, the matter devolves upon the House of Justice. We have made it a refuge for the poor and needy. Whoever educates his own child or another child is as though he had educated one of My children. Upon him rest My glory, My loving care, and My mercy, which has encompassed all worlds.

50

قد حکم اللّه لکلّ زان و زانیة دیة مسلّمة الی بیت العدل و هی تسعة مثاقیل من الذّهب و ان عادا مرّة اخری عودوا بضعف الجزآء هذا ما حکم به مالک الأسمآء فی الأولی و فی الأخری قدّر لهما عذاب مهین من ابتلی بمعصیة فله ان یتوب و یرجع الی اللّه انّه یغفر لمن یشآء و لا یسئل عمّا شآء انّه لهو التوّاب العزیز الحمید

Qad ḥakama Allāh li-kull zānin wa-zāniyatin diyatan musallamatan ilā Bayt al-ʿAdl wa-hiya tisʿatu mathāqīla min al-dhahab wa-in ʿādā marratan ukhrā ʿūdū bi-ḍiʿf al-jazāʾ. Hādhā mā ḥakama bihi Mālik al-asmāʾ fī al-ūlā wa-fī al-ukhrā qaddara lahumā ʿadhābun muhīn. Man ibtuliya bi-maʿṣiyatin fa-lahu an yatūba wa-yarjiʿa ilā Allāh. Innahu yaghfiru li-man yashāʾ wa-lā yusʾalu ʿammā shāʾ. Innahu la-huwa al-Tawwāb al-ʿAzīz al-Ḥamīd.

God has decreed that every adulterer and adulteress pay a fine to the House of Justice of nine mithqals of gold. If they repeat the offense, double the penalty. This is what the Sovereign of Names has decreed in this world; in the world to come He has ordained a humiliating punishment for them both. Anyone who commits a sin may repent and return to God. He forgives whomever He wills and is not questioned about what He wills. He is indeed the Ever-Forgiving, the Almighty, the Praiseworthy.

51

ایاکم ان تمنعکم سبحات الجلال عن زلال هذا السّلسال خذوا اقداح الفلاح فی هذا الصّباح باسم فالق الاصباح ثمّ اشربوا بذکره العزیز البدیع

Iyyākum an tamnaʿakum subuḥātu al-jalāl ʿan zulāl hādhā al-salsāl. Khudhū aqdāḥa al-falāḥ fī hādhā al-ṣabāḥ bi-smi Fāliq al-iṣbāḥ thumma ishrabū bi-dhikrihi al-ʿAzīz al-Badīʿ.

Do not let the veils of glory keep you from the pure water of this flowing spring. Take up the cups of salvation this morning in the name of Him who causes the dawn to break, then drink in remembrance of Him, the Almighty, the Incomparable.

52

انّا حلّلنا لکم اصغآء الأصوات و النّغمات ایّاکم ان یخرجکم الاصغآء عن شأن الأدب و الوقار افرحوا بفرح اسمی الأعظم الّذی به تولّهت الافئدة و انجذبت عقول المقرّبین انّا جعلناه مرقاةً لعروج الأرواح الی الأفق الأعلی لا تجعلوه جناح النّفس و الهوی انّی اعوذ ان تکونوا من الجاهلین

Innā ḥallalnā lakum iṣghāʾa al-aṣwāt wa-l-naghamāt. Iyyākum an yukhrijakum al-iṣghāʾ ʿan shaʾn al-adab wa-l-waqār. Ifraḥū bi-faraḥ ismī al-aʿẓam alladhī bihi tawallahat al-afʾida wa-injadhabat ʿuqūlu al-muqarrabīn. Innā jaʿalnāhu mirqātan li-ʿurūj al-arwāḥ ilā al-ufuq al-aʿlā. Lā tajʿalūhu janāḥa al-nafs wa-l-hawā. Innī aʿūdhu an takūnū min al-jāhilīn.

We have made it lawful for you to listen to voices and melodies. Take care that listening does not lead you beyond the bounds of propriety and dignity. Rejoice in the joy of My Most Great Name, through which hearts have been enraptured and the minds of those brought near have been drawn in attraction. We have made it a ladder for souls to ascend to the highest horizon. Do not make it a wing for self and desire. I seek refuge from your being among the ignorant.

53

قد ارجعنا ثلث الدّیات کلّها الی مقرّ العدل و نوصی رجاله بالعدل الخالص لیصرفوا ما اجتمع عندهم فیما امروا به من لدن علیم حکیم یا رجال العدل کونوا رعاة اغنام اللّه فی مملکته و احفظوهم عن الذّئاب الّذین ظهروا بالأثواب کما تحفظون ابنائکم کذلک ینصحکم النّاصح الأمین

Qad arjaʿnā thultha al-diyāt kullihā ilā maqarr al-ʿadl wa-nūṣī rijālahu bi-l-ʿadl al-khāliṣ li-yaṣrifū mā ijtamaʿa ʿindahum fī-mā umirū bihi min ladun ʿAlīm Ḥakīm. Yā rijāl al-ʿadl kūnū ruʿāta aghnām Allāh fī mamlakatihi wa-iḥfaẓūhum ʿan al-dhiʾāb alladhīna ẓaharū bi-l-athwāb ka-mā taḥfaẓūna abnāʾakum. Kadhālika yanṣaḥukum al-Nāṣiḥ al-Amīn.

We have assigned a third of all fines to the seat of justice, and We counsel its members to practice pure justice, so that they may spend what has accumulated with them as they have been commanded by One who is All-Knowing and All-Wise. Members of the House of Justice! Be shepherds of God’s sheep in His kingdom, and protect them from the wolves that have appeared in disguise, just as you protect your own children. Thus the faithful Counselor advises you.

54

اذا اختلفتم فی امر فارجعوه الی اللّه ما دامت الشّمس مشرقة من افق هذه السّماء و اذا غربت ارجعوا الی ما نزّل من عنده انّه لیکفی العالمین قل یا قوم لا یأخذکم الاضطراب اذا غاب ملکوت ظهوری و سکنت امواج بحر بیانی انّ فی ظهوری لحکمة و فی غیبتی حکمة اخری ما اطّلع بها الاّ اللّه الفرد الخبیر و نراکم من افقی الأبهی و ننصر من قام علی نصرة امری بجنود من الملاء الأعلی و قبیل من الملائکة المقرّبین

Idhā ikhtalaftum fī amrin fa-arjiʿūhu ilā Allāh mā dāmat al-shamsu mushriqatan min ufuq hādhihi al-samāʾ wa-idhā gharabat irjiʿū ilā mā nuzzila min ʿindihi. Innahu la-yakfī al-ʿālamīn. Qul yā qawm lā yaʾkhudhkum al-iḍṭirāb idhā ghāba malakūtu ẓuhūrī wa-sakanat amwāju baḥr bayānī. Inna fī ẓuhūrī la-ḥikmatan wa-fī ghaybatī ḥikmatun ukhrā mā iṭṭalaʿa bihā illā Allāh al-Fard al-Khabīr. Wa-narākum min ufuqī al-abhā wa-nanṣuru man qāma ʿalā nuṣrati amrī bi-junūdin min al-malaʾ al-aʿlā wa-qabīlin min al-malāʾika al-muqarrabīn.

If you disagree over a matter, refer it to God as long as the Sun shines from the horizon of this heaven. When it has set, turn to what has been sent down from Him. It is indeed sufficient for all worlds. Say: People! Do not be troubled when the kingdom of My revelation has disappeared and the waves of the ocean of My utterance have grown still. In My appearance there is a wisdom, and in My absence there is another wisdom, known to none but God, the One, the All-Informed. We see you from My most glorious horizon and will aid anyone who arises to champion My Cause with hosts from the Concourse on high and a company of angels brought near.

55

یا ملاء الأرض تاللّه الحقّ قد انفجرت من الأحجار الأنهار العذبة السّائغة بما اخذتها حلاوة بیان ربّکم المختار و انتم من الغافلین دعوا ما عندکم ثمّ طیروا بقوادم الانقطاع فوق الابداع کذلک یأمرکم مالک الاختراع الّذی بحرکة قلمه قلّب العالمین

Yā malaʾ al-arḍ ta-Allāh al-Ḥaqq qad infajarat min al-aḥjār al-anhāru al-ʿadhbatu al-sāʾigha bi-mā akhadhathā ḥalāwatu bayāni Rabbikum al-Mukhtār wa-antum min al-ghāfilīn. Daʿū mā ʿindakum thumma ṭīrū bi-qawādim al-inqiṭāʿ fawqa al-ibdāʿ. Kadhālika yaʾmurukum Mālik al-ikhtirāʿ alladhī bi-ḥarakati qalamihi qallaba al-ʿālamīn.

People of the earth! By God, the Truth, sweet, refreshing rivers have burst from the rocks, so seized have they been by the sweetness of the utterance of your Lord, the Unconstrained; yet you remain heedless. Abandon what you possess, then soar on the wings of detachment above creation. Thus commands you the Sovereign of creation, who has transformed the worlds with a movement of His Pen.

56

هل تعرفون من ایّ افقٍ ینادیکم ربّکم الأبهی و هل علمتم من ایّ قلم یأمرکم ربّکم مالک الأسمآء لا و عمری لو عرفتم لترکتم مقبلین بالقلوب الی شطر المحبوب و اخذکم اهتزاز الکلمة علی شأن یهتزّ منه العالم الأکبر و کیف هذا العالم الصّغیر کذلک هطلت من سماء عنایتی امطار مکرمتی فضلاً من عندی لتکونوا من الشّاکرین

Hal taʿrifūna min ayyi ufuqin yunādīkum Rabbukum al-Abhā wa-hal ʿalimtum min ayyi qalamin yaʾmurukum Rabbukum Mālik al-asmāʾ? Lā wa-ʿamrī law ʿaraftum la-taraktum muqbilīna bi-l-qulūb ilā shaṭr al-maḥbūb wa-akhadhakum ihtizāzu al-kalima ʿalā shaʾnin yahtazzu minhu al-ʿālam al-akbar wa-kayfa hādhā al-ʿālam al-ṣaghīr. Kadhālika haṭalat min samāʾ ʿināyatī amṭāru makrumatī faḍlan min ʿindī li-takūnū min al-shākirīn.

Do you know from what horizon your all-glorious Lord calls you, and have you understood from what Pen your Lord, the Sovereign of Names, commands you? No, by My life! If you knew, you would let go, turning your hearts toward the Beloved, and the stirring of the Word would seize you with such force that the greater world would tremble—how much more this lesser world. Thus the rains of My generosity have poured down from the heaven of My loving care, as a grace from Me, so that you may be thankful.

57

و امّا الشّجاج و الضّرب تختلف احکامهما باختلاف مقادیرهما و حکم الدّیان لکلّ مقدار دیة معینة انّه لهو الحاکم العزیز المنیع لو نشآء نفصّلها بالحقّ وعداً من عندنا انّه لهو الموفّی العلیم

Wa-ammā al-shijāj wa-l-ḍarb takhtalifu aḥkāmuhumā bi-ikhtilāf maqādīrihimā wa-ḥakama al-Dayyān li-kull miqdārin diyatan muʿayyana. Innahu la-huwa al-Ḥākim al-ʿAzīz al-Manīʿ. Law nashāʾ nufaṣṣiluhā bi-l-ḥaqq waʿdan min ʿindinā. Innahu la-huwa al-Muwaffī al-ʿAlīm.

As for wounds and blows, their rulings vary according to their severity, and the Judge has decreed a specified compensation for each degree. He is indeed the Ruler, the Almighty, the Unassailable. Should We wish, We will set them out in detail in truth—a promise from Us. He is indeed the One who fulfills His promise, the All-Knowing.

58

قد رقم علیکم الضّیافة فی کلّ شهر مرّةً واحدةً ولو بالمآء انّ اللّه اراد ان یؤلّف بین القلوب ولو باسباب السّموات و الأرضین

Qad ruqima ʿalaykum al-ḍiyāfatu fī kull shahr marratan wāḥidatan wa-law bi-l-māʾ. Inna Allāh arāda an yuʾallifa bayna al-qulūb wa-law bi-asbāb al-samāwāt wa-l-araḍīn.

You have been enjoined to offer hospitality once each month, even if only with water. God wishes to unite hearts, even through the means of the heavens and the earth.

59

ایّاکم ان تفرّقکم شئونات النّفس و الهوی کونوا کالأصابع فی الید و الأرکان للبدن کذلک یعظکم قلم الوحی ان انتم من الموقنین

Iyyākum an tufarriqakum shuʾūnātu al-nafs wa-l-hawā. Kūnū ka-l-aṣābiʿ fī al-yad wa-l-arkān li-l-badan. Kadhālika yaʿiẓukum Qalam al-waḥy in antum min al-mūqinīn.

Do not let the promptings of self and desire divide you. Be like the fingers of one hand and the limbs of one body. Thus the Pen of Revelation counsels you, if you are among those who are certain.

60

فانظروا فی رحمة اللّه و الطافه انّه یأمرکم بما ینفعکم بعد اذ کان غنیاً عن العالمین لن تضرّنا سیئاتکم کما لا تنفعنا حسناتکم انّما ندعوکم لوجه اللّه یشهد بذلک کلّ عالم بصیر

Fa-nẓurū fī raḥmat Allāh wa-alṭāfihi innahu yaʾmurukum bi-mā yanfaʿukum baʿda idh kāna ghaniyyan ʿan al-ʿālamīn. Lan taḍurranā sayyiʾātukum ka-mā lā tanfaʿunā ḥasanātukum. Innamā nadʿūkum li-wajh Allāh. Yashhadu bi-dhālika kullu ʿālim baṣīr.

Consider God’s mercy and kindness: He commands you to do what benefits you, although He has no need of any of the worlds. Your evil deeds will never harm Us, just as your good deeds do not benefit Us. We call you only for the sake of God. Every discerning person of knowledge bears witness to this.

61

اذا ارسلتم الجوارح الی الصّید اذکروا اللّه اذاً یحلّ ما امسکن لکم ولو تجدونه میتاً انّه لهو العلیم الخبیر ایّاکم ان تسرفوا فی ذلک کونوا علی صراط العدل و الانصاف فی کلّ الأمور کذلک یأمرکم مطلع الظّهور ان انتم من العارفین

Idhā arsaltum al-jawāriḥ ilā al-ṣayd udhkurū Allāh idhan yaḥill mā amsakna lakum wa-law tajidūnahu maytan innahu la-huwa al-ʿalīm al-khabīr. Iyyākum an tusrifū fī dhālik kūnū ʿalā ṣirāṭ al-ʿadl wa-al-inṣāf fī kull al-umūr. Kadhālika yaʾmurukum maṭlaʿ al-ẓuhūr in antum min al-ʿārifīn.

When you send hunting animals after game, mention God; then whatever they catch for you is lawful, even if you find it dead. He is indeed the All-Knowing, the All-Informed. Beware of excess in this matter. Follow the path of justice and fairness in all things. Thus the Dawning-Place of Revelation commands you, if you are among those who understand.

62

انّ اللّه قد امرکم بالمودّة فی ذوی القربی و ما قدّر لهم حقّاً فی اموال النّاس انّه لهو الغنی عن العالمین

Inna Allāh qad amarakum bi-al-mawadda fī dhawī al-qurbā wa-mā qaddara lahum ḥaqqan fī amwāl al-nās innahu la-huwa al-ghaniyy ʿan al-ʿālamīn.

God has commanded you to show affection toward His kindred, but has assigned them no right to the property of others. He is indeed independent of all the worlds.

63

من احرق بیتاً متعمّداً فاحرقوه و من قتل نفساً عامداً فاقتلوه خذوا سنن اللّه بأیادی القدرة و الاقتدار ثمّ اترکوا سنَنَ الجاهلین و ان تحکموا لهما حبساً ابدیّاً لا بأس علیکم فی الکتاب انّه لهو الحاکم علی ما یرید

Man aḥraqa baytan mutaʿammidan fa-aḥriqūhu wa-man qatala nafsan ʿāmidan fa-uqtulūhu. Khudhū sunan Allāh bi-ayādī al-qudra wa-al-iqtidār thumma utrukū sunan al-jāhilīn. Wa-in taḥkumū lahumā ḥabsan abadiyyan lā baʾs ʿalaykum fī al-kitāb innahu la-huwa al-ḥākim ʿalā mā yurīd.

Whoever deliberately burns down a house, burn him; whoever intentionally kills a person, put him to death. Take hold of God’s laws with the hands of power and might, and abandon the ways of the ignorant. If you sentence them both to lifelong imprisonment, no blame attaches to you in the Book. He indeed rules as He wills.

64

بواحدة من الامآء استراحت نفسه و نفسها و من اتّخذ بکراً لخدمته قد کتب اللّه علیکم النّکاح ایّاکم ان تجاوزوا عن الاثنتین و الّذی اقتنع لا بأس علیه کذلک کان الأمر من قلم الوحی بالحقّ مرقوماً تزوّجوا یا قوم لیظهر منکم من یذکرنی بین عبادی هذا من امری علیکم اتخذوه لانفسکم معیناً

Bi-wāḥida min al-imāʾ istarāḥat nafsuhu wa-nafsuhā wa-man ittakhadha bikran li-khidmatihi qad kataba Allāh ʿalaykum al-nikāḥ iyyākum an tujāwizū ʿan al-ithnatayn wa-alladhī iqtanaʿa lā baʾs ʿalayhi kadhālika kāna al-amr min qalam al-waḥy bi-al-ḥaqq marqūman. Tazawwajū yā qawm li-yaẓhara minkum man yadhkurunī bayna ʿibādī hādhā min amrī ʿalaykum ittakhidhūhu li-anfusikum muʿīnan.

With one of the maidservants, his soul and hers find rest. As for whoever takes a virgin into his service, God has prescribed marriage for you. Beware of exceeding two, and whoever is content incurs no blame. Thus has the decree been inscribed in truth by the Pen of Revelation. Marry, O people, so that from you may appear someone who will remember Me among My servants. This is My command to you; take it as an aid to yourselves.

65

یا ملاء الانشآء لا تتّبعوا انفسکم انّها لأمّارة بالبغی و الفحشآء اتبعوا مالک الأشیآء الّذی یأمرکم بالبرّ و التّقوی انّه کان عن العالمین غنیاً ایّاکم ان تفسدوا فی الأرض بعد اصلاحها و من افسد انّه لیس منّا و نحن برٴآء منه کذلک کان الأمر من سمآء الوحی بالحقّ مشهوداً

Yā malaʾ al-inshāʾ lā tattabiʿū anfusakum innahā la-ammāra bi-al-baghy wa-al-faḥshāʾ. Ittabiʿū mālik al-ashyāʾ alladhī yaʾmurukum bi-al-birr wa-al-taqwā innahu kāna ʿan al-ʿālamīn ghaniyyan. Iyyākum an tufsidū fī al-arḍ baʿda iṣlāḥihā wa-man afsada innahu laysa minnā wa-naḥnu buraʾāʾ minhu. Kadhālika kāna al-amr min samāʾ al-waḥy bi-al-ḥaqq mashhūdan.

O people of creation, do not follow your own selves, for they constantly urge wrongdoing and indecency. Follow the Lord of all things, who commands you to practice righteousness and reverence for God. He is independent of all the worlds. Beware of spreading corruption on earth after it has been set right. Whoever spreads corruption is not one of Us, and We disavow him. Thus has the decree been made manifest in truth from the heaven of revelation.

66

انّه قد حدّد فی البیان برضآء الطّرفین انّا لمّا اردنا المحبّة و الوداد و اتّحاد العباد لذا علّقناه باذن الأبوین بعدهما لئلاّ تقع بینهم الضّغینة و البغضآء و لنا فیه مأرب اخری و کذلک کان الأمر مقضیّا

Innahu qad ḥuddida fī al-bayān bi-riḍā al-ṭarafayn innā lammā aradnā al-maḥabba wa-al-widād wa-ittiḥād al-ʿibād lidhā ʿallaqnāhu bi-idhn al-abawayn baʿdahumā li-allā taqaʿa baynahum al-ḍaghīna wa-al-baghḍāʾ wa-lanā fīhi maʾrib ukhrā wa-kadhālika kāna al-amr maqḍiyyan.

In the Bayan, it was made conditional on the consent of both parties. Since We desire love, affection, and unity among Our servants, We have also made it dependent on the permission of the parents after that of the couple, so that resentment and hatred may not arise among them. We have other purposes in this as well. Thus has the matter been decreed.

67

لا یحقّق الصّهار الاّ بالامهار قد قدّر للمدن تسعة عشر مثقالاً من الذّهب الابریز و للقری من الفضّة و من اراد الزّیادة حرّم علیه ان یتجاوز عن خمسة و تسعین مثقالا کذلک کان الأمر بالعزّ مسطورا و الّذی اقتنع بالدّرجة الأولی خیر له فی الکتاب انّه یغنی من یشآء باسباب السّموات و الأرض و کان اللّه علی کلّ شئً قدیراً

Lā yuḥaqqaq al-ṣihār illā bi-al-imhār qad quddira li-al-mudun tisʿata ʿashara mithqālan min al-dhahab al-ibrīz wa-li-al-qurā min al-fiḍḍa wa-man arāda al-ziyāda ḥurrima ʿalayhi an yatajāwaza ʿan khamsa wa-tisʿīn mithqālan kadhālika kāna al-amr bi-al-ʿizz masṭūran. Wa-alladhī iqtanaʿa bi-al-daraja al-ūlā khayr lahu fī al-kitāb innahu yughnī man yashāʾ bi-asbāb al-samāwāt wa-al-arḍ wa-kāna Allāh ʿalā kull shayʾ qadīran.

Marriage is not established without a dowry. For towns, nineteen mithqals of pure gold have been prescribed, and for villages, the same amount of silver. Whoever wishes to increase this is forbidden to exceed ninety-five mithqals. Thus has the decree been inscribed in majesty. For whoever is content with the lowest amount, this is better for him according to the Book. He enriches whomever He wills through the means of the heavens and the earth. God has power over all things.

68

قد کتب اللّه لکلّ عبد اراد الخروج من وطنه ان یجعل میقاتا لصاحبته فی ایة مدّة اراد ان اتی و وفی بالوعد انّه اتّبع امر مولاه و کان من المحسنین من قلم الأمر مکتوبا والاّ ان اعتذر بعذر حقیقی فله ان یخبر قرینته و یکون فی غایة الجهد للرّجوع الیها و ان فات الأمران فلها تربّص تسعة اشهر معدودات و بعد اکمالها لا بأس علیها فی اختیار الزّوج و ان صبرت انّه یحبّ الصّابرات و الصّابرین اعملوا اوامری و لا تتّبعوا کلّ مشرک کان فی اللّوح اثیماً و ان اتی الخبر حین تربّصها لها ان تأخذ المعروف انّه اراد الاصلاح بین العباد و الاماء ایّاکم ان ترتکبوا ما یحدث به العناد بینکم کذلک قضی الأمر و کان الوعد مأتیاً و ان اتاها خبر الموت او القتل و ثبت بالشّیاع او بالعدلین لها ان تلبث فی البیت اذا مضت اشهر معدودات لها الاختیار فیما تختار هذا ما حکم به من کان علی الأمر قویا

Qad kataba Allāh li-kull ʿabd arāda al-khurūj min waṭanihi an yajʿala mīqātan li-ṣāḥibatihi fī ayyat mudda arād. In atā wa-wafā bi-al-waʿd innahu ittabaʿa amr mawlāhu wa-kāna min al-muḥsinīn min qalam al-amr maktūban wa-illā in iʿtadhara bi-ʿudhr ḥaqīqī fa-lahu an yukhbira qarīnatahu wa-yakūna fī ghāyat al-juhd li-al-rujūʿ ilayhā wa-in fāta al-amrān fa-lahā tarabbuṣ tisʿat ashhur maʿdūdāt wa-baʿda ikmālihā lā baʾs ʿalayhā fī ikhtiyār al-zawj wa-in ṣabarat innahu yuḥibb al-ṣābirāt wa-al-ṣābirīn. Iʿmalū awāmirī wa-lā tattabiʿū kull mushrik kāna fī al-lawḥ athīman. Wa-in atā al-khabar ḥīna tarabbuṣihā lahā an taʾkhudha al-maʿrūf innahu arāda al-iṣlāḥ bayna al-ʿibād wa-al-imāʾ iyyākum an tartakibū mā yaḥduthu bihi al-ʿinād baynakum kadhālika quḍiya al-amr wa-kāna al-waʿd maʾtiyyan. Wa-in atāhā khabar al-mawt aw al-qatl wa-thabata bi-al-shiyāʿ aw bi-al-ʿadlayn lahā an talbatha fī al-bayt idhā maḍat ashhur maʿdūdāt lahā al-ikhtiyār fīmā takhtār hādhā mā ḥakama bihi man kāna ʿalā al-amr qawiyyan.

God has prescribed that every man who wishes to leave his homeland set a time for his wife, of whatever duration he wishes. If he returns and fulfills his promise, he has obeyed his Lord’s command and is recorded by the Pen of Command among those who do good. Otherwise, if he has a genuine excuse, he must inform his wife and make every effort to return to her. If neither occurs, she is to wait nine full months; after completing them, she incurs no blame in choosing a husband. If she waits patiently, He loves women and men who are patient. Follow My commandments, and do not follow any who associates partners with God and is recorded as sinful in the Tablet. If news arrives during her waiting period, she may do what is right. He desires reconciliation between His male and female servants. Beware of doing anything that creates hostility among you. Thus has the matter been decreed, and the promise is fulfilled. If news of his death or killing reaches her and is established by widespread report or by two just witnesses, she is to remain in the house. When the appointed months have passed, she is free to choose as she wishes. This is what He who is mighty in command has decreed.

69

و ان حدث بینهما کدورة او کره لیس له ان یطلّقها و له ان یصبر سنة کاملة لعلّ تسطع بینهما رائحة المحبّة و ان کملت و ما فاحت فلا بأس فی الطّلاق انّه کان علی کلّ شئ حکیماً قد نهاکم اللّه عمّا عملتم بعد طلقات ثلاث فضلاً من عنده لتکونوا من الشّاکرین فی لوحٍ کان من قلم الأمر مسطوراً و الّذی طلّق له الاختیار فی الرّجوع بعد انقضاء کلّ شهر بالمودّة و الرضآء ما لم تستحصن و اذا استحصنت تحقّق الفصل بوصل آخر و قضی الأمر الاّ بعد امر مبین کذلک کان الأمر من مطلع الجمال فی لوح الجلال بالاجلال مرقوماً

Wa-in ḥadatha baynahumā kudūra aw kurh laysa lahu an yuṭalliqahā wa-lahu an yaṣbira sana kāmila laʿalla tasṭaʿu baynahumā rāʾiḥat al-maḥabba wa-in kamulat wa-mā fāḥat fa-lā baʾs fī al-ṭalāq innahu kāna ʿalā kull shayʾ ḥakīman. Qad nahākum Allāh ʿammā ʿamiltum baʿda ṭalaqāt thalāth faḍlan min ʿindihi li-takūnū min al-shākirīn fī lawḥ kāna min qalam al-amr masṭūran.
