Wa-alladhī ṭallaqa lahu al-ikhtiyār fī al-rujūʿ baʿda inqiḍāʾ kull shahr bi-al-mawadda wa-al-riḍā mā lam tastaḥṣin wa-idhā istaḥṣanat taḥaqqaqa al-faṣl bi-waṣl ākhar wa-quḍiya al-amr illā baʿda amr mubīn kadhālika kāna al-amr min maṭlaʿ al-jamāl fī lawḥ al-jalāl bi-al-ijlāl marqūman.

If estrangement or aversion arises between them, he may not divorce her, but must wait a full year, so that perhaps the fragrance of love may spread between them. If the year is completed and that fragrance has not spread, there is no objection to divorce. He is wise in all things. In a Tablet inscribed by the Pen of Command, God has forbidden you what you formerly practiced after three divorces, as a favor from Him, so that you may be thankful. A man who has divorced his wife may choose to return to her at the end of any month, with affection and mutual consent, as long as she has not remarried. If she has remarried, their separation is confirmed by another union, and the matter is settled, unless a manifest change occurs. Thus has the decree been inscribed with majesty by the Dawning-Place of Beauty in the Tablet of Glory.

70

و الّذی سافر و سافرت معه ثمّ حدث بینهما الاختلاف فله ان یؤتیها نفقة سنة کاملة و یرجعها الی المقرّ الّذی خرجت عنه او یسلّمها بید امین و ما تحتاج به فی السّبیل لیبلّغها الی محلّها انّ ربّک یحکم کیف یشآء بسلطان کان علی العالمین محیطا

Wa-alladhī sāfara wa-sāfarat maʿahu thumma ḥadatha baynahumā al-ikhtilāf fa-lahu an yuʾtiyahā nafaqat sana kāmila wa-yurjiʿahā ilā al-maqarr alladhī kharajat ʿanhu aw yusallimahā bi-yad amīn wa-mā taḥtāju bihi fī al-sabīl li-yuballighahā ilā maḥallihā inna rabbaka yaḥkum kayfa yashāʾ bi-sulṭān kāna ʿalā al-ʿālamīn muḥīṭan.

If a man travels and his wife travels with him, and disagreement then arises between them, he must provide her with maintenance for a full year and return her to the place from which she departed, or entrust her to a trustworthy person, together with whatever she needs for the journey, to convey her to her home. Your Lord decrees as He wills, with an authority encompassing all the worlds.

71

و الّتی طلّقت بما ثبت علیها منکر لا نفقة لها ایّام تربّصها کذلک کان نیّر الأمر من افق العدل مشهودا انّ اللّه احبّ الوصل و الوفاق و ابغض الفصل و الطّلاق عاشروا یا قوم بالرّوح و الرّیحان لعمری سیفنی من فی الامکان و ما یبقی هو العمل الطّیّب و کان اللّه علی ما اقول شهیدا یا عبادی اصلحوا ذات بینکم ثمّ استمعوا ما ینصحکم به القلم الأعلی و لا تتّبعوا جبّاراً شقیا

Wa-allatī ṭulliqat bi-mā thabata ʿalayhā munkar lā nafaqa lahā ayyām tarabbuṣihā kadhālika kāna nayyir al-amr min ufuq al-ʿadl mashhūdan. Inna Allāh aḥabba al-waṣl wa-al-wifāq wa-abghaḍa al-faṣl wa-al-ṭalāq. ʿĀshirū yā qawm bi-al-rūḥ wa-al-rayḥān la-ʿamrī sa-yafnā man fī al-imkān wa-mā yabqā huwa al-ʿamal al-ṭayyib wa-kāna Allāh ʿalā mā aqūl shahīdan. Yā ʿibādī aṣliḥū dhāta baynikum thumma istamiʿū mā yanṣaḥukum bihi al-qalam al-aʿlā wa-lā tattabiʿū jabbāran shaqiyyan.

A woman divorced because of proven misconduct has no right to maintenance during her waiting period. Thus has the Sun of the Cause appeared above the horizon of justice. God loves union and harmony and detests separation and divorce. Associate with one another, O people, in joy and gladness. By My life, all who exist will pass away; what remains is the good deed. God bears witness to what I say. O My servants, set right your relations with one another, then listen to the counsel of the Most Exalted Pen, and do not follow any wretched tyrant.

72

ایّاکم ان تغرّنکم الدّنیا کما غرّت قوماً قبلکم اتّبعوا حدود اللّه و سننه ثمّ اسلکوا هذا الصّراط الّذی کان بالحقّ ممدوداً انّ الّذین نبذوا البغی و الغوی و اتّخذوا التّقوی اولئک من خیرة الخلق لدی الحقّ یذکرهم الملأ الأعلی و اهل هذا المقام الّذی کان باسم اللّه مرفوعاً

Iyyākum an taghurrannakum al-dunyā kamā gharrat qawman qablakum. Ittabiʿū ḥudūd Allāh wa-sunanahu thumma uslukū hādhā al-ṣirāṭ alladhī kāna bi-al-ḥaqq mamdūdan. Inna alladhīna nabadhū al-baghy wa-al-ghawā wa-ittakhadhū al-taqwā ulāʾika min khīrat al-khalq ladā al-ḥaqq yadhkuruhum al-malaʾ al-aʿlā wa-ahl hādhā al-maqām alladhī kāna bi-ism Allāh marfūʿan.

Beware lest the world deceive you as it deceived people before you. Follow God’s ordinances and laws, and walk this path that has been laid out in truth. Those who cast aside wrongdoing and waywardness and embrace reverence for God are among the finest of His creatures in the sight of the True One. The Concourse on high remembers them, as do the inhabitants of this station that has been exalted in God’s name.

73

قد حرّم علیکم بیع الامآء و الغلمان لیس لعبد ان یشتری عبداً نهیاً فی لوح اللّه کذلک کان الأمر من قلم العدل بالفضل مسطورا و لیس لأحد ان یفتخر علی احد کلّ ارقّاء له و ادلاّء علی انّه لا اله الاّ هو انّه کان علی کلّ شئ حکیما

Qad ḥurrima ʿalaykum bayʿ al-imāʾ wa-al-ghilmān laysa li-ʿabd an yashtarī ʿabdan nahyan fī lawḥ Allāh kadhālika kāna al-amr min qalam al-ʿadl bi-al-faḍl masṭūran. Wa-laysa li-aḥad an yaftakhira ʿalā aḥad kull ariqqāʾ lahu wa-adillāʾ ʿalā annahu lā ilāha illā huwa innahu kāna ʿalā kull shayʾ ḥakīman.

You are forbidden to sell female or male slaves. No person may buy another person: this is prohibited in the Tablet of God. Thus has the decree been graciously inscribed by the Pen of Justice. No one may exalt himself above another. All are His bondservants and bear witness that there is no God but Him. He is wise in all things.

74

زینوا انفسکم بطراز الأعمال و الّذی فاز بالعمل فی رضاه انّه من اهل البهآء قد کان لدی العرش مذکوراً انصروا مالک البریة بالأعمال الحسنة ثمّ بالحکمة و البیان کذلک امرتم فی اکثر الألواح من لدی الرّحمن انّه کان علی ما اقول علیماً لا یعترض احد علی احد و لا یقتل نفس نفساً هذا ما نهیتم عنه فی کتاب کان فی سرادق العزّ مستورا اتقتلون من احیاه اللّه بروح من عنده انّ هذا خطأ قد کان لدی العرش کبیرا اتّقوا اللّه و لا تخربوا ما بناه اللّه بأیادی الظّلم و الطّغیان ثمّ اتّخذوا الی الحقّ سبیلا لما ظهرت جنود العرفان برایات البیان انهزمت قبائل الادیان الاّ من اراد ان یشرب کوثر الحیوان فی رضوانٍ کان من نفس السّبحان موجودا

Zayyinū anfusakum bi-ṭirāz al-aʿmāl wa-alladhī fāza bi-al-ʿamal fī riḍāhu innahu min ahl al-bahāʾ qad kāna ladā al-ʿarsh madhkūran. Unṣurū mālik al-bariyya bi-al-aʿmāl al-ḥasana thumma bi-al-ḥikma wa-al-bayān kadhālika umirtum fī akthar al-alwāḥ min ladā al-raḥmān innahu kāna ʿalā mā aqūl ʿalīman. Lā yaʿtariḍ aḥad ʿalā aḥad wa-lā yaqtul nafs nafsan hādhā mā nuhītum ʿanhu fī kitāb kāna fī surādiq al-ʿizz mastūran. A-taqtulūna man aḥyāhu Allāh bi-rūḥ min ʿindihi inna hādhā khaṭaʾ qad kāna ladā al-ʿarsh kabīran. Ittaqū Allāh wa-lā tukhribū mā banāhu Allāh bi-ayādī al-ẓulm wa-al-ṭughyān thumma ittakhidhū ilā al-ḥaqq sabīlan. Lammā ẓaharat junūd al-ʿirfān bi-rāyāt al-bayān inhazamat qabāʾil al-adyān illā man arāda an yashraba kawthar al-ḥayawān fī riḍwān kāna min nafs al-subḥān mawjūdan.

Adorn yourselves with the ornament of deeds. Whoever succeeds in acting according to His good pleasure is numbered among the people of Baha before the Throne. Aid the Lord of creation through good deeds, and through wisdom and utterance. Thus have you been commanded in most of the Tablets by the All-Merciful. He knows what I say. Let no one contend with another, and let no person kill another. This is what you have been forbidden in a Book concealed within the pavilion of majesty. Would you kill someone whom God has brought to life through a spirit from Him? This is a grievous wrong before the Throne. Fear God, and do not destroy with the hands of oppression and tyranny what God has built. Take a path toward the True One. When the hosts of understanding appeared with the banners of utterance, the tribes of the religions were put to flight, except those who wished to drink from the river of life in a paradise brought into being by the All-Glorious Himself.

75

قد حکم اللّه بالطّهارة علی مآء النّطفة رحمةً من عنده علی البریة اشکروه بالرّوح و الرّیحان و لا تتّبعوا من کان عن مطلع القرب بعیدا قوموا علی خدمة الأمر فی کلّ الأحوال انّه یؤیّدکم بسلطان کان علی العالمین محیطا تمسّکوا بحبل اللّطافة علی شأن لا یری من ثیابکم اآار الأوساخ هذا ما حکم به من کان الطف من کلّ لطیف و الّذی له عذر لا بأس علیه انّه لهو الغفور الرّحیم طهّروا کلّ مکروه بالمآء الّذی لم یتغیر بالثلٰث ایّاکم ان تستعملوا المآء الّذی تغیر بالهوآء او بشئ آخر کونوا عنصر اللّطافة بین البریّة هذا ما اراد لکم مولاکم العزیز الحکیم

Qad ḥakama Allāh bi-al-ṭahāra ʿalā māʾ al-nuṭfa raḥmatan min ʿindihi ʿalā al-bariyya ushkurūhu bi-al-rūḥ wa-al-rayḥān wa-lā tattabiʿū man kāna ʿan maṭlaʿ al-qurb baʿīdan. Qūmū ʿalā khidmat al-amr fī kull al-aḥwāl innahu yuʾayyidukum bi-sulṭān kāna ʿalā al-ʿālamīn muḥīṭan. Tamassakū bi-ḥabl al-laṭāfa ʿalā shaʾn lā yurā min thiyābikum [corrupted text] al-awsākh hādhā mā ḥakama bihi man kāna alṭaf min kull laṭīf wa-alladhī lahu ʿudhr lā baʾs ʿalayhi innahu la-huwa al-ghafūr al-raḥīm. Ṭahhirū kull makrūh bi-al-māʾ alladhī lam yataghayyar bi-al-thalāth iyyākum an tastaʿmilū al-māʾ alladhī taghayyara bi-al-hawāʾ aw bi-shayʾ ākhar kūnū ʿunṣur al-laṭāfa bayna al-bariyya hādhā mā arāda lakum mawlākum al-ʿazīz al-ḥakīm.

God has decreed that semen is pure, as a mercy from Him to His creatures. Thank Him with joy and gladness, and do not follow those who are far from the Dawning-Place of Nearness. Arise to serve the Cause under all circumstances. He will support you with an authority encompassing all the worlds. Hold fast to the cord of cleanliness, so that no [corrupted original text] of dirt may be seen on your clothes. This is what He who is more refined than all who possess refinement has decreed. Whoever has an excuse incurs no blame. He is indeed the Ever-Forgiving, the Merciful. Cleanse every unclean thing with water that has not undergone any of the three changes. Beware of using water that has been altered by the air or by anything else. Be the embodiment of cleanliness among creation. This is what your Lord, the Almighty, the All-Wise, desires for you.

76

و کذلک رفع اللّه حکم دون الطّهارة عن کلّ الأشیاء و عن مللٍ اخری موهبة من اللّه انّه لهو الغفور الکریم قد انغمست الأشیآء فی بحر الطّهارة فی اوّل الرّضوان اذ تجلّینا علی من فی الامکان باسمآئنا الحسنی و صفاتنا العلیا هذا من فضلی الّذی احاط العالمین لتعاشروا مع الأدیان و تبلّغوا امر ربّکم الرّحمن هذا لاکلیل الاعمال لو انتم من العارفین

Wa-kadhālika rafaʿa Allāh ḥukm dūn al-ṭahāra ʿan kull al-ashyāʾ wa-ʿan milal ukhrā mawhiba min Allāh innahu la-huwa al-ghafūr al-karīm. Qad inghamasat al-ashyāʾ fī baḥr al-ṭahāra fī awwal al-riḍwān idh tajallaynā ʿalā man fī al-imkān bi-asmāʾinā al-ḥusnā wa-ṣifātinā al-ʿulyā hādhā min faḍlī alladhī aḥāṭa al-ʿālamīn li-tuʿāshirū maʿa al-adyān wa-tuballighū amr rabbikum al-raḥmān hādhā la-iklīl al-aʿmāl law antum min al-ʿārifīn.

Likewise, God has removed the designation of impurity from all things and from other religious communities, as a gift from God. He is indeed the Ever-Forgiving, the Generous. All things were immersed in the sea of purity on the first day of Ridvan, when We revealed Our splendor to all who exist through Our most beautiful names and Our most exalted attributes. This is from My grace, which encompasses all the worlds, so that you may associate with the followers of other religions and convey the Cause of your Lord, the All-Merciful. This is indeed the crown of deeds, if you are among those who understand.

77

و حکم باللّطافة الکبری و تغسیل ما تغبّر من الغبار و کیف الأوساخ المنجمدة و دونها اتّقوا اللّه و کونوا من المطهّرین و الّذی یری فی کسائه وسخ انّه لا یصعد دعائه الی اللّه و یجتنب عنه ملأ عالون استعملوا مآء الورد ثمّ العطر الخالص هذا ما احبّه اللّه من الأوّل الّذی لا اوّل له لیتضوّع منکم ما اراد ربّکم العزیز الحکیم

Wa-ḥakama bi-al-laṭāfa al-kubrā wa-taghsīl mā taghabbara min al-ghubār wa-kayfa al-awsākh al-munjamida wa-dūnihā ittaqū Allāh wa-kūnū min al-muṭahhirīn. Wa-alladhī yarā fī kisāʾihi wasakh innahu lā yaṣʿadu duʿāʾuhu ilā Allāh wa-yajtanibu ʿanhu malaʾ ʿālūn. Istaʿmilū māʾ al-ward thumma al-ʿiṭr al-khāliṣ hādhā mā aḥabbahu Allāh min al-awwal alladhī lā awwala lahu li-yataḍawwaʿa minkum mā arāda rabbukum al-ʿazīz al-ḥakīm.

He has decreed the utmost cleanliness and the washing of whatever has gathered dust—how much more, then, encrusted dirt and other impurities. Fear God and be among those who keep themselves pure. Whoever has visible dirt on his clothing, his prayer does not ascend to God, and the exalted Concourse shuns him. Use rosewater and pure perfume. This is what God has loved from the beginning that has no beginning, so that the fragrance your Lord, the Almighty, the All-Wise, desires may spread from you.

78

قد عفا اللّه عنکم ما نزّل فی البیان من محو الکتب و اذّناکم بان تقرؤوا من العلوم ما ینفعکم لا ما ینتهی الی المجادلة فی الکلام هذا خیر لکم ان انتم من العارفین

Qad ʿafā Allāh ʿankum mā nuzzila fī al-bayān min maḥw al-kutub wa-adhinnākum bi-an taqraʾū min al-ʿulūm mā yanfaʿukum lā mā yantahī ilā al-mujādala fī al-kalām hādhā khayr lakum in antum min al-ʿārifīn.

God has released you from the command revealed in the Bayan to destroy books. We have permitted you to study those branches of knowledge that benefit you, not those that end in verbal disputation. This is better for you, if you are among those who understand.

79

یا معشر الملوک قد اتی المالک و الملک للّه المهیمن القیّوم الاّ تعبدوا الاّ اللّه و توجّهوا بقلوب نوراء الی وجه ربّکم مالک الأسمآء هذا امر لا یعادله ما عندکم لو انتم تعرفون

Yā maʿshar al-mulūk, qad atā al-Mālik wa-l-mulk li-llāh al-Muhaymin al-Qayyūm. Allā taʿbudū illā Allāh wa-tawajjahū bi-qulūb nūrāʾ ilā wajh rabbikum Mālik al-Asmāʾ. Hādhā amr lā yuʿādiluhu mā ʿindakum law antum taʿrifūn.

O kings, the Sovereign has come, and sovereignty belongs to God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting. Worship none but God, and turn with radiant hearts toward the face of your Lord, the Lord of Names. This is a Cause that nothing you possess can equal, if only you understood.

80

انّا نریکم تفرحون بما جمعتموه لغیرکم و تمنعون انفسکم عن العوالم الّتی لم یحصها الاّ لوحی المحفوظ قد شغلتکم الأموال عن المأل هذا لا ینبغی لکم لو انتم تعلمون طهّروا قلوبکم عن ذفر الدّنیا مسرعین الی ملکوت ربّکم فاطر الأرض و السّمآء الّذی به ظهرت الزّلازل و ناحت القبائل الاّ من نبذ الوری و اخذ ما امر به فی لوح مکنون

Innā narākum tafraḥūn bi-mā jamaʿtumūhu li-ghayrikum wa-tamnaʿūn anfusakum ʿan al-ʿawālim allatī lam yuḥṣihā illā lawḥī al-maḥfūẓ. Qad shaghalatkum al-amwāl ʿan al-maʾāl. Hādhā lā yanbaghī lakum law antum taʿlamūn. Ṭahhirū qulūbakum ʿan dhafar al-dunyā musriʿīn ilā malakūt rabbikum Fāṭir al-arḍ wa-l-samāʾ alladhī bihi ẓaharat al-zalāzil wa-nāḥat al-qabāʾil illā man nabadha al-warā wa-akhadha mā umira bihi fī lawḥ maknūn.

We see you rejoicing in what you have amassed for others, while depriving yourselves of worlds that none but My preserved Tablet has numbered. Your wealth has distracted you from your final destination. This does not befit you, if only you knew. Cleanse your hearts of the stench of this world, hastening toward the kingdom of your Lord, the Creator of earth and heaven, through whom earthquakes have appeared and the peoples have lamented, except those who have cast aside all creation and embraced what they were commanded in a hidden Tablet.

81

هذا یوم فیه فاز الکلیم بانوار القدیم و شرب زلال الوصال من هذا القدح الّذی به سجّرت البحور قل تاللّه الحقّ انّ الطّور یطوف حول مطلع الظّهور و الرّوح ینادی من الملکوت هلّموا و تعالوا یا ابنآء الغرور هذا یوم فیه سرع کوم اللّه شوقا للقائه و صاح الصّهیون قد اتی الوعد و ظهر ما هو المکتوب فی الواح اللّه المتعالی العزیز المحبوب

Hādhā yawm fīhi fāza al-Kalīm bi-anwār al-Qadīm wa-shariba zulāl al-wiṣāl min hādhā al-qadaḥ alladhī bihi sujjirat al-buḥūr. Qul ta-llāh al-Ḥaqq inna al-Ṭūr yaṭūf ḥawla maṭlaʿ al-ẓuhūr wa-l-Rūḥ yunādī min al-malakūt halummū wa-taʿālaw yā abnāʾ al-ghurūr. Hādhā yawm fīhi saraʿa kawm Allāh shawqan li-liqāʾihi wa-ṣāḥa al-Ṣahyūn qad atā al-waʿd wa-ẓahara mā huwa al-maktūb fī alwāḥ Allāh al-Mutaʿālī al-ʿAzīz al-Maḥbūb.

This is the day when the One Who Conversed with God attained the lights of the Ancient One and drank the pure water of reunion from this cup through which the seas were set ablaze. Say: By God, the Truth! Sinai circles around the Dayspring of Revelation, and the Spirit calls from the kingdom: “Come, draw near, you children of delusion!” This is the day when the hill of God has hastened in longing to meet Him, and Zion has cried out: “The promise has come, and what was written in the Tablets of God, the Most Exalted, the Almighty, the Beloved, has appeared.”

82

یا معشر الملوک قد نزّل النّاموس الأکبر فی المنظر الأنور و ظهر کل امر مستتر من لدن مالک القدر الّذی به اتت السّاعة و انشقّ القمر و فصّل کلّ امر محتوم

Yā maʿshar al-mulūk, qad nuzzila al-nāmūs al-akbar fī al-manẓar al-anwar wa-ẓahara kull amr mustatir min ladun Mālik al-qadar alladhī bihi atat al-sāʿa wa-nshaqqa al-qamar wa-fuṣṣila kull amr maḥtūm.

O kings, the Most Great Law has been sent down in the most radiant Vision, and every hidden matter has been revealed by the Lord of Destiny, through whom the Hour has come, the moon has split, and every irrevocable decree has been set forth.

83

یا معشر الملوک انتم الممالیک قد ظهر المالک بأحسن الطّراز و یدعوکم الی نفسه المهیمن القیّوم ایّاکم ان یمنعکم الغرور عن مشرق الظّهور او تحجبکم الدّنیا عن فاطر السّمآء قوموا علی خدمة المقصود الّذی خلقکم بکلمة من عنده و جعلکم مظاهر القدرة لما کان و ما یکون

Yā maʿshar al-mulūk, antum al-mamālīk. Qad ẓahara al-Mālik bi-aḥsan al-ṭirāz wa-yadʿūkum ilā nafsihi al-Muhaymin al-Qayyūm. Iyyākum an yamnaʿakum al-ghurūr ʿan mashriq al-ẓuhūr aw taḥjubakum al-dunyā ʿan Fāṭir al-samāʾ. Qūmū ʿalā khidmat al-Maqṣūd alladhī khalaqakum bi-kalima min ʿindihi wa-jaʿalakum maẓāhir al-qudra li-mā kāna wa-mā yakūn.

O kings, you are but servants. The Sovereign has appeared in the finest adornment and calls you to Himself, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting. Beware lest pride keep you from the Dawning-Place of Revelation, or the world veil you from the Creator of heaven. Arise to serve the Desired One, who created you through a word from Him and made you manifestations of power over all that has been and all that will be.

84

تاللّه لا نرید ان نتصرّف فی ممالککم بل جئنا لتصرّف القلوب انّها لمنظر البهآء یشهد بذلک ملکوت الأسمآء لو انتم تفقهون و الّذی اتّبع مولاه انّه اعرض عن الدّنیا کلّها و کیف هذا المقام المحمود دعوا البیوت ثمّ اقبلوا الی الملکوت هذا ما ینفعکم فی الآخرة و الأولی یشهد بذلک مالک الجبروت لو انتم تعلمون

Ta-llāh lā nurīd an nataṣarraf fī mamālikikum bal jiʾnā li-taṣarruf al-qulūb. Innahā la-manẓar al-Bahāʾ yashhadu bi-dhālika malakūt al-asmāʾ law antum tafqahūn. Wa-lladhī ittabaʿa mawlāhu innahu aʿraḍa ʿan al-dunyā kullihā wa-kayfa hādhā al-maqām al-maḥmūd. Daʿū al-buyūt thumma aqbilū ilā al-malakūt. Hādhā mā yanfaʿukum fī al-ākhira wa-l-ūlā yashhadu bi-dhālika Mālik al-jabarūt law antum taʿlamūn.

By God! We do not wish to take possession of your kingdoms; rather, We have come to take possession of hearts. They are indeed the place where Bahá is revealed; the kingdom of names bears witness to this, if only you understood. Whoever has followed his Lord has turned away from the whole world—how much more so in this praiseworthy station! Leave your houses and turn toward the kingdom. This is what will benefit you in the next life and in this one. The Lord of the realm of power bears witness to this, if only you knew.

85

طوبی لملک قام علی نصرة امری فی مملکتی و انقطع عن سوائی انّه من اصحاب السّفینة الحمرآء التی جعلها اللّه لأهل البهآء ینبغی لکلٍ ان یعزّزوه و یوقّروه و ینصروه لیفتح المدن بمفاتیح اسمی المهیمن علی من فی ممالک الغیب و الشّهود انّه بمنزلة البَصَر للبشر و الغرّة الغرآء لجبین الانشآء و رأس الکرم لجسد العالم انصروه یا اهل البهآء بالأموال و النّفوس

Ṭūbā li-malik qāma ʿalā nuṣrat amrī fī mamlakatī wa-nqaṭaʿa ʿan siwāʾī. Innahu min aṣḥāb al-safīna al-ḥamrāʾ allatī jaʿalahā Allāh li-ahl al-Bahāʾ. Yanbaghī li-kull an yuʿazzizūhu wa-yuwaqqirūhu wa-yanṣurūhu li-yaftaḥ al-mudun bi-mafātīḥ ismī al-Muhaymin ʿalā man fī mamālik al-ghayb wa-l-shuhūd. Innahu bi-manzilat al-baṣar li-l-bashar wa-l-ghurra al-gharrāʾ li-jabīn al-inshāʾ wa-raʾs al-karam li-jasad al-ʿālam. Unṣurūhu yā ahl al-Bahāʾ bi-l-amwāl wa-l-nufūs.

Blessed is the king who arises to aid My Cause in My kingdom and detaches himself from all but Me. He is among the companions of the Crimson Ark that God has ordained for the people of Bahá. Everyone should honor, revere, and support him, so that he may open the cities with the keys of My name, the All-Protecting over all who dwell in the kingdoms of the unseen and the seen. He is as sight to humanity, a radiant adornment on the brow of creation, and the head of generosity to the body of the world. Support him, O people of Bahá, with your wealth and your lives.

86

یا ملک النّمسة کان مطلع نور الأحدیّة فی سجن عکّآء اذ قصدت المسجد الأقصی مررت و ما سئلت عنه بعد اذ رفع به کلّ بیت و فتح کلّ باب منیف قد جعلناه مقبل العالم لذکری و انت نبذت المذکور اذ ظهر بملکوت اللّه ربّک و ربّ العالمین کنّا معک فی کلّ الأحوال و وجدناک متمسّکا بالفرع غافلا عن الأصل انّ ربّک علی ما اقول شهید قد اخذتنا الأحزان بما رأیناک تدور لاسمنا و لا تعرفنا امام وجهک افتح البصر لتنظر هذا المنظر الکریم و تعرف من تدعوه فی اللّیالی و الأیّام و تری النّور المشرق من هذا الأفق اللّمیع

Yā malik al-Nimsa, kāna maṭlaʿ nūr al-aḥadiyya fī sijn ʿAkkā idh qaṣadta al-masjid al-aqṣā. Mararta wa-mā saʾalta ʿanhu baʿda idh rufiʿa bihi kull bayt wa-futiḥa kull bāb munīf. Qad jaʿalnāhu muqbil al-ʿālam li-dhikrī wa-anta nabadhta al-madhkūr idh ẓahara bi-malakūt Allāh rabbika wa-rabb al-ʿālamīn. Kunnā maʿaka fī kull al-aḥwāl wa-wajadnāka mutamassikan bi-l-farʿ ghāfilan ʿan al-aṣl. Inna rabbaka ʿalā mā aqūl shahīd. Qad akhadhatnā al-aḥzān bi-mā raʾaynāka tadūr li-sminā wa-lā taʿrifunā amāma wajhika. Iftaḥ al-baṣar li-tanẓur hādhā al-manẓar al-karīm wa-taʿrif man tadʿūhu fī al-layālī wa-l-ayyām wa-tarā al-nūr al-mushriq min hādhā al-ufuq al-lamīʿ.

O king of Austria, the Dayspring of the light of oneness was in the prison of Acre when you set out for the Farthest Mosque. You passed by without asking about Him, through whom every house has been exalted and every lofty gate opened. We made it the place toward which the world turns to remember Me, yet you cast aside the One remembered when He appeared with the kingdom of God, your Lord and the Lord of all worlds. We were with you in every circumstance and found you clinging to the branch, heedless of the root. Your Lord bears witness to what I say. Sorrow seized Us when We saw you journeying for the sake of Our name, yet failing to recognize Us before your very eyes. Open your eyes to behold this noble Vision, recognize the One you invoke by night and day, and see the light shining from this radiant horizon.

87

قل یا ملک برلین اسمع النّدآء من هذا الهیکل المبین انّه لا اله الاّ انا الباقی الفرد القدیم ایّاک ان یمنعک الغرور عن مطلع الظّهور او یحجبک الهوی عن مالک العرش و الثّری کذلک ینصحک القلم الأعلی انّه لهو الفضّال الکریم اذکر من کان اعظم منک شأنا و اکبر منک مقاماً این هو و ما عنده انتبه و لا تکن من الرّاقدین انّه نبذ لوح اللّه ورائه اذ اخبرناه بما ورد علینا من جنود الظّالمین لذا اخذته الذّلّة من کلّ الجهات الی ان رجع الی التّراب خسران عظیم یا ملک تفکّر فیه و فی امثالک الّذین سخّروا البلاد و حکموا علی العباد قد انزلهم الرّحمن من القصور الی القبور اعتبر و کن من المتذکّرین

Qul yā malik Birlīn, ismaʿ al-nidāʾ min hādhā al-haykal al-mubīn. Innahu lā ilāha illā anā al-Bāqī al-Fard al-Qadīm. Iyyāka an yamnaʿaka al-ghurūr ʿan maṭlaʿ al-ẓuhūr aw yaḥjubaka al-hawā ʿan Mālik al-ʿarsh wa-l-tharā. Kadhālika yanṣaḥuka al-Qalam al-Aʿlā innahu la-huwa al-Faḍḍāl al-Karīm. Udhkur man kāna aʿẓam minka shaʾnan wa-akbar minka maqāman. Ayna huwa wa-mā ʿindahu? Intabih wa-lā takun min al-rāqidīn. Innahu nabadha lawḥ Allāh warāʾahu idh akhbarnāhu bi-mā warada ʿalaynā min junūd al-ẓālimīn. Li-dhā akhadhat-hu al-dhilla min kull al-jihāt ilā an rajaʿa ilā al-turāb. Khusrān ʿaẓīm. Yā malik tafakkar fīhi wa-fī amthālika alladhīna sakhkharū al-bilād wa-ḥakamū ʿalā al-ʿibād. Qad anzalahum al-Raḥmān min al-quṣūr ilā al-qubūr. Iʿtabir wa-kun min al-mutadhakkirīn.

Say: O king of Berlin, hear the call from this manifest Temple: “There is no god but Me, the Everlasting, the One, the Ancient.” Beware lest pride keep you from the Dayspring of Revelation, or desire veil you from the Lord of the throne and the earth. Thus the Most Exalted Pen counsels you. He is indeed the Most Bountiful, the Generous. Remember the one who was greater than you in power and higher than you in station. Where is he, and where is all he possessed? Awaken, and do not be among those who sleep. He cast the Tablet of God behind him when We told him what had befallen Us at the hands of the armies of the oppressors. Therefore humiliation overtook him from every side, until he returned to dust. What a tremendous loss! O king, reflect on him and on those like you who subdued lands and ruled over their peoples. The All-Merciful brought them down from palaces to graves. Take heed, and be among those who remember.

88

انّا ما اردنا منکم شیئا انّما ننصحکم لوجه اللّه و نصبر کما صبرنا بما وردعلینا منکم یا معشر السّلاطین

Innā mā aradnā minkum shayʾan innamā nanṣaḥukum li-wajh Allāh wa-naṣbir kamā ṣabarnā bi-mā warada ʿalaynā minkum yā maʿshar al-salāṭīn.

We have desired nothing from you. We counsel you only for the sake of God, and We endure patiently, as We have endured what you have inflicted on Us, O sovereigns.

89

یا ملوک امریقا و رؤسآء الجمهور فیها اسمعوا ما تغنّ به الورقآء علی غصن البقآء انّه لا اله الاّ انا الباقی الغفور الکریم زیّنوا هیکل الملک بطراز العدل و التّقی و رأسه باکلیل ذکر ربّکم فاطر السّمآء کذلک یأمرکم مطلع الأسمآء من لدن علیمٍ حکیمٍ قد ظهر الموعود فی هذا المقام المحمود الّذی به ابتسم ثغر الوجود من الغیب و الشّهود اغتنموا یوم اللّه انّ لقائه خیر لکم عمّا تطلع الشّمس علیها ان انتم من العارفین یا معشر الأمرآء اسمعوا ما ارتفع من مطلع الکبریآء انّه لا اله الاّ انا النّاطق العلیم اجبروا الکسیر بایادی العدل و کسّروا الصّحیح الظّالم بسیاط اوامر ربّکم الأمر الحکیم

Yā mulūk Amrīqā wa-ruʾasāʾ al-jumhūr fīhā, ismaʿū mā taghann bihi al-warqāʾ ʿalā ghuṣn al-baqāʾ. Innahu lā ilāha illā anā al-Bāqī al-Ghafūr al-Karīm. Zayyinū haykal al-mulk bi-ṭirāz al-ʿadl wa-l-tuqā wa-raʾsahu bi-iklīl dhikr rabbikum Fāṭir al-samāʾ. Kadhālika yaʾmurukum maṭlaʿ al-asmāʾ min ladun ʿAlīm Ḥakīm. Qad ẓahara al-Mawʿūd fī hādhā al-maqām al-maḥmūd alladhī bihi ibtasama thaghr al-wujūd min al-ghayb wa-l-shuhūd. Ightanimū yawm Allāh inna liqāʾahu khayr lakum ʿammā taṭluʿ al-shams ʿalayhā in antum min al-ʿārifīn. Yā maʿshar al-umarāʾ, ismaʿū mā irtafaʿa min maṭlaʿ al-kibriyāʾ. Innahu lā ilāha illā anā al-Nāṭiq al-ʿAlīm. Ijburū al-kasīr bi-ayādī al-ʿadl wa-kassirū al-ṣaḥīḥ al-ẓālim bi-siyāṭ awāmir rabbikum al-Āmir al-Ḥakīm.

O kings of America and presidents of its republics, listen to what the Dove sings upon the branch of eternity: “There is no god but Me, the Everlasting, the All-Forgiving, the Generous.” Adorn the body of sovereignty with justice and piety, and its head with the crown of remembrance of your Lord, the Creator of heaven. Thus the Dayspring of Names commands you on behalf of One who is All-Knowing, All-Wise. The Promised One has appeared in this praiseworthy station, through which all existence, unseen and seen, has smiled. Seize the opportunity of the Day of God. Meeting Him is better for you than all that the sun shines upon, if you are among those who understand. O rulers, listen to what has risen from the Dayspring of Grandeur: “There is no god but Me, the Speaker, the All-Knowing.” Bind up the broken with the hands of justice, and break the oppressor who is unbroken with the scourges of the commands of your Lord, the Ordainer, the All-Wise.

90

یا معشر الرّوم نسمع بینکم صوت البوم ء اخذکم سکر الهوی ام کنتم من الغافلین یا ایتها النّقطة الواقعة فی شاطئ البحرین قد استقرّ علیک کرسیّ الظّلم و اشتعلت فیک نار البغضآء علی شأن ناح بها الملأ الأعلی و الّذین یطوفون حول کرسی رفیع نری فیک الجاهل یحکم علی العاقل و الظّلام یفتخر علی النّور و انّک فی غرور مبین اغرّتک زینتک الظّاهرة سوف تفنی و ربّ البریّة و تنوح البنات و الأرامل و ما فیک من القبائل کذلک ینبئک العلیم الخبیر

Yā maʿshar al-Rūm, nasmaʿ baynakum ṣawt al-būm. A-akhadhakum sukr al-hawā am kuntum min al-ghāfilīn? Yā ayyatuhā al-nuqṭa al-wāqiʿa fī shāṭiʾ al-baḥrayn, qad istaqarra ʿalayki kursī al-ẓulm wa-shtaʿalat fīki nār al-baghḍāʾ ʿalā shaʾn nāḥa bihā al-malaʾ al-aʿlā wa-lladhīna yaṭūfūn ḥawla kursī rafīʿ. Narā fīki al-jāhil yaḥkum ʿalā al-ʿāqil wa-l-ẓalām yaftakhir ʿalā al-nūr wa-innaki fī ghurūr mubīn. A-gharratki zīnatuki al-ẓāhira? Sawfa tafnā wa-rabb al-bariyya wa-tanūḥ al-banāt wa-l-arāmil wa-mā fīki min al-qabāʾil. Kadhālika yunabbiʾuki al-ʿAlīm al-Khabīr.

O people of Rūm, We hear the owl’s cry among you. Has the intoxication of desire seized you, or are you among the heedless? O spot situated on the shore of the two seas, the throne of oppression has been established upon you, and the fire of hatred has blazed within you so fiercely that the exalted Concourse and those who circle a lofty throne have lamented. We see the ignorant ruling over the wise within you, and darkness boasting over light. You are indeed in manifest delusion. Has your outward splendor deceived you? By the Lord of creation, it will perish, and the daughters, the widows, and all the peoples within you will lament. Thus the All-Knowing, the All-Aware informs you.

91

یا شواطی نهر الرّین قد رأیناک مغطّاة بالدّماء بما سلّ علیک سیوف الجزآء و لک مرّة اخری و نسمع حنین البرلین ولو انّها الیوم علی عزّ مبین

Yā shawāṭiʾ nahr al-Rayn, qad raʾaynāki mughaṭṭāt bi-l-dimāʾ bi-mā sulla ʿalayki suyūf al-jazāʾ wa-laki marra ukhrā wa-nasmaʿ ḥanīn al-Birlīn wa-law annahā al-yawm ʿalā ʿizz mubīn.

O banks of the Rhine, We have seen you covered in blood, for the swords of retribution have been drawn against you; and you will have another turn. We hear the lament of Berlin, though today she enjoys manifest glory.

92

یا ارض الطّآء لا تحزنی من شئ قد جعلک اللّه مطلع فرح العالمین لو یشآء یبارک سریرک بالّذی یحکم بالعدل و یجمع اغنام اللّه الّتی تفرّقت من الذّئاب انّه یواجه اهل البهآء بالفرح و الانبساط الا انّه من جوهر الخلق لدی الحقّ علیه بهآء اللّه و بهآء من فی ملکوت الأمر فی کلّ حین

Yā arḍ al-Ṭāʾ, lā taḥzanī min shayʾ. Qad jaʿalaki Allāh maṭlaʿ faraḥ al-ʿālamīn. Law yashāʾ yubārik sarīraki bi-lladhī yaḥkum bi-l-ʿadl wa-yajmaʿ aghnām Allāh allatī tafarraqat min al-dhiʾāb. Innahu yuwājih ahl al-Bahāʾ bi-l-faraḥ wa-l-inbisāṭ. Alā innahu min jawhar al-khalq ladā al-Ḥaqq. ʿAlayhi bahāʾ Allāh wa-bahāʾ man fī malakūt al-amr fī kull ḥīn.

O land of Ṭā, grieve over nothing. God has made you the dayspring of joy for all worlds. If He wills, He will bless your throne with one who rules with justice and gathers the sheep of God that have been scattered by the wolves. He will meet the people of Bahá with joy and warmth. Indeed, in the sight of the True One, he is among the choicest of creation. Upon him be the glory of God and the glory of all who dwell in the kingdom of His Cause at every moment.

93

افرحی بما جعلک اللّه افق النّور بما ولد فیک مطلع الظّهور و سمّیت بهذا الاسم الّذی به لاح نیّر الفضل و اشرقت السّموات و الأرضون

Ifraḥī bi-mā jaʿalaki Allāh ufuq al-nūr bi-mā wulida fīki maṭlaʿ al-ẓuhūr wa-summīti bi-hādhā al-ism alladhī bihi lāḥa nayyir al-faḍl wa-ashraqat al-samāwāt wa-l-araḍūn.

Rejoice that God has made you the horizon of light, for the Dayspring of Revelation was born within you, and you were called by this name through which the sun of grace has shone and the heavens and the earth have been illumined.

94

سوف تنقلب فیک الأمور و یحکم علیک جمهور النّاس انّ ربّک لهو العلیم المحیط اطمئنّی بفضل ربّک انّه لا تنقطع عنک لحظات الألطاف سوف یأخذک الاطمینان بعد الاضطراب کذلک قضی الأمر فی کتاب بدیع

Sawfa tanqalib fīki al-umūr wa-yaḥkum ʿalayki jumhūr al-nās. Inna rabbaki la-huwa al-ʿAlīm al-Muḥīṭ. Iṭmaʾinnī bi-faḍl rabbiki innahu lā tanqaṭiʿ ʿanki laḥaẓāt al-alṭāf. Sawfa yaʾkhudhuki al-iṭmiʾnān baʿda al-iḍṭirāb. Kadhālika quḍiya al-amr fī kitāb badīʿ.

Affairs within you will change, and the people will rule over you. Your Lord is indeed the All-Knowing, the All-Encompassing. Be assured of your Lord’s grace: His glances of favor toward you will not cease. Tranquillity will embrace you after turmoil. Thus has the matter been decreed in a wondrous Book.

95

یا ارض الخآء نسمع فیک صوت الرّجال فی ذکر ربّک الغنی المتّعال طوبی لیوم فیه تنصب رایات الأسمآء فی ملکوت الانشآء باسمی الأبهی یومئذ یفرح المخلصون بنصر اللّه و ینوح المشرکون

Yā arḍ al-Khāʾ, nasmaʿ fīki ṣawt al-rijāl fī dhikr rabbiki al-Ghanī al-Mutaʿāl. Ṭūbā li-yawm fīhi tunṣab rāyāt al-asmāʾ fī malakūt al-inshāʾ bi-smī al-Abhā. Yawmaʾidh yafraḥ al-mukhliṣūn bi-naṣr Allāh wa-yanūḥ al-mushrikūn.

O land of Khā, We hear within you the voices of men remembering your Lord, the Self-Sufficient, the Most Exalted. Blessed is the day when the banners of the names will be raised in the kingdom of creation through My name, the All-Glorious. On that day the sincere will rejoice in God’s victory, and those who associate partners with Him will lament.

96

لیس لأحد ان یعترض علی الّذین یحکمون علی العباد دعوا لهم ما عندهم و توجّهوا الی القلوب

Laysa li-aḥad an yaʿtariḍ ʿalā alladhīna yaḥkumūn ʿalā al-ʿibād. Daʿū lahum mā ʿindahum wa-tawajjahū ilā al-qulūb.

No one may oppose those who rule over the people. Leave to them what they possess, and turn your attention to hearts.

97

یا بحر الأعظم رشّ علی الأمم ما امرت به من لدن مالک القدم و زین هیاکل الأنام بطراز الأحکام الّتی بها تفرح القلوب و تقرّ العیون

Yā baḥr al-aʿẓam, rushsha ʿalā al-umam mā umirta bihi min ladun Mālik al-qidam wa-zayyin hayākil al-anām bi-ṭirāz al-aḥkām allatī bihā tafraḥ al-qulūb wa-taqarr al-ʿuyūn.

O Most Great Ocean, sprinkle upon the nations what you have been commanded by the Lord of Eternity, and adorn the bodies of humanity with the laws through which hearts rejoice and eyes find delight.

98

و الّذی تملّک مأة مثقال من الذّهب فتسعة عشر مثقالا للّه فاطر الأرض و السّمآء ایّاکم یا قوم ان تمنعوا انفسکم عن هذا الفضل العظیم قد امرناکم بهذا بعد اذ کنّا غنیا عنکم و عن کلّ من فی السّموات و الأرضین انّ فی ذلک لحکم و مصالح لم یحط بها علم احد الاّ اللّه العالم الخبیر قل بذلک اراد تطهیر اموالکم و تقرّبکم الی مقامات لا یدرکها الاّ من شاء اللّه انّه لهو الفضّال العزیز الکریم یا قوم لا تخونوا فی حقوق اللّه و لا تصرّفوا فیها الاّ بعد اذنه کذلک قضی الأمر فی الألواح و فی هذا اللّوح المنیع من خان اللّه یخان بالعدل و الّذی عمل بما امر ینزل علیه البرکة من سمآء عطآء ربّه الفیاض المعطی الباذل القدیم انّه اراد لکم ما لا تعرفونه الیوم سوف یعرفه القوم اذا طارت الأرواح و طویت زرابی الافراح کذلک یذکرکم من عنده لوح حفیظ

Wa-alladhī tamallaka miʾata mithqālin mina al-dhahabi fa-tisʿata ʿashara mithqālan li-llāhi fāṭiri al-arḍi wa-al-samāʾi. Iyyākum yā qawmi an tamnaʿū anfusakum ʿan hādhā al-faḍli al-ʿaẓīmi. Qad amarnākum bi-hādhā baʿda idh kunnā ghaniyyan ʿankum wa-ʿan kulli man fī al-samāwāti wa-al-araḍīna. Inna fī dhālika la-ḥikaman wa-maṣāliḥa lam yuḥiṭ bihā ʿilmu aḥadin illā Allāhu al-ʿālimu al-khabīru. Qul bi-dhālika arāda taṭhīra amwālikum wa-taqarrubakum ilā maqāmātin lā yudrikuhā illā man shāʾa Allāhu. Innahu la-huwa al-faḍḍālu al-ʿazīzu al-karīmu. Yā qawmi lā takhūnū fī ḥuqūqi Allāhi wa-lā taṣarrafū fīhā illā baʿda idhnihi. Kadhālika quḍiya al-amru fī al-alwāḥi wa-fī hādhā al-lawḥi al-manīʿi. Man khāna Allāha yukhānu bi-al-ʿadli wa-alladhī ʿamila bi-mā umira yanzilu ʿalayhi al-barakatu min samāʾi ʿaṭāʾi rabbihi al-fayyāḍi al-muʿṭī al-bādhili al-qadīmi. Innahu arāda lakum mā lā taʿrifūnahu al-yawma. Sawfa yaʿrifuhu al-qawmu idhā ṭārati al-arwāḥu wa-ṭuwiyat zarābiyyu al-afrāḥi. Kadhālika yudhakkirukum man ʿindahu lawḥun ḥafīẓun.

Whoever possesses a hundred mithqals of gold, nineteen mithqals of it belong to God, the Creator of earth and heaven. Take care, O people, not to deprive yourselves of this great bounty. We have commanded you to observe this, although We have always been independent of you and of all who are in the heavens and on earth. In this lie wisdom and benefits beyond the knowledge of anyone except God, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed. Say: By this He has intended to purify your possessions and bring you near to stations that none can comprehend except those whom God wills. He is indeed the Bountiful, the Almighty, the Generous. O people, do not act dishonestly concerning the Right of God, nor dispose of it without His permission. Thus has the command been decreed in the Tablets and in this exalted Tablet. Whoever betrays God will, in justice, be betrayed; and whoever acts as commanded will receive blessings from the heaven of the bounty of his Lord, the All-Bountiful, the Bestower, the Munificent, the Ancient. He has intended for you what you do not understand today. The people will understand it when their spirits take flight and the carpets of joy are rolled up. Thus does He who possesses a preserving Tablet admonish you.

99

قد حضرت لدی العرش عرائض شتّی من الّذین امنوا و سئلوا فیها اللّه ربّ ما یری و ما لا یری ربّ العالمین لذا نزّلنا اللّوح و زینّاه بطراز الأمر لعلّ النّاس باحکام ربّهم یعملون و کذلک سئلنا من قبل فی سنین متوالیات و امسکنا القلم حکمة من لدنّا الی ان حضرت کتب من انفسٍ معدودات فی تلک الأیّام لذا اجبناهم بالحقّ بما تحیی به القلوب

Qad ḥaḍarat ladā al-ʿarshi ʿarāʾiḍu shattā mina alladhīna āmanū wa-saʾalū fīhā Allāha rabba mā yurā wa-mā lā yurā rabba al-ʿālamīna. Lidhā nazzalnā al-lawḥa wa-zayyannāhu bi-ṭirāzi al-amri laʿalla al-nāsa bi-aḥkāmi rabbihim yaʿmalūna. Wa-kadhālika suʾilnā min qablu fī sinīna mutawāliyātin wa-amsaknā al-qalama ḥikmatan min ladunnā ilā an ḥaḍarat kutubun min anfusin maʿdūdātin fī tilka al-ayyāmi. Lidhā ajabnāhum bi-al-ḥaqqi bi-mā taḥyā bihi al-qulūbu.

Various petitions have reached the Throne from those who have believed, in which they have addressed questions to God, the Lord of the seen and the unseen, the Lord of all worlds. We have therefore sent down this Tablet and adorned it with the ornament of command, so that people may act according to the laws of their Lord. Likewise, We were questioned in previous years, one after another, but in Our wisdom We withheld the Pen until letters from a few individuals arrived in these days. We have therefore answered them in truth with that which brings hearts to life.

100

قل یا معشر العلمآء لا تزنوا کتاب اللّه بما عندکم من القواعد و العلوم انّه لقسطاس الحقّ بین الخلق قد یوزن ما عند الأمم بهذا القسطاس الأعظم و انّه بنفسه لو انتم تعلمون

Qul yā maʿshara al-ʿulamāʾi lā tazinū kitāba Allāhi bi-mā ʿindakum mina al-qawāʿidi wa-al-ʿulūmi. Innahu la-qisṭāsu al-ḥaqqi bayna al-khalqi. Qad yūzanu mā ʿinda al-umami bi-hādhā al-qisṭāsi al-aʿẓami wa-innahu bi-nafsihi law antum taʿlamūna.

Say: O assembly of scholars, do not weigh the Book of God by the rules and sciences you possess. It is the true balance among creation. Whatever the nations possess is weighed in this Most Great Balance, while it stands by itself, if only you knew.

101

تبکی علیکم عین عنایتی لانّکم ما عرفتم الّذی دعوتموه فی العشی و الاشراق و فی کلّ اصیلٍ و بکور توجّهوا یا قوم بوجوه بیضآء و قلوب نورآء الی البقعة المبارکة الحمرآء الّتی فیها تنادی سدرة المنتهی انّه لا اله الاّ انا المهیمن القیّوم

Tabkī ʿalaykum ʿaynu ʿināyatī li-annakum mā ʿaraftumu alladhī daʿawtumūhu fī al-ʿashiyyi wa-al-ishrāqi wa-fī kulli aṣīlin wa-bukūrin. Tawajjahū yā qawmi bi-wujūhin bayḍāʾa wa-qulūbin nawrāʾa ilā al-buqʿati al-mubārakati al-ḥamrāʾi allatī fīhā tunādī sidratu al-muntahā innahu lā ilāha illā anā al-muhayminu al-qayyūmu.

The eye of My loving care weeps over you, because you have not recognized the One you have called upon at evening and sunrise, and at every dusk and dawn. Turn, O people, with radiant faces and luminous hearts toward the blessed crimson Spot, where the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary calls out: “There is no God but Me, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting.”

102

یا معشر العلمآء هل یقدر احد منکم ان یستنّ معی فی میدان المکاشفة و العرفان او یجول فی مضمار الحکمة و التّبیان لا و ربّی الرّحمن کلّ من علیها فان و هذا وجه ربّکم العزیز المحبوب

Yā maʿshara al-ʿulamāʾi hal yaqdiru aḥadun minkum an yastanna maʿī fī maydāni al-mukāshafati wa-al-ʿirfāni aw yajūla fī miḍmāri al-ḥikmati wa-al-tibyāni. Lā wa-rabbī al-raḥmāni. Kullu man ʿalayhā fānin wa-hādhā wajhu rabbikumu al-ʿazīzi al-maḥbūbi.

O assembly of scholars, can any of you race with Me in the field of unveiling and recognition, or range over the arena of wisdom and exposition? No, by My Lord, the All-Merciful! Everyone on earth passes away, and this is the face of your Lord, the Almighty, the Beloved.

103

یا قوم انّا قدّرنا العلوم لعرفان المعلوم و انتم احتجبتم بها عن مشرقها الّذی به ظهر کلّ امر مکنون لو عرفتم الأفق الّذی منه اشرقت شمس الکلام لنبذتم الأنام و ما عندهم و اقبلتم الی المقام المحمود

Yā qawmi innā qaddarnā al-ʿulūma li-ʿirfāni al-maʿlūmi wa-antum iḥtajabtum bihā ʿan mashriqihā alladhī bihi ẓahara kullu amrin maknūnin. Law ʿaraftumu al-ufuqa alladhī minhu ashraqat shamsu al-kalāmi la-nabadhtumu al-anāma wa-mā ʿindahum wa-aqbaltum ilā al-maqāmi al-maḥmūdi.

O people, We ordained the sciences for the recognition of the One who is their object, yet you have allowed them to veil you from their dawning place, through whom every hidden thing has been revealed. Had you recognized the horizon from which the sun of utterance has risen, you would have cast aside humanity and all it possesses and turned toward the praiseworthy station.

104

قل هذه لسمآء فیها کنز امّ الکتاب لو انتم تعقلون هذا لهو الّذی به صاحت الصّخرة و نادت السّدرة علی الطّور المرتفع علی الأرض المبارکة الملک للّه الملک العزیز الودود

Qul hādhihi la-samāʾun fīhā kanzu ummi al-kitābi law antum taʿqilūna. Hādhā la-huwa alladhī bihi ṣāḥati al-ṣakhratu wa-nādati al-sidratu ʿalā al-ṭūri al-murtafiʿi ʿalā al-arḍi al-mubārakati al-mulku li-llāhi al-maliki al-ʿazīzi al-wadūdi.

Say: This is indeed a heaven in which lies the treasure of the Mother Book, if only you understood. This is the One through whom the Rock cried out and the Lote Tree proclaimed upon the Mount rising above the blessed land: “Sovereignty belongs to God, the King, the Almighty, the All-Loving.”

105

انّا ما دخلنا المدارس و ما طالعنا المباحث اسمعوا ما یدعوکم به هذا الأمی الی اللّه الأبدی انّه خیر لکم عمّا کنز فی الأرض لو انتم تفقهون

Innā mā dakhalnā al-madārisa wa-mā ṭālaʿnā al-mabāḥitha. Ismaʿū mā yadʿūkum bihi hādhā al-ummiyyu ilā Allāhi al-abadiyyi. Innahu khayrun lakum ʿammā kuniza fī al-arḍi law antum tafqahūna.

We have not entered schools or studied learned treatises. Listen to that with which this unlettered One calls you to God, the Eternal. It is better for you than all the treasures stored in the earth, if only you understood.

106

انّ الّذی یاوّل ما نزّل من سمآء الوحی و یخرجه عن الظّاهر انّه ممّن حرّف کلمة اللّه العلیا و کان من الأخسرین فی کتاب مبین

Inna alladhī yuʾawwilu mā nuzzila min samāʾi al-waḥyi wa-yukhrijuhu ʿani al-ẓāhiri innahu mimman ḥarrafa kalimata Allāhi al-ʿulyā wa-kāna mina al-akhsarīna fī kitābin mubīnin.

Whoever interprets what has been sent down from the heaven of revelation and takes it away from its evident meaning is among those who have distorted the exalted Word of God, and is numbered among the greatest losers in a clear Book.

107

قد کتب علیکم تقلیم الاظفار و الدّخول فی مآء یحیط هیاکلکم فی کلّ اسبوع و تنظیف ابدانکم بما استعملتموه من قبل ایّاکم ان تمنعکم الغفلة عمّا امرتم به من لدن عزیز عظیم ادخلوا مآءَ بکرا و المستعمل منه لا یجوز الدّخول فیه ایّاکم ان تقربوا خزائن حمامات العجم من قصدها وجد رائحتها المنتنة قبل وروده فیها تجنّبوا یا قوم و لا تکوننّ من الصّاغرین انّه یشبه بالصّدید و الغسلین ان انتم من العارفین و کذلک حیاضهم المنتنة اترکوها و کونوا من المقدّسین انّا اردنا ان نراکم مظاهر الفردوس فی الأرض لیتضوّع منکم ما تفرح به افئدة المقرّبین و الّذی یصبّ علیه المآء و یغسل به بدنه خیر له و یکفیه عن الدّخول انّه اراد ان یسهّل علیکم الأمور فضلا من عنده لتکونوا من الشّاکرین

Qad kutiba ʿalaykum taqlīmu al-aẓfāri wa-al-dukhūlu fī māʾin yuḥīṭu hayākilakum fī kulli usbūʿin wa-tanẓīfu abdānikum bi-mā istaʿmaltumūhu min qablu. Iyyākum an tamnaʿakumu al-ghaflatu ʿammā umirtum bihi min ladun ʿazīzin ʿaẓīmin. Udkhulū māʾan bikran wa-al-mustaʿmalu minhu lā yajūzu al-dukhūlu fīhi. Iyyākum an taqrabū khazāʾina ḥammāmāti al-ʿajami. Man qaṣadahā wajada rāʾiḥatahā al-muntinata qabla wurūdihi fīhā. Tajannabū yā qawmi wa-lā takūnanna mina al-ṣāghirīna. Innahu yushbihu bi-al-ṣadīdi wa-al-ghislīni in antum mina al-ʿārifīna. Wa-kadhālika ḥiyāḍuhumu al-muntinatu utrukūhā wa-kūnū mina al-muqaddasīna. Innā aradnā an narākum maẓāhira al-firdawsi fī al-arḍi li-yataḍawwaʿa minkum mā tafraḥu bihi afʾidatu al-muqarrabīna. Wa-alladhī yuṣabbu ʿalayhi al-māʾu wa-yaghsilu bihi badanahu khayrun lahu wa-yakfīhi ʿani al-dukhūli. Innahu arāda an yusahhila ʿalaykumu al-umūra faḍlan min ʿindihi li-takūnū mina al-shākirīna.

You are required to trim your nails, immerse yourselves each week in water that surrounds your bodies, and clean your bodies with what you have used before. Take care that negligence does not prevent you from doing what you have been commanded by One who is Almighty, Most Great. Enter fresh water; immersion in water that has been used is not permitted. Take care not to approach the reservoirs of the Persian baths. Anyone making their way to them encounters their foul smell before entering. Avoid them, O people, and do not be among the abased. Such water resembles pus and foul discharge, if you understand. Likewise, abandon their foul-smelling pools and be among the pure. We have desired to see you as manifestations of paradise on earth, so that a fragrance may spread from you that gladdens the hearts of those brought near to God. For anyone who has water poured over him and washes his body with it, this is better and suffices in place of immersion. He has desired to make matters easy for you, as a bounty from Him, so that you may be thankful.

108

قد حرّمت علیکم ازواج آبائکم انّا نستحیی ان نذکر حکم الغلمان اتّقوا الرّحمن یا ملاء الامکان و لا ترتکبوا ما نهیتم عنه فی اللّوح و لا تکونوا فی هیماء الشّهوات من الهائمین

Qad ḥurrimat ʿalaykum azwāju ābāʾikum. Innā nastaḥyī an nadhkura ḥukma al-ghilmāni. Ittaqū al-raḥmāna yā malaʾa al-imkāni wa-lā tartakibū mā nuhītum ʿanhu fī al-lawḥi wa-lā takūnū fī haymāʾi al-shahawāti mina al-hāʾimīna.

Marriage to your fathers’ wives has been forbidden to you. We are ashamed to mention the ruling concerning boys. Fear the All-Merciful, O people of the world of existence, and do not commit what you have been forbidden in the Tablet. Do not be among those who wander in the wilderness of desires.

109

لیس لأحد ان یحرّک لسانه امام النّاس اذ یمشی فی الطّرق و الأسواق بل ینبغی لمن اراد الذّکر ان یذکر فی مقام بنی لذکر اللّه او فی بیته هذا اقرب بالخلوص و التّقوی کذلک اشرقت شمس الحکم من افق البیان طوبی للعاملین

Laysa li-aḥadin an yuḥarrika lisānahu amāma al-nāsi idh yamshī fī al-ṭuruqi wa-al-aswāqi. Bal yanbaghī li-man arāda al-dhikra an yadhkura fī maqāmin buniya li-dhikri Allāhi aw fī baytihi. Hādhā aqrabu bi-al-khulūṣi wa-al-taqwā. Kadhālika ashraqat shamsu al-ḥukmi min ufuqi al-bayāni. Ṭūbā li-al-ʿāmilīna.

No one may move his tongue in remembrance before others while walking in the streets and marketplaces. Rather, whoever wishes to engage in remembrance should do so in a place built for the remembrance of God or in his own home. This is closer to sincerity and piety. Thus has the sun of the ordinance shone from the horizon of utterance. Blessed are those who act accordingly.

110

قد فرض لکلّ نفس کتاب الوصیة و له ان یزین رأسه بالاسم الأعظم و یعترف فیه بوحدانیّة اللّه فی مظهر ظهوره و یذکر فیه ما اراد من المعروف لیشهد له فی عوالم الأمر و الخلق و یکون له کنزاً عند ربّه الحافظ الأمین

Qad furiḍa li-kulli nafsin kitābu al-waṣiyyati wa-lahu an yuzayyina raʾsahu bi-al-ismi al-aʿẓami wa-yaʿtarifa fīhi bi-waḥdāniyyati Allāhi fī maẓhari ẓuhūrihi wa-yadhkura fīhi mā arāda mina al-maʿrūfi li-yashhada lahu fī ʿawālimi al-amri wa-al-khalqi wa-yakūna lahu kanzan ʿinda rabbihi al-ḥāfiẓi al-amīni.

Everyone is required to write a will. He should adorn its heading with the Most Great Name, acknowledge in it the oneness of God in the Manifestation of His revelation, and set down in it whatever good he wishes, so that it may bear witness for him in the worlds of command and creation and be a treasure for him with his Lord, the Guardian, the Faithful.

111

قد انتهت الأعیاد الی العیدین الأعظمین امّا الأوّل ایّام فیها تجلّی الرّحمن علی من فی الامکان باسمائه الحسنی و صفاته العلیا و الآخر یوم فیه بعثنا من بشّر النّاس بهذا الاسم الّذی به قامت الأموات و حشر من فی السّموات و الأرضین و الآخرین فی یومین کذلک قضی الأمر من لدن آمرٍ علیم

Qad intahati al-aʿyādu ilā al-ʿīdayni al-aʿẓamayni. Ammā al-awwalu ayyāmun fīhā tajallā al-raḥmānu ʿalā man fī al-imkāni bi-asmāʾihi al-ḥusnā wa-ṣifātihi al-ʿulyā wa-al-ākharu yawmun fīhi baʿathnā man bashshara al-nāsa bi-hādhā al-ismi alladhī bihi qāmati al-amwātu wa-ḥushira man fī al-samāwāti wa-al-araḍīna wa-al-ākharayni fī yawmayni. Kadhālika quḍiya al-amru min ladun āmirin ʿalīmin.

The festivals have culminated in the two Most Great Festivals. The first comprises the days when the All-Merciful revealed Himself to all in the world of existence through His most beautiful names and most exalted attributes. The other is the day on which We raised up the One who announced to humanity this Name, through which the dead have risen and all who are in the heavens and on earth have been gathered together. The other two festivals fall on two days. Thus has the matter been decreed by an all-knowing Ordainer.

112

طوبی لمن فاز بالیوم الأوّل من شهر البهآء الّذی جعله اللّه لهذا الاسم العظیم طوبی لمن یظهر فیه نعمة اللّه علی نفسه انّه ممّن اظهر شکر اللّه بفعله المدلّ علی فضله الّذی احاط العالمین قل انّه لصدر الشّهور و مبدئها و فیه تمرّ نفحة الحیات علی الممکنات طوبی لمن ادرکه بالرّوح و الرّیحان نشهد انّه من الفائزین

Ṭūbā li-man fāza bi-al-yawmi al-awwali min shahri al-bahāʾi alladhī jaʿalahu Allāhu li-hādhā al-ismi al-ʿaẓīmi. Ṭūbā li-man yuẓhiru fīhi niʿmata Allāhi ʿalā nafsihi. Innahu mimman aẓhara shukra Allāhi bi-fiʿlihi al-dālli ʿalā faḍlihi alladhī aḥāṭa al-ʿālamīna. Qul innahu la-ṣadru al-shuhūri wa-mabdaʾuhā wa-fīhi tamurru nafḥatu al-ḥayāti ʿalā al-mumkināti. Ṭūbā li-man adrakahu bi-al-rūḥi wa-al-rayḥāni. Nashhadu innahu mina al-fāʾizīna.

Blessed is whoever reaches the first day of the month of Bahāʾ, which God has appointed for this great Name. Blessed is whoever displays on that day God’s bounty to him. He is among those who have shown gratitude to God through an act that bears witness to His grace, which encompasses all worlds. Say: It is the foremost of the months and their beginning, and in it the breath of life passes over all created things. Blessed is whoever reaches it with joy and gladness. We testify that he is among those who have attained.

113

قل انّ العید الاعظم لسلطان الأعیاد اذکروا یا قوم نعمة اللّه علیکم اذ کنتم رقدآء ایقظکم من نسمات الوحی و عرّفکم سبیله الواضح المستقیم

Qul inna al-ʿīda al-aʿẓama la-sulṭānu al-aʿyādi. Udhkurū yā qawmi niʿmata Allāhi ʿalaykum idh kuntum ruqadāʾa ayqaẓakum min nasamāti al-waḥyi wa-ʿarrafakum sabīlahu al-wāḍiḥa al-mustaqīma.

Say: The Most Great Festival is indeed the sovereign of festivals. Remember, O people, God’s bounty to you: when you were asleep, He awakened you through the breezes of revelation and made known to you His clear and straight path.

114

اذا مرضتم ارجعوا الی الحذّاق من الأطبّآء انّا ما رفعنا الأسباب بل اثبتناها من هذا القلم الّذی جعله اللّه مطلع امره المشرق المنیر

Idhā mariḍtum irjiʿū ilā al-ḥudhdhāqi mina al-aṭibbāʾi. Innā mā rafaʿnā al-asbāba bal athbatnāhā min hādhā al-qalami alladhī jaʿalahu Allāhu maṭlaʿa amrihi al-mushriqa al-munīra.

When you are ill, consult skilled physicians. We have not set aside the use of means; rather, We have affirmed it through this Pen, which God has made the radiant, luminous dawning place of His Cause.

115

قد کتب اللّه علی کلّ نفس ان یحضر لدی العرشبما عنده ممّا لا عدل له انّا عفونا عن ذلک فضلا من لدنّا انّه هو المعطی الکریم

Qad kataba Allāhu ʿalā kulli nafsin an yuḥḍira ladā al-ʿarshi bi-mā ʿindahu mimmā lā ʿidla lahu. Innā ʿafawnā ʿan dhālika faḍlan min ladunnā. Innahu huwa al-muʿṭī al-karīmu.

God had required every person to bring before the Throne whatever he possessed that was without equal. We have waived this as a bounty from Us. He is indeed the Bestower, the Generous.

116

طوبی لمن توجّه الی مشرق الأذکار فی الأسحار ذاکرا متذکّرا مستغفرا و اذا دخل یقعد صامتا لاصغآء آیات اللّه الملک العزیز الحمید قل مشرق الأذکار انّه کلّ بیت بنی لذکری فی المدن و القری کذلک سمّی لدی العرش ان انتم من العارفین

Ṭūbā li-man tawajjaha ilā mashriqi al-adhkāri fī al-asḥāri dhākiran mutadhakkiran mustaghfiran wa-idhā dakhala yaqʿudu ṣāmitan li-iṣghāʾi āyāti Allāhi al-maliki al-ʿazīzi al-ḥamīdi. Qul mashriqu al-adhkāri innahu kullu baytin buniya li-dhikrī fī al-muduni wa-al-qurā. Kadhālika summiya ladā al-ʿarshi in antum mina al-ʿārifīna.

Blessed is whoever turns toward the Dawning Place of Remembrance at dawn, remembering, reflecting, and seeking forgiveness, and who, upon entering, sits silently to listen to the verses of God, the King, the Almighty, the All-Praised. Say: The Dawning Place of Remembrance is every house built for My remembrance in cities and villages. Thus has it been named before the Throne, if you understand.

117

و الّذین یتلون آیات الرّحمن بأحسن الألحان اولئک یدرکون منها ما لا یعادله ملکوت ملک السّموات و الأرضین و بها یجدون عرف عوالمی الّتی لا یعرفها الیوم الاّ من اوتی البصر من هذا المنظر الکریم قل انّها تجذب القلوب الصّافیة الی العوالم الرّوحانیة الّتی لا تعبّر بالعبارة و لا تشار بالاشارة طوبی للسّامعین

Wa-alladhīna yatlūna āyāti al-raḥmāni bi-aḥsani al-alḥāni ulāʾika yudrikūna minhā mā lā yuʿādiluhu malakūtu mulki al-samāwāti wa-al-araḍīna wa-bihā yajidūna ʿarfa ʿawālimī allatī lā yaʿrifuhā al-yawma illā man ūtiya al-baṣara min hādhā al-manẓari al-karīmi. Qul innahā tajdhibu al-qulūba al-ṣāfiyata ilā al-ʿawālimi al-rūḥāniyyati allatī lā tuʿabbaru bi-al-ʿibārati wa-lā tushāru bi-al-ishārati. Ṭūbā li-al-sāmiʿīna.

Those who recite the verses of the All-Merciful in the most beautiful melodies perceive in them what the entire dominion of the heavens and earth cannot equal. Through them they sense the fragrance of My worlds, which no one knows today except those who have been granted sight by this gracious Vision. Say: These verses draw pure hearts toward spiritual worlds that cannot be expressed in words or indicated by any allusion. Blessed are those who listen.

118

انصروا یا قوم اصفیائی الّذین قاموا علی ذکری بین خلقی و ارتفاع کلمتی فی مملکتی اولئک انجم سمآء عنایتی و مصابیح هدایتی للخلائق اجمعین و الّذی یتکلّم بغیر ما نزّل فی الواحی انّه لیس منّی ایّاکم ان تتّبعوا کلّ مدّعٍ اثیم قد زینت الألواح بطراز ختم فالق الأصباح الّذی ینطق بین السّموات و الأرضین تمسّکوا بالعروة الوثقی و حبل امری المحکم المتین

Unṣurū yā qawmi aṣfiyāʾī alladhīna qāmū ʿalā dhikrī bayna khalqī wa-irtifāʿi kalimatī fī mamlakatī. Ulāʾika anjumu samāʾi ʿināyatī wa-maṣābīḥu hidāyatī li-al-khalāʾiqi ajmaʿīna. Wa-alladhī yatakallamu bi-ghayri mā nuzzila fī alwāḥī innahu laysa minnī. Iyyākum an tattabiʿū kulla muddaʿin athīmin. Qad zuyyinati al-alwāḥu bi-ṭirāzi khatmi fāliqi al-aṣbāḥi alladhī yanṭiqu bayna al-samāwāti wa-al-araḍīna. Tamassakū bi-al-ʿurwati al-wuthqā wa-ḥabli amrī al-muḥkami al-matīni.

Support, O people, My chosen ones who have arisen to remember Me among My creation and exalt My Word in My kingdom. They are the stars of the heaven of My loving care and the lamps of My guidance to all created beings. Whoever speaks contrary to what has been sent down in My Tablets is not of Me. Take care not to follow any sinful pretender. The Tablets have been adorned with the seal of the One who causes the dawn to break, who speaks amid the heavens and earth. Hold fast to the surest handle and to the firm, strong cord of My Cause.

119

قد اذن اللّه لمن اراد ان یتعلّم الألسن المختلفة لیبلّغ امر اللّه شرق الأرض و غربها و یذکره بین الدّول و الملل علی شأن تنجذب به الافئدة و یحیی به کلّ عظم رمیم

Qad adhina Allāhu li-man arāda an yataʿallama al-alsuna al-mukhtalifata li-yuballigha amra Allāhi sharqa al-arḍi wa-gharbahā wa-yadhkurahu bayna al-duwali wa-al-milali ʿalā shaʾnin tanjadhibu bihi al-afʾidatu wa-yaḥyā bihi kullu ʿaẓmin ramīmin.

God has permitted whoever wishes to learn different languages to do so, so that he may convey the Cause of God to the east and west of the earth and proclaim it among nations and peoples in such a way that hearts are attracted and every decayed bone is brought to life.

120

لیس للعاقل ان یشرب ما یذهب به العقل و له ان یعمل ما ینبغی للانسان لا ما یرتکبه کلّ غافلٍ مریب

Laysa li-al-ʿāqili an yashraba mā yadhhabu bihi al-ʿaqlu wa-lahu an yaʿmala mā yanbaghī li-al-insāni lā mā yartakibuhu kullu ghāfilin murībin.

A person of understanding must not drink what takes away reason, but should do what befits a human being, not what every heedless, dubious person commits.

121

زینوا رؤسکم باکلیل الأمانة و الوفآء و قلوبکم بردآء التّقوی و السنکم بالصّدق الخالص و هیاکلکم بطراز الآداب کلّ ذلک من سجیة الانسان لو انتم من المتبصّرین یا اهل البهآء تمسّکوا بحبل العبودیة للّه الحقّ بها تظهر مقاماتکم و تثبت اسمائکم و ترتفع مراتبکم و اذکارکم فی لوح حفیظ ایّاکم ان یمنعکم من علی الأرض عن هذا المقام العزیز الرّفیع قد وصّیناکم بها فی اکثر الألواح و فی هذا اللّوح الّذی لاح من افقه نیّر احکام ربّکم المقتدر الحکیم

Zayyinū ruʾūsakum bi-iklīl al-amāna wa-l-wafāʾ wa-qulūbakum bi-ridāʾ al-taqwā wa-alsinatakum bi-l-ṣidq al-khāliṣ wa-hayākilakum bi-ṭirāz al-ādāb. Kull dhālika min sajiyyat al-insān law antum min al-mutabaṣṣirīn. Yā ahl al-Bahāʾ, tamassakū bi-ḥabl al-ʿubūdiyya li-llāh al-Ḥaqq. Bihā taẓhar maqāmātukum wa-tathbut asmāʾukum wa-tartafiʿ marātibukum wa-adhkārukum fī lawḥ ḥafīẓ. Iyyākum an yamnaʿakum man ʿalā al-arḍ ʿan hādhā al-maqām al-ʿazīz al-rafīʿ. Qad waṣṣaynākum bihā fī akthar al-alwāḥ wa-fī hādhā al-lawḥ alladhī lāḥa min ufuqihi nayyir aḥkām rabbikum al-Muqtadir al-Ḥakīm.

Adorn your heads with the crown of trustworthiness and fidelity, your hearts with the robe of reverence for God, your tongues with pure truthfulness, and your bodies with the ornament of good manners. All these belong to human nature, if you have insight. People of Bahá, hold fast to the cord of servitude to God, the Truth. Through it your stations become manifest, your names are established, and your ranks and remembrance are exalted in a preserving Tablet. Beware lest anyone on earth keep you from this mighty, lofty station. We have enjoined it upon you in most of the Tablets, and in this Tablet, from whose horizon the sun of the ordinances of your Lord, the All-Powerful, the All-Wise, has shone.

122

اذا غیض بحر الوصال و قضی کتاب المبدء فی المال توجّهوا الی من اراده اللّه الّذی انشعب من هذا الأصل القدیم

Idhā ghīḍa baḥr al-wiṣāl wa-quḍiya kitāb al-mabdaʾ fī al-maʾāl, tawajj ahū ilā man arādahu Allāh alladhī inshaʿaba min hādhā al-aṣl al-qadīm.

When the ocean of reunion has ebbed and the Book of the Beginning has reached its end, turn to the one whom God has intended, who has branched from this ancient Root.

123

فانظروا فی النّاس و قلّة عقولهم یطلبون ما یضرّهم و یترکون ما ینفعهم الا انّهم من الهائمین انّا نری بعض النّاس ارادوا الحرّیة و یفتخرون بها اولیک فی جهلٍ مبین

Fa-nẓurū fī al-nās wa-qillat ʿuqūlihim. Yaṭlubūna mā yaḍurruhum wa-yatrukūna mā yanfaʿuhum. Alā innahum min al-hāʾimīn. Innā narā baʿḍ al-nās arādū al-ḥurriyya wa-yaftakhirūna bihā. Ulāʾika fī jahl mubīn.

Consider people and how little understanding they have. They seek what harms them and abandon what benefits them. Truly, they wander aimlessly. We see that some people desire liberty and take pride in it. They are in manifest ignorance.

124

انّ الحرّیة تنتهی عواقبها الی الفتنة الّتی لا تخمد نارها کذلک یخبرکم المحصی العلیم فاعلموا انّ مطالع الحرّیة و مظاهرها هی الحیوان و للانسان ینبغی ان یکون تحت سننٍ تحفظه عن جهل نفسه و ضرّ الماکرین انّ الحرّیة تخرج الانسان عن شئون الأدب و الوقار و تجعله من الارذلین

Inna al-ḥurriyya tantahī ʿawāqibuhā ilā al-fitna allatī lā tukh m ad nāruhā. Kadhālika yukhbirukum al-Muḥṣī al-ʿAlīm. Fa-ʿlamū anna maṭāliʿ al-ḥurriyya wa-maẓāhirahā hiya al-ḥayawān. Wa-li-l-insān yanbaghī an yakūna taḥta sunan taḥfaẓuhu ʿan jahl nafsihi wa-ḍarr al-mākirīn. Inna al-ḥurriyya tukhrij al-insān ʿan shuʾūn al-adab wa-l-waqār wa-tajʿaluhu min al-ardhalīn.

Liberty ultimately leads to turmoil whose fire cannot be extinguished. Thus the All-Reckoning, the All-Knowing informs you. Know that animals are the sources and manifestations of liberty. A human being should be subject to laws that protect him from his own ignorance and the harm of schemers. Liberty takes a person beyond the bounds of courtesy and dignity and makes him one of the most abject.

125

فانظروا الخلق کالأغنام لابدّ لها من راعٍ لیحفظها انّ هذا لحقٌّ یقین انّا نصدّقها فی بعض المقامات دون الآخر انّا کنّا عالمین

Fa-nẓurū al-khalq ka-l-aghnām. Lā budda lahā min rāʿ li-yaḥfaẓahā. Inna hādhā la-ḥaqq yaqīn. Innā nuṣaddiquhā fī baʿḍ al-maqāmāt dūna al-ākhar. Innā kunnā ʿālimīn.

Look upon humanity as sheep that must have a shepherd to protect them. This is indeed a certain truth. We approve liberty in some circumstances, but not in others. We have always been all-knowing.

126

قل الحرّیة فی اتّباع اوامری لو انتم من العارفین لو اتّبع النّاس ما نزّلناه لهم من سمآء الوحی لیجدنّ انفسهم فی حرّیة بحتة طوبی لمن عرف مراد اللّه فیما نزّل من سمآء مشیته المهیمنة علی العالمین قل الحرّیة الّتی تنفعکم انّها فی العبودیة للّه الحق و الّذی وجد حلاوتها لا یبدّلها بملکوت ملک السّموات و الأرضین

Qul al-ḥurriyya fī ittibāʿ awāmirī law antum min al-ʿārifīn. Law ittabaʿa al-nās mā nazzalnāhu lahum min samāʾ al-waḥy la-yajidanna anfusahum fī ḥurriyya baḥta. Ṭūbā li-man ʿarafa murād Allāh fīmā nazzala min samāʾ mashīʾatihi al-muhaymina ʿalā al-ʿālamīn. Qul al-ḥurriyya allatī tanfaʿukum innahā fī al-ʿubūdiyya li-llāh al-Ḥaqq. Wa-alladhī wajada ḥalāwatahā lā yubaddiluhā bi-malakūt mulk al-samāwāt wa-l-araḍīn.

Say: Liberty lies in following My commandments, if you understand. If people followed what We have sent down to them from the heaven of revelation, they would surely find themselves in pure liberty. Blessed is the one who recognizes God’s purpose in what He has sent down from the heaven of His will, which reigns over all worlds. Say: The liberty that benefits you lies in servitude to God, the Truth. Whoever has tasted its sweetness would not exchange it for sovereignty over the dominion of the heavens and the earth.

127

حرّم علیکم السّؤال فی البیان عفا اللّه عن ذلک لتسئلواما تحتاج به انفسکم لا ما تکلّم به رجال قبلکم اتّقوا اللّه و کونوا من المتّقین اسئلوا ما ینفعکم فی امر اللّه و سلطانه قد فتح باب الفضل علی من فی السّموات و الأرضین

Ḥurrima ʿalaykum al-suʾāl fī al-Bayān. ʿAfā Allāh ʿan dhālika li-tasʾalū mā taḥtāju bihi anfusukum lā mā takallama bihi rijāl qablakum. Ittaqū Allāh wa-kūnū min al-muttaqīn. Isʾalū mā yanfaʿukum fī amr Allāh wa-sulṭānihi. Qad futiḥa bāb al-faḍl ʿalā man fī al-samāwāt wa-l-araḍīn.

Asking questions was forbidden to you in the Bayán. God has waived this prohibition so that you may ask about what you yourselves need, not what people before you discussed. Be mindful of God and be among those who revere Him. Ask about what benefits you in the Cause of God and His sovereignty. The door of grace has been opened to all who are in the heavens and the earth.

128

انّ عدّة الشّهور تسعة عشر شهراً فی کتاب اللّه قد زین اوّلها بهذا الاسم المهیمن علی العالمین

Inna ʿiddat al-shuhūr tisʿata ʿashara shahran fī kitāb Allāh. Qad zuyyina awwaluhā bi-hādhā al-ism al-muhaymin ʿalā al-ʿālamīn.

The number of months in the Book of God is nineteen. The first of them has been adorned with this Name, which reigns over all worlds.

129

قد حکم اللّه دفن الأموات فی البلّور و الأحجار الممتنعة او الاخشاب الصّلبة اللّطیفة و وضع الخواتیم المنقوشة فی اصابعهم انّه لهو المقتدر العلیم

Qad ḥakama Allāh dafn al-amwāt fī al-billawr wa-l-aḥjār al-mumtaniʿa aw al-akhshāb al-ṣalba al-laṭīfa wa-waḍʿ al-khawātīm al-manqūsha fī aṣābiʿihim. Innahu la-huwa al-Muqtadir al-ʿAlīm.

God has decreed that the dead be buried in crystal, durable stone, or fine hardwood, and that engraved rings be placed on their fingers. He is indeed the All-Powerful, the All-Knowing.

130

یکتب للرّجال و للّه ما فی السّموات و الأرض و ما بینهما و کان اللّه بکلّ شئ علیماً و للورقات و للّه ملک السّموات و الأرض و ما بینهما و کان اللّه علی کلّ شئ قدیرا هذا ما نزّل من قبل و ینادی نقطة البیان و یقول یا محبوب الامکان انطق فی هذا المقام بما تتضوّع به نفحات الطافک بین العالمین انّا اخبرنا الکلّ بأن لا یعادل بکلمة منک ما نزّل فی البیان انّک انت المقتدر علی ما تشآء لا تمنع عبادک عن فیوضات بحر رحمتک انّک انت ذو الفضل العظیم قد استجبنا ما اراد انّه لهو المحبوب المجیب لو ینقش علیها ما نزّل فی الحین من لدی اللّه انّه خیر لهم و لهنّ انّا کنّا حاکمین قد بدئت من اللّه و رجعت الیه منقطعا عمّا سواه و متمسّکا باسمه الرّحمن الرّحیم کذلک یختصّ اللّه من یشآء بفضل من عنده انّه لهو المقتدر القدیر

Yuktab li-l-rijāl: Wa-li-llāh mā fī al-samāwāt wa-l-arḍ wa-mā baynahumā wa-kāna Allāh bi-kull shayʾ ʿalīman. Wa-li-l-waraqāt: Wa-li-llāh mulk al-samāwāt wa-l-arḍ wa-mā baynahumā wa-kāna Allāh ʿalā kull shayʾ qadīran. Hādhā mā nuzzila min qabl. Wa-yunādī Nuqṭat al-Bayān wa-yaqūl: Yā maḥbūb al-imkān, unṭuq fī hādhā al-maqām bi-mā tataḍawwaʿu bihi nafaḥāt alṭāfika bayna al-ʿālamīn. Innā akhbarnā al-kull bi-an lā yuʿādalu bi-kalima minka mā nuzzila fī al-Bayān. Innaka anta al-muqtadir ʿalā mā tashāʾ. Lā tamnaʿ ʿibādaka ʿan fuyūḍāt baḥr raḥmatika. Innaka anta dhū al-faḍl al-ʿaẓīm. Qad istajabnā mā arāda. Innahu la-huwa al-Maḥbūb al-Mujīb. Law yunqashu ʿalayhā mā nuzzila fī al-ḥīn min ladā Allāh innahu khayr lahum wa-lahunna. Innā kunnā ḥākimīn. Qad badaʾtu min Allāh wa-rajaʿtu ilayhi munqaṭiʿan ʿammā siwāhu wa-mutamassikan bi-ismihi al-Raḥmān al-Raḥīm. Kadhālika yakhtaṣṣu Allāh man yashāʾ bi-faḍl min ʿindihi. Innahu la-huwa al-Muqtadir al-Qadīr.

For men, the inscription is: “To God belongs all that is in the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, and God knows all things.” For the leaves: “To God belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, and God has power over all things.” This is what was sent down before. The Point of the Bayán calls out and says: “Beloved of all existence, speak on this matter words through which the fragrances of Your loving-kindness may spread among all worlds. We have informed everyone that nothing revealed in the Bayán can equal a single word from You. You have power to do whatever You will. Do not withhold from Your servants the outpourings of the ocean of Your mercy. You are the Possessor of immense grace.” We have answered His wish. He is indeed the Beloved, the Responsive. If what has now been sent down from God is engraved upon them, it is better for both men and women. We have indeed decreed: “I came from God and have returned to Him, detached from all but Him and holding fast to His name, the All-Merciful, the Compassionate.” Thus God singles out whomever He wills for grace from His presence. He is indeed the All-Powerful, the Almighty.

131

و ان تکفنوه فی خمسة اثواب من الحریر او القطن من لم یستطع یکتفی بواحدة منهما کذلک قضی الأمر من لدن علیم خبیر حرّم علیکم نقل المیت ازید من مسافة ساعة من المدینة ادفنوه بالرّوح و الرّیحان فی مکان قریب

Wa-an tukaffinūhu fī khamsat athwāb min al-ḥarīr aw al-quṭn. Man lam yastaṭiʿ yaktafī bi-wāḥida minhumā. Kadhālika quḍiya al-amr min ladun ʿAlīm Khabīr. Ḥurrima ʿalaykum naql al-mayyit azyad min masāfat sāʿa min al-madīna. Idfinūhu bi-l-rūḥ wa-l-rayḥān fī makān qarīb.

And wrap the deceased in five lengths of silk or cotton. Whoever cannot afford this may make do with one of either. Thus has the ordinance been decreed by One who is All-Knowing, All-Aware. You are forbidden to transport the deceased more than an hour’s journey from the city. Bury him with joy and fragrance in a nearby place.

132

قد رفع اللّه ما حکم به البیان فی تحدید الأسفا انّه لهو المختار یفعل ما یشآء و یحکم ما یرید

Qad rafaʿa Allāh mā ḥakama bihi al-Bayān fī taḥdīd [corrupted text]. Innahu la-huwa al-Mukhtār yafʿalu mā yashāʾ wa-yaḥkumu mā yurīd.

God has lifted what the Bayán ordained concerning the restriction of [corrupted original text]. He is indeed free to choose: He does whatever He wills and ordains whatever He desires.

133

یا ملاء الانشآء اسمعوا ندآء مالک الأسمآء انّه ینادیکم من شطر سجنه الأعظم انّه لا اله الاّ انا المقتدر المتکبّر المتسخّر المتعالی العلیم الحکیم انّه لا اله الاّ هو المقتدر علی العالمین لو یشآء یاخذ العالم بکلمة من عنده ایّاکم ان تتوقّفوا فی هذا الأمر الّذی خضع له الملأ الأعلی و اهل مدائن الأسمآء اتّقوا اللّه و لا تکوننّ من المحتجبین احرقوا الحجبات بنار حبّی و السّبحات بهذا الاسم الّذی به سخّرنا العالمین

Yā malaʾ al-inshāʾ, ismaʿū nidāʾ Mālik al-Asmāʾ. Innahu yunādīkum min shaṭr sijnihi al-aʿẓam: Innahu lā ilāha illā anā al-Muqtadir al-Mutakabbir al-Mutasakhkhir al-Mutaʿālī al-ʿAlīm al-Ḥakīm. Innahu lā ilāha illā huwa al-muqtadir ʿalā al-ʿālamīn. Law yashāʾ yaʾkhudh al-ʿālam bi-kalima min ʿindihi. Iyyākum an tatawaqqafū fī hādhā al-amr alladhī khaḍaʿa lahu al-malaʾ al-aʿlā wa-ahl madāʾin al-asmāʾ. Ittaqū Allāh wa-lā takūnanna min al-muḥtajibīn. Aḥriqū al-ḥujubāt bi-nār ḥubbī wa-l-subuḥāt bi-hādhā al-ism alladhī bihi sakhkharnā al-ʿālamīn.

People of creation, hear the call of the Lord of Names. He calls to you from His Most Great Prison: “There is no God but Me, the All-Powerful, the Supremely Great, the One in service, the Most Exalted, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.” There is no God but Him, who has power over all worlds. If He wills, He can seize the world with a word from Himself. Beware of hesitating in this Cause, before which the Concourse on high and the inhabitants of the cities of names have bowed. Be mindful of God, and do not be among those who are veiled. Burn away the veils with the fire of My love, and the veils of glory with this Name through which We have subdued all worlds.

134

و ارفعنّ البیتین فی المقامین و المقامات الّتی فیها استقرّ عرش ربّکم الرّحمن کذلک یأمرکم مولی العارفین

Wa-irfaʿanna al-baytayn fī al-maqāmayn wa-l-maqāmāt allatī fīhā istaqarra ʿarsh rabbikum al-Raḥmān. Kadhālika yaʾmurukum Mawlā al-ʿārifīn.

Raise up the two Houses in the two places, and the sites where the throne of your Lord, the All-Merciful, was established. Thus commands you the Lord of those who know.

135

ایّاکم ان تمنعکم شئونات الأرض عمّا امرتم به من لدن قوی امین کونوا مظاهر الاستقامة بین البریّة علی شأن لا تمنعکم شبهات الّذین کفروا باللّه اذ ظهر بسلطان عظیم ایّاکم ان یمنعکم ما نزّل فی الکتاب عن هذا الکتاب الّذی ینطق بالحقّ انّه لا اله الاّ انا العزیز الحمید انظروا بعین الانصاف الی من اتی من سمآء المشیّة و الاقتدار و لا تکوننّ من الظّالمین

Iyyākum an tamnaʿakum shuʾūnāt al-arḍ ʿammā umirtum bihi min ladun Qawiyy Amīn. Kūnū maẓāhir al-istiqāma bayna al-bariyya ʿalā shaʾn lā tamnaʿukum shubuhāt alladhīna kafarū bi-llāh idh ẓahara bi-sulṭān ʿaẓīm. Iyyākum an yamnaʿakum mā nuzzila fī al-kitāb ʿan hādhā al-kitāb alladhī yanṭiqu bi-l-ḥaqq: Innahu lā ilāha illā anā al-ʿAzīz al-Ḥamīd. Unẓurū bi-ʿayn al-inṣāf ilā man atā min samāʾ al-mashīʾa wa-l-iqtidār wa-lā takūnanna min al-ẓālimīn.

Beware lest earthly affairs keep you from what you have been commanded by One who is Strong and Trustworthy. Be manifestations of steadfastness among humanity, so that the doubts of those who disbelieved in God when He appeared with mighty sovereignty cannot deter you. Beware lest what was revealed in the Book keep you from this Book, which declares the truth: “There is no God but Me, the Almighty, the Praiseworthy.” Look with fairness upon the One who has come from the heaven of will and power, and do not be among the unjust.

136

ثمّ اذکروا ما جری من قلم مبشّری فی ذکر هذا الظّهور و ما ارتکبه اولو الطّغیان فی ایّامه الا انّهم من الأخسرین قال ان ادرکتم ما نظهره انتم من فضل اللّه تسئلون لیمنّ علیکم باستوائه علی سرائرکم فانّ ذلک عزّ ممتنع منیع ان یشرب کأس مآء عندکم اعظم من ان تشربنّ کلّ نفس مآء وجوده بل کلّ شئ ان یا عبادی تدرکون

Thumma udhkurū mā jarā min qalam mubashshirī fī dhikr hādhā al-ẓuhūr wa-mā irtakabahu ulū al-ṭughyān fī ayyāmihi. Alā innahum min al-akhsarīn. Qāla: In adraktum mā nuẓhiruhu antum min faḍl Allāh tasʾalūn li-yamunna ʿalaykum bi-istiwāʾihi ʿalā sarāʾirikum fa-inna dhālika ʿizz mumtaniʿ manīʿ. An yashraba kaʾs māʾ ʿindakum aʿẓam min an tashrabanna kull nafs māʾ wujūdihi bal kull shayʾ, in yā ʿibādī tudrikūn.

Then remember what flowed from the pen of My Herald concerning this Revelation, and what the tyrannical committed in His days. Truly, they are among the greatest losers. He said: “If you attain the presence of the One We shall manifest, ask of God’s grace that He may favor you by taking His seat in your innermost hearts, for that is an inaccessible, exalted honor. For Him to drink a cup of water in your presence is greater than for every soul—indeed, every thing—to drink the water of its own existence, if you understand, My servants.”

137

هذا ما نزّل من عنده ذکرا لنفسی لو انتم تعلمون و الّذی تفکّر فی هذه الآیات و اطّلع بما ستر فیهنّ من اللآلیٴ المخزونة تاللّه انّه یجد عرف الرّحمن من شطر السّجن و یسرع بقلبه الیه باشتیاق لا تمنعه جنود السّموات و الأرضین قل هذا لظهور تطوف حوله الحجّة و البرهان کذلک انزله الرّحمن ان انتم من المنصفین قل هذا روح الکتب قد نفخ به فی القلم الأعلی و انصعق من فی الانشآء الاّ من اخذته نفحات رحمتی و فوحات الطافی المهیمنة علی العالمین

Hādhā mā nuzzila min ʿindihi dhikran li-nafsī law antum taʿlamūn. Wa-alladhī tafakkara fī hādhihi al-āyāt wa-iṭṭalaʿa bi-mā sutira fīhinna min al-laʾāliʾ al-makhzūna, ta-llāh innahu yajidu ʿarf al-Raḥmān min shaṭr al-sijn wa-yusriʿu bi-qalbihi ilayhi bi-ishtiyāq lā tamnaʿuhu junūd al-samāwāt wa-l-araḍīn. Qul hādhā la-ẓuhūr taṭūfu ḥawlahu al-ḥujja wa-l-burhān. Kadhālika anzalahu al-Raḥmān in antum min al-munṣifīn. Qul hādhā rūḥ al-kutub qad nufikha bihi fī al-qalam al-aʿlā wa-inṣaʿiqa man fī al-inshāʾ illā man akhadhathu nafaḥāt raḥmatī wa-fawḥāt alṭāfī al-muhaymina ʿalā al-ʿālamīn.

This is what was sent down from Him in remembrance of Me, if you only knew. Whoever reflects on these verses and discovers the treasured pearls concealed within them will, by God, perceive the fragrance of the All-Merciful from the direction of the prison and hasten toward Him in his heart with a longing that the armies of heaven and earth cannot restrain. Say: This is indeed a Revelation around which proof and testimony circle. Thus has the All-Merciful sent it down, if you judge fairly. Say: This is the spirit of the scriptures, breathed into the Most Exalted Pen, at which all creation has fallen thunderstruck, except those whom the breezes of My mercy and the fragrances of My loving-kindness, which reigns over all worlds, have embraced.

138

یا ملاء البیان اتّقوا الرّحمن ثمّ انظروا ما انزله فی مقام آخر قال انّما القبلة من یظهره اللّه متی ینقلب تنقلب الی ان یستقرّ کذلک نزّل من لدن مالک القدر اذ اراد ذکر هذا المنظر الأکبر تفکّروا یا قوم و لا تکوننّ من الهآئمین لو تنکرونه بأهوائکم الی آیة قبلة تتوجّهون یا معشر الغافلین تفکّروا فی هذه الآیة ثمّ انصفوا باللّه لعلّ تجدون لآلیٴ الأسرار من البحر الّذی تموّج باسمی العزیز المنیع

Yā malaʾ al-Bayān, ittaqū al-Raḥmān thumma unẓurū mā anzalahu fī maqām ākhar. Qāla: Innamā al-qibla man yuẓhiruhu Allāh matā yanqalib tanqalib ilā an yastaqirr. Kadhālika nuzzila min ladun Mālik al-Qadar idh arāda dhikr hādhā al-manẓar al-akbar. Tafakkarū yā qawm wa-lā takūnanna min al-hāʾimīn. Law tunkirūnahu bi-ahwāʾikum ilā ayyat qibla tataw ajjahūn yā maʿshar al-ghāfilīn? Tafakkarū fī hādhihi al-āya thumma anṣifū bi-llāh laʿalla tajidūna laʾāliʾ al-asrār min al-baḥr alladhī tamawwaja bi-ismī al-ʿAzīz al-Manīʿ.

People of the Bayán, be mindful of the All-Merciful, and consider what He revealed elsewhere. He said: “The Qibla is none other than the One whom God will manifest. Whenever He moves, it moves, until He comes to rest.” Thus was it sent down by the Lord of Destiny when He wished to speak of this Most Great Vision. Reflect, people, and do not be among those who wander aimlessly. If you deny Him because of your desires, toward what Qibla will you turn, heedless ones? Reflect on this verse, and then, by God, judge fairly, so that you may find the pearls of mysteries in the ocean that has surged through My name, the Almighty, the Inaccessible.

139

لیس لأحد ان یتمسّک الیوم الاّ بما ظهر فی هذا الظّهور هذا حکم اللّه من قبل و من بعد و به زیّن صحف الأوّلین هذا ذکر اللّه من قبل و من بعد قد طرّز به دیباج کتاب الوجود ان انتم من الشّاعرین هذا امر اللّه من قبل و من بعد ایّاکم ان تکونوا من الصّاغرین لا یغنیکم الیوم شئ و لیس لأحد مهرب الاّ اللّه العلیم الحکیم من عرفنی فقد عرف المقصود من توجّه الی قد توجّه الی المعبود کذلک فصّل فی الکتاب و قضی الأمر من لدی اللّه ربّ العالمین من یقرء آیة من آیاتی لخیر له من ان یقرء کتب الأوّلین و الأخرین هذا بیان الرّحمن ان انتم من السّامعین قل هذا حقّ العلم لو انتم من العارفین

Laysa li-aḥad an yatamassaka al-yawm illā bi-mā ẓahara fī hādhā al-ẓuhūr. Hādhā ḥukm Allāh min qabl wa-min baʿd wa-bihi zuyyina ṣuḥuf al-awwalīn. Hādhā dhikr Allāh min qabl wa-min baʿd qad ṭurriza bihi dībā j kitāb al-wujūd in antum min al-shāʿirīn. Hādhā amr Allāh min qabl wa-min baʿd. Iyyākum an takūnū min al-ṣāghirīn. Lā yughnīkum al-yawm shayʾ wa-laysa li-aḥad mahrab illā Allāh al-ʿAlīm al-Ḥakīm. Man ʿarafanī fa-qad ʿarafa al-maqṣūd. Man tawajjaha ilayya qad tawajjaha ilā al-maʿbūd. Kadhālika fuṣṣila fī al-kitāb wa-quḍiya al-amr min ladā Allāh rabb al-ʿālamīn. Man yaqraʾ āya min āyātī la-khayr lahu min an yaqraʾ kutub al-awwalīn wa-l-ākhirīn. Hādhā bayān al-Raḥmān in antum min al-sāmiʿīn. Qul hādhā ḥaqq al-ʿilm law antum min al-ʿārifīn.

Today no one may hold fast to anything but what has appeared in this Revelation. This is God’s decree, before and hereafter, and with it the scriptures of the ancients were adorned. This is God’s remembrance, before and hereafter, with which the brocade of the Book of Existence has been embroidered, if you perceive. This is God’s command, before and hereafter. Beware of being among the abased. Nothing will avail you today, and no one has any refuge except God, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise. Whoever has recognized Me has recognized the One who is sought; whoever has turned toward Me has turned toward the One who is worshipped. Thus has it been set out in the Book, and the matter decreed by God, the Lord of all worlds. For anyone to read a single one of My verses is better than reading the books of the ancients and those who came after them. This is the utterance of the All-Merciful, if you listen. Say: This is true knowledge, if you understand.

140

ثمّ انظروا ما نزّل فی مقام اخر لعلّ تدعون ما عندکم مقبلین الی اللّه ربّ العالمین قال لا یحلّ الاقتران ان لم یکن فی البیان و ان یدخل من احد یحرم علی الآخر ما یملک من عنده الاّ و ان یرجع ذلک بعد ان یرفع امر من نظهره بالحقّ او ما قد ظهر بالعدل و قبل ذلک فلتقربنّ لعلّکم بذلک امر اللّه ترفعون کذلک تغرّدت الورقآء علی الافنان فی ذکر ربّها الرّحمن طوبی للسّامعین

Thumma unẓurū mā nuzzila fī maqām ākhar laʿalla tadaʿūna mā ʿindakum muqbilīn ilā Allāh rabb al-ʿālamīn. Qāla: Lā yaḥillu al-iqtirān in lam yakun fī al-Bayān wa-in yadkhul min aḥad yaḥrumu ʿalā al-ākhar mā yamliku min ʿindihi illā wa-an yarjiʿa dhālika baʿda an yurfaʿa amr man nuẓhiruhu bi-l-ḥaqq aw mā qad ẓahara bi-l-ʿadl wa-qabla dhālika fa-la-taqrubanna laʿallakum bi-dhālika amr Allāh tarfaʿūn. Kadhālika tagharradat al-warqāʾ ʿalā al-afnān fī dhikr rabbihā al-Raḥmān. Ṭūbā li-l-sāmiʿīn.

Then consider what was revealed elsewhere, so that you may relinquish what you possess and turn toward God, the Lord of all worlds. He said: “Marriage is not lawful unless it is within the Bayán. If one of the two enters it, whatever that one possesses becomes unlawful to the other, unless the other returns, after the Cause of the One We shall manifest in truth, or what has appeared in justice, has been raised up. Before that, you must draw close, so that through this you may exalt the Cause of God.” Thus has the Dove sung upon the branches in remembrance of her Lord, the All-Merciful. Blessed are those who listen.

141
