یا ملاء البیان اقسمکم بربّکم الرّحمن بأن تنظروا فیما نزّل بالحقّ بعین الانصاف و لا تکوننّ من الّذین یرون برهان اللّه و ینکرونه الا انّهم من الهالکین قد صرّح نقطة البیان فی هذه الآیة بارتفاع امری قبل امره یشهد بذلک کلّ منصف علیمٍ کما ترونه الیوم انّه ارتفع علی شأن لا ینکره الا الّذین سکرت ابصارهم فی الأولی و فی الأخری لهم عذاب مهین

Yā malaʾa al-Bayān, uqsimukum bi-rabbikumu al-Raḥmān bi-an tanẓurū fīmā nuzzila bi-al-ḥaqq bi-ʿayni al-inṣāf wa-lā takūnunna mina alladhīna yarawna burhāna Allāh wa-yunkirūnahu. Alā innahum mina al-hālikīn. Qad ṣarraḥa Nuqṭatu al-Bayān fī hādhihi al-āyah bi-irtifāʿi amrī qabla amrihi, yashhadu bi-dhālika kullu munṣifin ʿalīm, kamā tarawnahu al-yawma innahu irtafaʿa ʿalā shaʾnin lā yunkiruhu illā alladhīna sakirat abṣāruhum fī al-ūlā wa-fī al-ukhrā lahum ʿadhābun muhīn.

O people of the Bayán! I implore you by your Lord, the All-Merciful, to look with fairness upon what has been revealed in truth, and not to be among those who see the proof of God yet deny it. They are indeed among those who perish. In this verse, the Point of the Bayán explicitly declared that My Cause would be exalted before His own. Every fair-minded, knowledgeable person bears witness to this, just as you see today that it has been exalted to a degree that none deny except those whose sight is bewildered in this world; in the next, a humiliating punishment awaits them.

142

قل تاللّه انّی لمحبوبه و الان یسمع ما ینزل من سمآء الوحی و ینوح بما ارتکبتم فی ایّامه خافوا اللّه و لا تکوننّ من المعتدین قل یا قوم ان لن تؤمنوا به لا تعترضوا علیه تاللّه یکفی ما اجتمع علیه من جنود الظّالمین

Qul ta-Allāhi innī la-maḥbūbuhu wa-al-āna yasmaʿu mā yanzilu min samāʾi al-waḥy wa-yanūḥu bi-mā irtakabtum fī ayyāmihi. Khāfū Allāh wa-lā takūnunna mina al-muʿtadīn. Qul yā qawmi in lan tuʾminū bihi lā taʿtariḍū ʿalayhi. Ta-Allāhi yakfī mā ijtamaʿa ʿalayhi min junūdi al-ẓālimīn.

Say: By God, I am indeed His Beloved, and He now hears what descends from the heaven of revelation and laments what you have committed in His days. Fear God, and do not be among the transgressors. Say: O people! If you will not believe in Him, do not oppose Him. By God, the hosts of oppressors already arrayed against Him are enough.

143

انّه قد انزل بعض الأحکام لئلّا یتحرّک القلم الأعلی فی هذا الظّهور الاّ علی ذکر مقاماته العلیا و منظره الأسنی و انّا لمّا اردنا الفضل فصّلناها بالحقّ و خفّفنا ما اردناه لکم انّه لهو الفضّال الکریم

Innahu qad anzala baʿḍa al-aḥkām li-allā yataḥarraka al-Qalamu al-Aʿlā fī hādhā al-ẓuhūr illā ʿalā dhikri maqāmātihi al-ʿulyā wa-manẓarihi al-asnā. Wa-innā lammā aradnā al-faḍla faṣṣalnāhā bi-al-ḥaqq wa-khaffafnā mā aradnāhu lakum. Innahu la-huwa al-Faḍḍālu al-Karīm.

He revealed certain laws so that, in this Revelation, the Most Exalted Pen would move only to mention His highest stations and His most radiant appearance. Yet when We desired to bestow Our bounty, We set them out in truth and lightened what We had intended for you. He is indeed the Bountiful, the Generous.

144

قد اخبرکم من قبل بما ینطق به هذا الذّکر الحکیم قال و قوله الحقّ انّه ینطق فی کلّ شأن انّه لا اله الاّ انا الفرد الواحد العلیم الخبیر هذا مقام خصّه اللّه لهذا الظّهور الممتنع البدیع هذا من فضل اللّه ان انتم من العارفین هذا من امره المبرم و اسمه الأعظم و کلمته العلیا و مطلع اسمائه الحسنی لو انتم من العالمین بل به تظهر المطالع و المشارق تفکروا یا قومِ فیما نزّل بالحقّ و تدبّروا فیه و لا تکوننّ من المعتدین

Qad akhbarakum min qablu bi-mā yanṭiqu bihi hādhā al-Dhikru al-Ḥakīm. Qāla wa-qawluhu al-ḥaqq: innahu yanṭiqu fī kulli shaʾnin innahu lā ilāha illā anā al-Fardu al-Wāḥidu al-ʿAlīmu al-Khabīr. Hādhā maqāmun khaṣṣahu Allāhu li-hādhā al-ẓuhūri al-mumtaniʿi al-badīʿ. Hādhā min faḍli Allāh in antum mina al-ʿārifīn. Hādhā min amrihi al-mubram wa-ismihi al-aʿẓam wa-kalimatihi al-ʿulyā wa-maṭlaʿi asmāʾihi al-ḥusnā law antum mina al-ʿālimīn. Bal bihi taẓharu al-maṭāliʿu wa-al-mashāriq. Tafakkarū yā qawmi fīmā nuzzila bi-al-ḥaqq wa-tadabbarū fīhi wa-lā takūnunna mina al-muʿtadīn.

He previously informed you of what this wise Remembrance would proclaim. He said—and His word is the truth—“He proclaims in every circumstance: ‘There is no God but Me, the Single, the One, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed.’” This is a station God has reserved for this inaccessible, wondrous Revelation. This is from the bounty of God, if you are among those who recognize. This proceeds from His irrevocable command, His Greatest Name, His most exalted Word, and the Dawning-Place of His most beautiful names, if you are among those who know. Indeed, through Him the dawning-places and daysprings appear. Reflect, O people, on what has been revealed in truth, ponder it, and do not be among the transgressors.

145

عاشروا مع الأدیان بالرّوح و الرّیحان لیجدوا منکم عرف الرّحمن ایّاکم ان تأخذکم حمیّة الجاهلیّة بین البریّة کلّ بدء من اللّه و یعود الیه انّه لمبدء الخلق و مرجع العالمین

ʿĀshirū maʿa al-adyān bi-al-rūḥi wa-al-rayḥān li-yajidū minkum ʿarfa al-Raḥmān. Iyyākum an taʾkhudhakum ḥamiyyatu al-jāhiliyyah bayna al-bariyyah. Kullun badaʾa mina Allāh wa-yaʿūdu ilayhi. Innahu la-mabdaʾu al-khalqi wa-marjiʿu al-ʿālamīn.

Associate with the followers of all religions in joy and fellowship, so that they may perceive from you the fragrance of the All-Merciful. Beware lest the zealotry of ignorance seize you among the people. All have originated from God and return to Him. He is indeed the source of creation and the One to whom all worlds return.

146

ایّاکم ان تدخلوا بیتاً عند فقدان صاحبه الاّ بعد اذنه تمسّکوا بالمعروف فی کلّ الأحوال و لا تکوننّ من الغافلین

Iyyākum an tadkhulū baytan ʿinda fuqdāni ṣāḥibihi illā baʿda idhnihi. Tamassakū bi-al-maʿrūfi fī kulli al-aḥwāl wa-lā takūnunna mina al-ghāfilīn.

Beware of entering a house in its owner’s absence without first obtaining permission. Adhere to what is right in all circumstances, and do not be among the heedless.

147

قد کتب علیکم تزکیة الاقوات و ما دونها بالزّکوة هذا ما حکم به منزل الآیات فی هذا الرّقّ المنیع سوف نفصّل لکم نصابها اذا شآء اللّه و اراد انّه یفصّل ما یشآء بعلم من عنده انّه لهو العلاّم الحکیم

Qad kutiba ʿalaykum tazkiyatu al-aqwāti wa-mā dūnahā bi-al-zakāh. Hādhā mā ḥakama bihi Munzilu al-Āyāt fī hādhā al-raqqi al-manīʿ. Sawfa nufaṣṣilu lakum niṣābahā idhā shāʾa Allāhu wa-arād. Innahu yufaṣṣilu mā yashāʾu bi-ʿilmin min ʿindihi. Innahu la-huwa al-ʿAllāmu al-Ḥakīm.

You are required to purify your provisions and other possessions through the payment of zakát. This is what the Revealer of the Verses has decreed in this exalted parchment. We will set out its minimum assessment for you when God wishes and wills. He sets out whatever He wishes through knowledge from His own presence. He is indeed the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

148

لا یحلّ السّؤال و من سئل حرّم علیه العطآء قد کتب علی الکّل ان یکسب و الّذی عجز فللوکلآء و الأغنیآء ان یعینوا له ما یکفیه اعملوا حدود اللّه و سننه ثمّ احفظوها کما تحفظون اعینکم و لا تکوننّ من الخاسرین

Lā yaḥillu al-suʾālu wa-man suʾila ḥurrima ʿalayhi al-ʿaṭāʾ. Qad kutiba ʿalā al-kulli an yaksiba wa-alladhī ʿajaza fa-li-al-wukalāʾi wa-al-aghniyāʾi an yuʿīnū lahu mā yakfīhi. Iʿmalū ḥudūda Allāhi wa-sunanahu thumma iḥfaẓūhā kamā taḥfaẓūna aʿyunakum wa-lā takūnunna mina al-khāsirīn.

Begging is not permitted, and giving to one who begs is forbidden. Everyone is required to earn a living. For anyone unable to do so, it is for the trustees and the wealthy to provide what is sufficient. Observe God’s laws and ordinances, and guard them as you guard your own eyes. Do not be among those who suffer loss.

149

قد منعتم فی الکتاب عن الجدال و النّزاع و الضّرب و امثالها عمّا تحزن به الافئدة و القلوب من یحزن احداً فله ان ینفق تسعة عشر مثقالاً من الذّهب هذا ما حکم به مولی العالمین انّه قد عفا ذلک عنکم فی هذا الظّهور و یوصیکم بالبرّ و التّقوی امراً من عنده فی هذا اللّوح المنیر لا ترضوا لأحدٍ ما لا ترضونه لانفسکم اتّقوا اللّه و لا تکوننّ من المتکبّرین کلّکم خلقتم من المآء و ترجعون الی التّراب تفکّروا فی عواقبکم و لا تکوننّ من الظّالمین اسمعوا ما تتلو السّدرة علیکم من آیات اللّه انّها لقسطاس الهدی من اللّه ربّ الآخرة و الأولی و بها تطیر النّفوس الی مطلع الوحی و تستضئی افئدة المقبلین تلک حدود اللّه قد فرضت علیکم و تلک اوامر اللّه قد امرتم بها فی اللّوح اعملوا بالرّوح و الرّیحان هذا خیر لکم ان انتم من العارفین

Qad muniʿtum fī al-kitābi ʿani al-jidāli wa-al-nizāʿi wa-al-ḍarbi wa-amthālihā ʿammā taḥzanu bihi al-afʾidatu wa-al-qulūb. Man yuḥzin aḥadan fa-lahu an yunfiqa tisʿata ʿashara mithqālan mina al-dhahab. Hādhā mā ḥakama bihi Mawlā al-ʿālamīn. Innahu qad ʿafā dhālika ʿankum fī hādhā al-ẓuhūr wa-yūṣīkum bi-al-birri wa-al-taqwā amran min ʿindihi fī hādhā al-lawḥi al-munīr. Lā tarḍaw li-aḥadin mā lā tarḍawnahu li-anfusikum. Ittaqū Allāh wa-lā takūnunna mina al-mutakabbirīn. Kullukum khuliqtum mina al-māʾi wa-tarjiʿūna ilā al-turāb. Tafakkarū fī ʿawāqibikum wa-lā takūnunna mina al-ẓālimīn. Ismaʿū mā tatlū al-Sidratu ʿalaykum min āyāti Allāh. Innahā la-qisṭāsu al-hudā mina Allāhi Rabbi al-ākhirati wa-al-ūlā wa-bihā taṭīru al-nufūsu ilā maṭlaʿi al-waḥyi wa-tastaḍīʾu afʾidatu al-muqbilīn. Tilka ḥudūdu Allāhi qad furiḍat ʿalaykum wa-tilka awāmiru Allāhi qad umirtum bihā fī al-lawḥ. Iʿmalū bi-al-rūḥi wa-al-rayḥān. Hādhā khayrun lakum in antum mina al-ʿārifīn.

In the Book you have been forbidden to engage in argument, conflict, violence, and similar acts that bring sorrow to hearts and souls. Whoever causes another sorrow is to expend nineteen mithqáls of gold. This is what the Lord of all worlds has decreed. In this Revelation He has relieved you of that obligation and enjoins goodness and piety upon you as a command from Him in this luminous Tablet. Do not wish for anyone what you would not wish for yourselves. Fear God, and do not be among the arrogant. You were all created from water and will return to dust. Reflect on your ultimate fate, and do not be among the wrongdoers. Listen to the verses of God that the Lote Tree recites to you. They are indeed the standard of guidance from God, the Lord of the world to come and of this world. Through them souls soar to the Dawning-Place of revelation, and the hearts of those who turn toward Him are illumined. These are the laws of God that have been made binding upon you, and these are the commandments of God that you have been enjoined to follow in the Tablet. Observe them with joy and gladness. This is better for you, if you are among those who recognize.

150

اتلوا آیات اللّه فی کلّ صباح و مسآء انّ الّذی لم یتل لم یوف بعهد اللّه و میثاقه و الّذی اعرض عنها الیوم انّه ممّن اعرض عن اللّه فی ازل الآزال اتّقنّ اللّه یا عبادی کلّکم اجمعون لا تغرّنکم کثرة القرائة و الاعمال فی اللیل و النّهار لو یقرء احدٌ آیةٌ من الآیات بالرّوح و الرّیحان خیر له من ان یتلو بالکسالة صحف اللّه المهیمن القیوم اتلوا آیات اللّه علی قدر لا تأخذکم الکسالة و الأحزان لا تحملوا علی الأرواح ما یکسلها و یثقلها بل ما یخفّفها لتطیر باجنحة الآیات الی مطلع البینات هذا اقرب الی اللّه لو انتم تعقلون

Utlū āyāti Allāhi fī kulli ṣabāḥin wa-masāʾ. Inna alladhī lam yatlu lam yūfi bi-ʿahdi Allāhi wa-mīthāqihi wa-alladhī aʿraḍa ʿanhā al-yawma innahu mimman aʿraḍa ʿani Allāhi fī azali al-āzāl. Ittaqinna Allāha yā ʿibādī kullukum ajmaʿūn. Lā taghurrannakum kathratu al-qirāʾati wa-al-aʿmāli fī al-layli wa-al-nahār. Law yaqraʾu aḥadun āyatun mina al-āyāti bi-al-rūḥi wa-al-rayḥān khayrun lahu min an yatluwa bi-al-kasālati ṣuḥufa Allāhi al-Muhaymini al-Qayyūm. Utlū āyāti Allāhi ʿalā qadrin lā taʾkhudhukumu al-kasālatu wa-al-aḥzān. Lā taḥmilū ʿalā al-arwāḥi mā yuksiluhā wa-yuthqiluhā bal mā yukhaffifuhā li-taṭīra bi-ajniḥati al-āyāti ilā maṭlaʿi al-bayyināt. Hādhā aqrabu ilā Allāhi law antum taʿqilūn.

Recite the verses of God every morning and evening. Whoever does not recite them has not fulfilled God’s covenant and pledge, and whoever turns away from them today is among those who have turned away from God from all eternity. Fear God, My servants, each and every one of you. Do not let abundant recitation and deeds by night and day delude you. For someone to read a single verse with joy and gladness is better than to read with weariness the scriptures of God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting. Recite the verses of God to such an extent that weariness and sorrow do not overtake you. Do not burden souls with what wearies and weighs them down, but rather with what lightens them, so that they may soar on the wings of the verses to the Dawning-Place of clear proofs. This is nearer to God, if you understand.

151

علّموا ذرّیاتکم ما نزّل من سمآء العظمة و الاقتدار لیقرٴوا الواح الرّحمن بحسن الألحان فی الغرف المبنیة فی مشارق الأذکار انّ الّذی اخذه جذب محبّة اسمی الرّحمن انّه یقرء آیات اللّه علی شأن تنجذب به افئدة الرّاقدین هنیئاً لمن شرب رحیق الحیوان من بیان ربّه الرّحمن بهذا الاسم الّذی به نسف کلّ جبل باذخ رفیع

ʿAllimū dhurriyyātikum mā nuzzila min samāʾi al-ʿaẓamati wa-al-iqtidār li-yaqraʾū alwāḥa al-Raḥmāni bi-ḥusni al-alḥāni fī al-ghurafi al-mabniyyati fī mashāriqi al-adhkār. Inna alladhī akhadhahu jadhbu maḥabbati ismī al-Raḥmān innahu yaqraʾu āyāti Allāhi ʿalā shaʾnin tanjadhibu bihi afʾidatu al-rāqidīn. Hanīʾan li-man shariba raḥīqa al-ḥayawāni min bayāni rabbihi al-Raḥmān bi-hādhā al-ismi alladhī bihi nusifa kullu jabalin bādhikhin rafīʿ.

Teach your children what has been revealed from the heaven of grandeur and power, so that they may recite the Tablets of the All-Merciful in beautiful melodies in the chambers built within the Dawning-Places of Remembrance. Whoever is seized by the rapture of love for My name, the All-Merciful, recites the verses of God in such a manner that the hearts of those who sleep are enraptured. Blessed is the one who has drunk the choice wine of life from the utterance of his Lord, the All-Merciful, through this Name by which every lofty, towering mountain has been scattered.

152

کتب علیکم تجدید اسباب البیت بعد انقضآء تسع عشرة سنة کذلک قضی الأمر من لدن علیم خبیر انّه اراد تلطیفکم و ما عندکم اتّقوا اللّه و لا تکوننّ من الغافلین و الّذی لم یستطع عفا اللّه عنه انّه لهو الغفور الکریم

Kutiba ʿalaykum tajdīdu asbābi al-bayti baʿda inqiḍāʾi tisʿa ʿashrata sanah. Kadhālika quḍiya al-amru min ladun ʿalīmin khabīr. Innahu arāda talṭīfakum wa-mā ʿindakum. Ittaqū Allāha wa-lā takūnunna mina al-ghāfilīn. Wa-alladhī lam yastaṭiʿ ʿafā Allāhu ʿanhu. Innahu la-huwa al-Ghafūru al-Karīm.

You are required to renew your household furnishings after nineteen years have elapsed. Thus has the matter been decreed by One who is All-Knowing, All-Informed. He desires refinement for you and for what you possess. Fear God, and do not be among the heedless. Whoever is unable to do so is excused by God. He is indeed the All-Forgiving, the Generous.

153

اغسلوا ارجلکم کلّ یوم فی الصّیف و فی الشّتآء کلّ ثلثة ایّام مرّة واحدة

Ighsilū arjulakum kulla yawmin fī al-ṣayfi wa-fī al-shitāʾi kulla thalāthati ayyāmin marratan wāḥidah.

Wash your feet every day in summer, and once every three days in winter.

154

و من اغتاظ علیکم قابلوه بالرّفق و الّذی زجرکم لا تزجروه دعوه بنفسه و توکّلوا علی اللّه المنتقم العادل القدیر

Wa-man ightāẓa ʿalaykum qābilūhu bi-al-rifqi wa-alladhī zajarakum lā tazjurūhu. Daʿūhu bi-nafsihi wa-tawakkalū ʿalā Allāhi al-Muntaqimi al-ʿĀdili al-Qadīr.

Meet anyone who is angry with you with gentleness, and do not rebuke anyone who rebukes you. Leave that person alone, and put your trust in God, the Avenger, the Just, the All-Powerful.

155

قد منعتم عن الارتقآء الی المنابر من اراد ان یتلو علیکم الآیات ربّه فلیقعد علی الکرسی الموضوع علی السّریر و یذکر اللّه ربّه و ربّ العالمین قد احبّ اللّه جلوسکم علی السّرر و الکراسی لعزّ ما عندکم من حبّ اللّه و مطلع امره المشرق المنیر

Qad muniʿtum ʿani al-irtiqāʾi ilā al-manābir. Man arāda an yatluwa ʿalaykumu al-āyāti rabbihi fa-l-yaqʿud ʿalā al-kursiyyi al-mawḍūʿi ʿalā al-sarīri wa-yadhkuri Allāha rabbahu wa-rabba al-ʿālamīn. Qad aḥabba Allāhu julūsakum ʿalā al-sururi wa-al-karāsī li-ʿizzi mā ʿindakum min ḥubbi Allāhi wa-maṭlaʿi amrihi al-mushriqi al-munīr.

You have been forbidden to ascend pulpits. Anyone who wishes to recite the verses of his Lord to you should sit on a chair placed upon a platform and remember God, his Lord and the Lord of all worlds. God has wished you to sit on platforms and chairs, in honor of the love you bear for God and for the radiant, luminous Dawning-Place of His Cause.

156

حرّم علیکم المیسر و الأفیون اجتنبوا یا معشر الخلق و لا تکوننّ من المتجاوزین ایّاکم ان تستعملوا ما تکسل به هیاکلکم و یضرّ ابدانکم انّا ما اردنا لکم الا ما ینفعکم یشهد بذلک کلّ الأشیآء لو انتم تسمعون

Ḥurrima ʿalaykumu al-maysiru wa-al-afyūn. Ijtanibū yā maʿshara al-khalqi wa-lā takūnunna mina al-mutajāwizīn. Iyyākum an tastaʿmilū mā taksalu bihi hayākilukum wa-yaḍurru abdānakum. Innā mā aradnā lakum illā mā yanfaʿukum. Yashhadu bi-dhālika kullu al-ashyāʾi law antum tasmaʿūn.

Gambling and opium have been forbidden to you. Avoid them, O people of creation, and do not be among those who overstep the bounds. Beware of using anything that makes your bodies sluggish and harms them. We have desired for you only what benefits you. All things bear witness to this, if you listen.

157

اذا دعیتم الی الولآئم و العزائم اجیبوا بالفرح و الانبساط و الّذی وفی بالوعد انّه امن من الوعید هذا یوم فیه فصّل کلّ امر حکیم

Idhā duʿītum ilā al-walāʾimi wa-al-ʿazāʾimi ajībū bi-al-faraḥi wa-al-inbisāṭ. Wa-alladhī wafā bi-al-waʿdi innahu amina mina al-waʿīd. Hādhā yawmun fīhi fuṣṣila kullu amrin ḥakīm.

When you are invited to feasts and festive gatherings, respond with joy and delight. Whoever keeps a promise is safe from the threat of punishment. This is a day on which every wise decree has been set out.

158

قد ظهر سرّ التّنکیس لرمز الرّئیس طوبی لمن ایده اللّه علی الاقرار بالسّتّة الّتی ارتفعت بهذا الألف القائمة الا انّه من المخلصین کم من ناسک اعرض و کم من تارک اقبل و قال لک الحمد یا مقصود العالمین انّ الأمر بید اللّه یعطی من یشآء ما یشآء و یمنع عمّن یشآء ما اراد یعلم خافیة القلوب و ما یتحرّک به اعین اللّامزین کم من غافلٍ اقبل بالخلوص اقعدناه علی سریر القبول و کم من عاقل رجعناه الی النّار عدلا من عندنا انّا کنّا حاکمین انّه لمظهر یفعل اللّه ما یشآء و المستقرّ علی عرش یحکم ما یرید

Qad ẓahara sirru al-tankīsi li-ramzi al-raʾīs. Ṭūbā li-man ayyadahu Allāhu ʿalā al-iqrāri bi-al-sittati allatī irtafaʿat bi-hādhihi al-alifi al-qāʾimah. Alā innahu mina al-mukhliṣīn. Kam min nāsikin aʿraḍa wa-kam min tārikٍ aqbala wa-qāla laka al-ḥamdu yā Maqṣūda al-ʿālamīn. Inna al-amra bi-yadi Allāh yuʿṭī man yashāʾu mā yashāʾu wa-yamnaʿu ʿamman yashāʾu mā arād. Yaʿlamu khāfiyata al-qulūbi wa-mā tataḥarraku bihi aʿyunu al-lāmizīn. Kam min ghāfilin aqbala bi-al-khulūṣi aqʿadnāhu ʿalā sarīri al-qabūli wa-kam min ʿāqilin rajaʿnāhu ilā al-nāri ʿadlan min ʿindinā. Innā kunnā ḥākimīn. Innahu la-maẓharu yafʿalu Allāhu mā yashāʾu wa-al-mustaqirru ʿalā ʿarshi yaḥkumu mā yurīd.

The mystery of the inversion in the symbol of the Chief has been revealed. Blessed is the one whom God has enabled to acknowledge the six raised up by this upright alif. He is indeed among the sincere. How many a devout worshipper has turned away, and how many a neglectful one has turned toward Him and said, “Praise be to You, O Desire of all worlds!” The matter is in God’s hands: He gives to whomever He wishes whatever He wishes, and withholds from whomever He wishes whatever He wills. He knows what hearts conceal and what moves the eyes of those who find fault. How many a heedless person who turned toward Us with sincerity have We seated upon the throne of acceptance, and how many a learned person have We consigned to the fire, in justice on Our part. We have indeed been the judge. He is indeed the manifestation of “God does whatever He wishes” and the One established upon the throne of “He decrees whatever He wills.”

159

طوبی لمن وجد عرف المعانی من اثر هذا القلم الّذی اذا تحرّک فاحت نسمة اللّه فیما سواه و اذا توقّف ظهرت کینونة الاطمینان فی الامکان تعالی الرّحمن مظهر هذا الفضل العظیم قل بما حمل الظّلم ظهر العدل فیما سواه و بما قبل الذّلّة لاح عزّ اللّه بین العالمین

Ṭūbā li-man wajada ʿarfa al-maʿānī min athari hādhā al-qalami alladhī idhā taḥarraka fāḥat nasmatu Allāhi fīmā siwāhu wa-idhā tawaqqafa ẓaharat kaynūnatu al-iṭmiʾnāni fī al-imkān. Taʿālā al-Raḥmānu muẓhiru hādhā al-faḍli al-ʿaẓīm. Qul bi-mā ḥamala al-ẓulma ẓahara al-ʿadlu fīmā siwāhu wa-bi-mā qabila al-dhillata lāḥa ʿizzu Allāhi bayna al-ʿālamīn.

Blessed is the one who has perceived the fragrance of inner meanings from the traces of this Pen, which, when it moves, spreads the breeze of God through all that is other than Him, and, when it rests, manifests the very essence of tranquillity throughout the world of being. Exalted is the All-Merciful, who manifests this great bounty. Say: Because He bore oppression, justice appeared throughout all that is other than Him, and because He accepted humiliation, the glory of God shone among all worlds.

160

حرّم علیکم حمل آلات الحرب الاّ حین الضّرورة و احلّ لکم لبس الحریر قد رفع اللّه عنکم حکم الحدّ فی اللّباس و اللّحی فضلاً من عنده انّه لهو الآمر العلیم اعملوا ما لا تنکره العقول المستقیمة و لا تجعلوا انفسکم ملعب الجاهلین طوبی لمن تزیّن بطراز الآداب و الأخلاق انّه ممّن نصر ربّه بالعمل الواضح المبین

Ḥurrima ʿalaykum ḥamlu ālāti al-ḥarbi illā ḥīna al-ḍarūrati wa-uḥilla lakum lubsu al-ḥarīr. Qad rafaʿa Allāhu ʿankum ḥukma al-ḥaddi fī al-libāsi wa-al-liḥā faḍlan min ʿindihi. Innahu la-huwa al-Āmiru al-ʿAlīm. Iʿmalū mā lā tunkiruhu al-ʿuqūlu al-mustaqīmatu wa-lā tajʿalū anfusakum malʿaba al-jāhilīn. Ṭūbā li-man tazayyana bi-ṭirāzi al-ādābi wa-al-akhlāq. Innahu mimman naṣara rabbahu bi-al-ʿamali al-wāḍiḥi al-mubīn.

You are forbidden to carry weapons except when necessary, and you are permitted to wear silk. As a bounty from Him, God has removed the restrictions on clothing and beards. He is indeed the Ordainer, the All-Knowing. Do what sound minds do not disapprove of, and do not make yourselves the playthings of the ignorant. Blessed is the one adorned with good manners and character. Such a person is among those who have aided their Lord through clear and manifest deeds.

161

عمّروا دیار اللّه و بلاده ثمّ اذکروه فیها بترنّمات المقرّبین انّما تعمّر القلوب باللّسان کما تعمّر البیوت و الدّیار بالید و اسباب آخر قد قدّرنا لکلّ شئ سبباً من عندنا تمسّکوا به و توکّلوا علی الحکیم الخبیر

ʿAmmirū diyāra Allāhi wa-bilādahu thumma udhkurūhu fīhā bi-tarannumāṭi al-muqarrabīn. Innamā tuʿammaru al-qulūbu bi-al-lisāni kamā tuʿammaru al-buyūtu wa-al-diyāru bi-al-yadi wa-asbābin ukhar. Qad qaddarnā li-kulli shayʾin sababan min ʿindinā. Tamassakū bihi wa-tawakkalū ʿalā al-Ḥakīmi al-Khabīr.

Develop God’s cities and lands, and remember Him there in the melodies of those brought near to Him. Hearts are built up through the tongue, just as houses and cities are built through the hand and other means. We have appointed a means for everything from Our own presence. Hold fast to it, and put your trust in the All-Wise, the All-Informed.

162

طوبی لمن اقرّ باللّه و آیاته و اعترف بانّه لا یسئل عمّا یفعل هذه کلمة قد جعلها اللّه طراز العقاید و اصلها و بها یقبل عمل العاملین اجعلوا هذه الکلمة نصب عیونکم لئلّا تزلّکم اشارات المعرضین

Ṭūbā li-man aqarra bi-Allāh wa-āyātihi wa-iʿtarafa bi-annahu lā yusʾalu ʿammā yafʿal. Hādhihi kalima qad jaʿalahā Allāh ṭirāz al-ʿaqāʾid wa-aṣlahā wa-bihā yuqbalu ʿamal al-ʿāmilīn. Ijʿalū hādhihi al-kalima nuṣba ʿuyūnikum li-allā tuzillakum ishārāt al-muʿriḍīn.

Blessed is the one who acknowledges God and His verses and recognizes that He is not to be questioned about what He does. This is a statement that God has made the adornment and foundation of all beliefs, and through it the deeds of those who act are accepted. Keep this statement before your eyes, so that the insinuations of those who turn away do not cause you to stumble.

163

لو یحلّ ما حرّم فی ازل الآزال او بالعکس لیس لأحد ان یعترض علیه و الّذی توقّف فی اقلّ من انٍ انّه من المعتدین

Law yuḥillu mā ḥarrama fī azal al-āzāl aw bi-l-ʿaks laysa li-aḥad an yaʿtariḍa ʿalayhi wa-alladhī tawaqqafa fī aqalla min ānin innahu min al-muʿtadīn.

Were He to make lawful what He had forbidden from all eternity, or the reverse, no one would have the right to object to Him. Whoever hesitates for less than an instant is among the transgressors.

164

و الّذی ما فاز بهذا الأصل الأسنی و المقام الأعلی تحرّکه اریاح الشّبهات و تقلّبه مقالات المشرکین من فاز بهذا الأصل قد فاز بالاستقامة الکبری حبّذا هذا المقام الأبهی الّذی بذکره زین کلّ لوح منیع کذلک یعلّمکم اللّه ما یخلّصکم عن الرّیب و الحیرة و ینجّیکم فی الدّنیا و الآخرة انّه هو الغفور الکریم هو الّذی ارسل الرّسل و انزل الکتب علی انّه لا اله الّا انا العزیز الحکیم

Wa-alladhī mā fāza bi-hādhā al-aṣl al-asnā wa-l-maqām al-aʿlā tuḥarrikuhu aryāḥ al-shubuhāt wa-tuqallibuhu maqālāt al-mushrikīn. Man fāza bi-hādhā al-aṣl qad fāza bi-l-istiqāma al-kubrā. Ḥabbadhā hādhā al-maqām al-abhā alladhī bi-dhikrihi zuyyina kull lawḥ manīʿ. Kadhālika yuʿallimukum Allāh mā yukhalliṣukum ʿan al-rayb wa-l-ḥayra wa-yunajjīkum fī al-dunyā wa-l-ākhira. Innahu huwa al-ghafūr al-karīm. Huwa alladhī arsala al-rusul wa-anzala al-kutub ʿalā annahu lā ilāha illā anā al-ʿazīz al-ḥakīm.

Whoever has not attained this most exalted principle and this highest station is shaken by the winds of doubt and tossed about by the assertions of those who associate partners with God. Whoever has attained this principle has attained the greatest steadfastness. How excellent is this most glorious station, with whose mention every exalted Tablet is adorned! Thus God teaches you what will free you from doubt and bewilderment and save you in this world and the next. He is indeed the All-Forgiving, the All-Bountiful. He is the One who sent the Messengers and revealed the Books, declaring: “There is no god but Me, the Almighty, the All-Wise.”

165

یا ارض الکاف و الرّآء انّا نراک علی ما لا یحبّه اللّه و نری منک ما لا اطّلع به احد الّا اللّه العلیم الخبیر و نجد ما یمرّ منک فی سرّ السّرّ عندنا علم کلّ شئ فی لوح مبین لا تحزنی بذلک سوف یظهر اللّه فیک اولی باس شدید یذکروننی باستقامة لا تمنعهم اشارات العلمآء و لا تحجبهم شبهات المریبین اولئک ینظرون اللّه باعینهم و ینصرونه بأنفسهم الا انّهم من الرّاسخین

Yā arḍ al-kāf wa-l-rāʾ innā narāki ʿalā mā lā yuḥibbuhu Allāh wa-narā minki mā lā iṭṭalaʿa bihi aḥad illā Allāh al-ʿalīm al-khabīr wa-najidu mā yamurru minki fī sirr al-sirr. ʿIndanā ʿilm kull shayʾ fī lawḥ mubīn. Lā taḥzanī bi-dhālika sawfa yuẓhiru Allāh fīki ulī baʾs shadīd yadhkurūnanī bi-istiqāma lā tamnaʿuhum ishārāt al-ʿulamāʾ wa-lā taḥjubuhum shubuhāt al-murībīn. Ulāʾika yanẓurūna Allāh bi-aʿyunihim wa-yanṣurūnahu bi-anfusihim alā innahum min al-rāsikhīn.

O land of Kāf and Rāʾ! We see you in a condition that God does not love, and We see from you what no one knows but God, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed. We perceive what passes within you in the deepest secrecy. With Us is the knowledge of all things in a clear Tablet. Do not grieve over this. God will soon raise up within you people of mighty strength who will remember Me with a steadfastness that neither the insinuations of the learned can hinder nor the doubts of those who sow doubt can veil. They will see God with their own eyes and aid Him with their own selves. They are indeed among those firmly established.

166

یا معشر العلمآء لمّا نزّلت الآیات و ظهرت البینات رأیناکم خلف الحجبات ان هذا الّا شئ عجاب قد افتخرتم باسمی و غفلتم عن نفسی اذ اتی الرّحمن بالحجّة و البرهان انّا خرقنا الأحجاب ایّاکم ان تحجبوا النّاس بحجاب اخر کسّروا سلاسل الأوهام باسم مالک الأنام و لا تکوننّ من الخادعین اذا اقبلتم الی اللّه و دخلتم هذا الأمر لا تفسدوا فیه و لا تقیسوا کتاب اللّه بأهوائکم هذا نصح اللّه من قبل و من بعد یشهد بذلک شهداء اللّه و اصفیائه انّا کلّ له شاهدون

Yā maʿshar al-ʿulamāʾ lammā nuzzilat al-āyāt wa-ẓaharat al-bayyināt raʾaynākum khalf al-ḥujubāt. In hādhā illā shayʾ ʿujāb. Qad iftakhartum bi-ismī wa-ghafaltum ʿan nafsī idh atā al-Raḥmān bi-l-ḥujja wa-l-burhān. Innā kharaqnā al-aḥjāb iyyākum an taḥjubū al-nās bi-ḥijāb ākhar. Kassirū salāsil al-awhām bi-ism mālik al-anām wa-lā takūnanna min al-khādiʿīn. Idhā aqbaltum ilā Allāh wa-dakhaltum hādhā al-amr lā tufsidū fīhi wa-lā taqīsū kitāb Allāh bi-ahwāʾikum. Hādhā nuṣḥ Allāh min qabl wa-min baʿd yashhadu bi-dhālika shuhadāʾ Allāh wa-aṣfiyāʾuhu innā kull lahu shāhidūn.

O company of the learned! When the verses were revealed and the clear proofs appeared, We saw you behind veils. This is truly an astonishing thing. You took pride in My name but neglected My own Self when the All-Merciful came with testimony and proof. We have torn through the veils; beware lest you veil the people with another veil. Break the chains of vain imaginings in the name of the Lord of all people, and do not be among the deceivers. When you turn to God and enter this Cause, do not spread corruption within it or measure the Book of God against your own desires. This is God’s counsel, before and hereafter. God’s witnesses and His chosen ones bear witness to this; We all bear witness to it.

167

اذکروا الشّیخ الّذی سمّی بمحمّد قبل حسن و کان من اعلم العلمآء فی عصره لمّا ظهر الحقّ اعرض عنه هو و امثاله و اقبل الی اللّه من ینقّی القمح و الشّعیر و کان یکتب علی زعمه احکام اللّه فی اللّیل و النّهار و لمّا اتی المختار ما نفعه حرف منها لو نفعه لم یعرض عن وجه به انارت وجوه المقرّبین لو آمنتم باللّه حین ظهوره ما اعرض عنه النّاس و ما ورد علینا ما ترونه الیوم اتّقوا اللّه و لا تکوننّ من الغافلین

Udhkurū al-shaykh alladhī summiya bi-Muḥammad qabla Ḥasan wa-kāna min aʿlam al-ʿulamāʾ fī ʿaṣrihi lammā ẓahara al-ḥaqq aʿraḍa ʿanhu huwa wa-amthāluhu wa-aqbala ilā Allāh man yunaqqī al-qamḥ wa-l-shaʿīr. Wa-kāna yaktubu ʿalā zaʿmihi aḥkām Allāh fī al-layl wa-l-nahār wa-lammā atā al-mukhtār mā nafaʿahu ḥarf minhā. Law nafaʿahu lam yuʿriḍ ʿan wajh bihi anārat wujūh al-muqarrabīn. Law āmantum bi-Allāh ḥīna ẓuhūrihi mā aʿraḍa ʿanhu al-nās wa-mā warada ʿalaynā mā tarawnahu al-yawm. Ittaqū Allāh wa-lā takūnanna min al-ghāfilīn.

Remember the shaykh whose name was Muḥammad followed by Ḥasan, who was among the most learned scholars of his age. When the Truth appeared, he and others like him turned away from Him, while a sifter of wheat and barley turned to God. Night and day the shaykh wrote what he imagined were the laws of God, yet when the Chosen One came, not a single letter of them benefited him. Had they benefited him, he would not have turned away from the Face through which the faces of those brought near to God were illumined. Had you believed in God when He appeared, the people would not have turned away from Him, nor would We have suffered what you see today. Fear God, and do not be among the heedless.

168

ایّاکم ان تمنعکم الأسماء عن مالکها او یحجبکم ذکر عن هذا الذّکر الحکیم استعیذوا باللّه یا معشر العلمآء و لا تجعلوا انفسکم حجاباً بینی و بین خلقی کذلک یعظکم اللّه و یأمرکم بالعدل لئلّا تحبط اعمالکم و انتم غافلون انّ الّذی اعرض عن هذا الأمر هل یقدر ان یثبت حقاً فی الابداع لا و مالک الاختراع ولکنّ النّاس فی حجاب مبین قل به اشرقت شمس الحجّة و لاح نیر البرهان لمن فی الامکان اتّقوا اللّه یا اولی الابصار و لا تنکرون ایّاکم ان یمنعکم ذکر النّبی عن هذا النّبأ الأعظم او الولایة عن ولایة اللّه المهیمنة علی العالمین قد خلق کلّ اسم بقوله و علّق کلّ امر بأمره المبرم العزیز البدیع قل هذا یوم اللّه لا یذکر فیه الاّ نفسه المهیمنة علی العالمین هذا امر اضطرب منه ما عندکم من الأوهام و التّماثیل

Iyyākum an tamnaʿakum al-asmāʾ ʿan mālikihā aw yaḥjubakum dhikr ʿan hādhā al-dhikr al-ḥakīm. Istaʿīdhū bi-Allāh yā maʿshar al-ʿulamāʾ wa-lā tajʿalū anfusakum ḥijāban baynī wa-bayna khalqī. Kadhālika yaʿiẓukum Allāh wa-yaʾmurukum bi-l-ʿadl li-allā taḥbaṭa aʿmālukum wa-antum ghāfilūn. Inna alladhī aʿraḍa ʿan hādhā al-amr hal yaqdiru an yuthbita ḥaqqan fī al-ibdāʿ lā wa-mālik al-ikhtirāʿ wa-lākinna al-nās fī ḥijāb mubīn. Qul bihi ashraqat shams al-ḥujja wa-lāḥa nayyir al-burhān li-man fī al-imkān. Ittaqū Allāh yā ulī al-abṣār wa-lā tunkirūn. Iyyākum an yamnaʿakum dhikr al-nabī ʿan hādhā al-nabaʾ al-aʿẓam aw al-wilāya ʿan wilāyat Allāh al-muhaymina ʿalā al-ʿālamīn. Qad khalaqa kull ism bi-qawlihi wa-ʿallaqa kull amr bi-amrihi al-mubram al-ʿazīz al-badīʿ. Qul hādhā yawm Allāh lā yudhkaru fīhi illā nafsuhu al-muhaymina ʿalā al-ʿālamīn. Hādhā amr iḍṭaraba minhu mā ʿindakum min al-awhām wa-l-tamāthīl.

Beware lest names keep you from their Lord, or any remembrance veil you from this wise Remembrance. Seek refuge in God, O company of the learned, and do not make yourselves a veil between Me and My creation. Thus God admonishes you and commands you to act justly, lest your deeds come to nothing while you remain unaware. Can one who has turned away from this Cause establish any truth in creation? No, by the Lord of all that has been brought into being! Yet the people are plainly veiled. Say: Through Him the sun of testimony has shone and the luminary of proof has dawned for all who dwell in the realm of existence. Fear God, you who have insight, and do not deny. Beware lest mention of the Prophet keep you from this Most Great Announcement, or guardianship from the guardianship of God, which encompasses all the worlds. He has created every name through His word and made every matter dependent on His irrevocable, mighty, wondrous command. Say: This is the Day of God, in which none is to be mentioned but His own Self, who holds sway over all the worlds. This is a Cause that has shaken the imaginings and idols you possess.

169

قد نری منکم من یأخذ الکتاب و یستدلّ به علی اللّه کما استدلّت کلّ ملّة بکتابها علی اللّه المهیمن القیوم قل تاللّه الحقّ لا تغنیکم الیوم کتب العالم و لا ما فیه من الصّحف الاّ بهذا الکتاب الّذی ینطق فی قطب الابداع انّه لا اله الاّ انا العلیم الحکیم

Qad narā minkum man yaʾkhudhu al-kitāb wa-yastadillu bihi ʿalā Allāh kamā istadallat kull milla bi-kitābihā ʿalā Allāh al-muhaymin al-qayyūm. Qul ta-Allāh al-ḥaqq lā tughnīkum al-yawm kutub al-ʿālam wa-lā mā fīhi min al-ṣuḥuf illā bi-hādhā al-kitāb alladhī yanṭiqu fī quṭb al-ibdāʿ innahu lā ilāha illā anā al-ʿalīm al-ḥakīm.

We see among you those who take the Book and use it to argue against God, just as every religious community has used its own Book to argue against God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting. Say: By God, the Truth! Today neither the books of the world nor any of its scriptures can avail you except through this Book, which proclaims at the heart of creation: “There is no god but Me, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.”

170

یا معشر العلمآء ایّاکم ان تکونوا سبب الاختلاف فی الأطراف کما کنتم علّة الاعراض فی اوّل الأمر اجمعوا النّاس علی هذه الکلمة الّتی بها صاحت الحصاة الملک للّه مطلع الآیات کذلک یعظکم اللّه فضلاً من عنده انّه لهو الغفور الکریم

Yā maʿshar al-ʿulamāʾ iyyākum an takūnū sabab al-ikhtilāf fī al-aṭrāf kamā kuntum ʿillat al-iʿrāḍ fī awwal al-amr. Ijmaʿū al-nās ʿalā hādhihi al-kalima allatī bihā ṣāḥat al-ḥaṣāh al-mulk li-Allāh maṭlaʿ al-āyāt. Kadhālika yaʿiẓukum Allāh faḍlan min ʿindihi innahu la-huwa al-ghafūr al-karīm.

O company of the learned! Beware lest you become a cause of discord throughout the lands, just as you were the cause of people turning away at the beginning of the Cause. Gather the people around this word, through which the pebbles have cried out: “Sovereignty belongs to God, the Dawning-Place of the verses.” Thus God admonishes you as a bounty from His presence. He is indeed the All-Forgiving, the All-Bountiful.

171

اذکروا الکریم اذ دعوناه الی اللّه انّه استکبر بما اتّبع هواه بعد اذ ارسلنا الیه ما قرّت به عین البرهان فی الامکان و تمّت حجّة اللّه علی من فی السّموات و الأرضین انّا امرناه بالاقبال فضلا من الغنی المتعال انّه ولی مدبراً الی ان اخذته زبانیة العذاب عدلا من اللّه انّا کنّا شاهدین

Udhkurū al-Karīm idh daʿawnāhu ilā Allāh innahu istakbara bi-mā ittabaʿa hawāhu baʿda idh arsalnā ilayhi mā qarrat bihi ʿayn al-burhān fī al-imkān wa-tammat ḥujjat Allāh ʿalā man fī al-samāwāt wa-l-araḍīn. Innā amarnāhu bi-l-iqbāl faḍlan min al-ghaniyy al-mutaʿāl. Innahu wallā mudbiran ilā an akhadhat-hu zabāniyat al-ʿadhāb ʿadlan min Allāh innā kunnā shāhidīn.

Remember Karīm when We called him to God. He grew arrogant, following his own desires, after We had sent him that which gladdened the eye of proof in the realm of existence and completed God’s testimony to all who dwell in the heavens and the earth. We commanded him to turn toward Us, as a bounty from the All-Sufficient, the Most Exalted. He turned his back until the wardens of torment seized him, as an act of justice from God. We were indeed witnesses.

172

اخرقنّ الأحجاب علی شأن یسمع اهل الملکوت صوت خرقها هذا امر اللّه من قبل و من بعد طوبی لمن عمل بما امر ویلٌ للتّارکین

Ikhriqanna al-aḥjāb ʿalā shaʾn yasmaʿu ahl al-malakūt ṣawt kharqihā. Hādhā amr Allāh min qabl wa-min baʿd. Ṭūbā li-man ʿamila bi-mā umira waylun li-l-tārikīn.

Tear through the veils so that the inhabitants of the Kingdom hear the sound of their tearing. This is God’s command, before and hereafter. Blessed is the one who acts as commanded; woe to those who neglect it.

173

انّا ما اردنا فی الملک الاّ ظهور اللّه و سلطانه و کفی باللّه علی شهیداً انّا ما اردنا فی الملکوت الاّ علوّ امر اللّه و ثنائه و کفی باللّه علی وکیلا انّا ما اردنا فی الجبروت الاّ ذکر اللّه و ما نزّل من عنده و کفی باللّه معینا

Innā mā aradnā fī al-mulk illā ẓuhūr Allāh wa-sulṭānahu wa-kafā bi-Allāh ʿalayya shahīdan. Innā mā aradnā fī al-malakūt illā ʿuluww amr Allāh wa-thanāʾihi wa-kafā bi-Allāh ʿalayya wakīlan. Innā mā aradnā fī al-jabarūt illā dhikr Allāh wa-mā nuzzila min ʿindihi wa-kafā bi-Allāh muʿīnan.

In the earthly realm, We have desired only the manifestation of God and His sovereignty, and God is sufficient as a witness over Me. In the Kingdom, We have desired only the exaltation of God’s Cause and His praise, and God is sufficient as My guardian. In the realm of power, We have desired only the remembrance of God and what has been sent down from His presence, and God is sufficient as a helper.

174

طوبی لکم یا معشر العلمآء فی البهآء تاللّه انتم امواج البحر الأعظم و انجم سمآء الفضل و الویة النّصر بین السّموات و الأرضین انتم مطالع الاستقامة بین البریة و مشارق البیان لمن فی الامکان طوبی لمن اقبل الیکم ویل للمعرضین ینبغی الیوم لمن شرب رحیق الحیوان من ید الطاف ربّه الرّحمن ان یکون نبّاضاً کالشّریان فی جسد الامکان لیتحرّک به العالم و کلّ عظم رمیم

Ṭūbā lakum yā maʿshar al-ʿulamāʾ fī al-Bahāʾ. Ta-Allāh antum amwāj al-baḥr al-aʿẓam wa-anjum samāʾ al-faḍl wa-alwiyat al-naṣr bayna al-samāwāt wa-l-araḍīn. Antum maṭāliʿ al-istiqāma bayna al-bariyya wa-mashāriq al-bayān li-man fī al-imkān. Ṭūbā li-man aqbala ilaykum waylun li-l-muʿriḍīn. Yanbaghī al-yawm li-man shariba raḥīq al-ḥayawān min yad alṭāf rabbihi al-Raḥmān an yakūna nabbāḍan ka-l-shiryān fī jasad al-imkān li-yataḥarraka bihi al-ʿālam wa-kull ʿaẓm ramīm.

Blessed are you, O company of the learned in Bahā! By God, you are the waves of the Most Great Ocean, the stars of the heaven of bounty, and the banners of victory between the heavens and the earth. You are the dawning-places of steadfastness among creation and the daysprings of utterance for all who dwell in the realm of existence. Blessed is the one who turns toward you; woe to those who turn away. Today, whoever has drunk the choice wine of life from the hand of the loving kindness of his Lord, the All-Merciful, should pulse like an artery in the body of existence, so that through him the world and every crumbling bone may be stirred to life.

175

یا اهل الانشآء اذا طارت الورقاء عن ایک الثّنآء و قصدت المقصد الأقصی الأخفی ارجعوا ما لا عرفتموه من الکتاب الی الفرع المنشعب من هذا الأصل القویم

Yā ahl al-inshāʾ idhā ṭārat al-warqāʾ ʿan ayk al-thanāʾ wa-qaṣadat al-maqṣad al-aqṣā al-akhfā irjiʿū mā lā ʿaraftumūhu min al-kitāb ilā al-farʿ al-munshaʿib min hādhā al-aṣl al-qawīm.

O people of creation! When the Dove has flown from the grove of praise and made its way to the farthest, most hidden destination, refer whatever you have not understood in the Book to the Branch that has sprung from this firmly established Root.

176

یا قلم الأعلی تحرّک علی اللّوح باذن ربّک فاطر السّمآء ثمّ اذکر اذ اراد مطلع التّوحید مکتب التّجرید لعلّ الاحرار یطّلعنّ علی قدر سمّ الابرة بما هو خلف الأستار من اسرار ربّک العزیز العلاّم قل انّا دخلنا مکتب المعانی و التّبیان حین غفلة من فی الامکان و شاهدنا ما انزله الرّحمن و قبلنا ما اهداه لی من آیات اللّه المهیمن القیوم و سمعنا ما شهد به فی اللّوح انّا کنّا شاهدین و اجبناه بأمر من عندنا انّا کنّا آمرین

Yā qalam al-aʿlā taḥarrak ʿalā al-lawḥ bi-idhn rabbika fāṭir al-samāʾ thumma udhkur idh arāda maṭlaʿ al-tawḥīd maktab al-tajrīd laʿalla al-aḥrār yaṭṭaliʿunna ʿalā qadr samm al-ibra bi-mā huwa khalf al-astār min asrār rabbika al-ʿazīz al-ʿallām. Qul innā dakhalnā maktab al-maʿānī wa-l-tibyān ḥīna ghaflat man fī al-imkān wa-shāhadnā mā anzalahu al-Raḥmān wa-qabilnā mā ahdāhu lī min āyāt Allāh al-muhaymin al-qayyūm wa-samiʿnā mā shahida bihi fī al-lawḥ innā kunnā shāhidīn wa-ajabnāhu bi-amr min ʿindinā innā kunnā āmirīn.

O Most Exalted Pen! Move across the Tablet by permission of your Lord, the Creator of heaven. Then recount when the Dawning-Place of Divine Unity set out for the school of detachment, so that the free may glimpse, to the extent of a needle’s eye, the mysteries of your Lord, the Almighty, the All-Knowing, that lie behind the veils. Say: We entered the school of inner meanings and exposition while those in the realm of existence were heedless. We beheld what the All-Merciful had sent down and accepted what He offered Me as a gift of the verses of God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting. We heard what He testified to in the Tablet; We were indeed witnesses. And We answered Him with a command from Our presence; We were indeed the One who commanded.

177

یا ملاء البیان انّا دخلنا مکتب اللّه اذ انتم راقدون و لاحظنا اللّوح اذ انتم نائمون تاللّه الحقّ قد قرئناه قبل نزوله و انتم غافلون قد احطنا الکتاب اذ کنتم فی الأصلاب هذا ذکری علی قدرکم لا علی قدر اللّه یشهد بذلک ما فی علم اللّه لو انتم تعرفون و یشهد بذلک لسان اللّه لو انتم تفقهون تاللّه لو نکشف الحجاب انتم تنصعقون

Yā malaʾ al-bayān innā dakhalnā maktab Allāh idh antum rāqidūn wa-lāḥaẓnā al-lawḥ idh antum nāʾimūn. Ta-Allāh al-ḥaqq qad qaraʾnāhu qabla nuzūlihi wa-antum ghāfilūn. Qad aḥaṭnā al-kitāb idh kuntum fī al-aṣlāb. Hādhā dhikrī ʿalā qadrikum lā ʿalā qadr Allāh yashhadu bi-dhālika mā fī ʿilm Allāh law antum taʿrifūn wa-yashhadu bi-dhālika lisān Allāh law antum tafqahūn. Ta-Allāh law nakshif al-ḥijāb antum tanṣaʿiqūn.

O people of the Bayān! We entered the school of God while you lay sleeping, and We examined the Tablet while you slumbered. By God, the Truth! We read it before it was revealed, while you were heedless. We encompassed the Book while you were still in the loins of your fathers. This account of Mine is according to your capacity, not according to God’s measure. What is in the knowledge of God bears witness to this, if only you knew, and the Tongue of God bears witness to it, if only you understood. By God! Were We to lift the veil, you would be struck senseless.

178

ایّاکم ان تجادلوا فی اللّه و امره انّه ظهر علی شأن احاط ما کان و ما یکون لو نتکلّم فی هذا المقام بلسان اهل الملکوت لنقول قد خلق اللّه ذلک المکتب قبل خلق السّموات و الأرض و دخلنا فیه قبل ان یقترن الکاف برکنها النّون هذا لسان عبادی فی ملکوتی تفکّروا فیما ینطق به لسان اهل جبروتی بما علّمناهم علما من لدنّا و ما کان مستورا فی علم اللّه و ما ینطق به لسان العظمة و الاقتدار فی مقامه المحمود

Iyyākum an tujādilū fī Allāh wa-amrihi innahu ẓahara ʿalā shaʾn aḥāṭa mā kāna wa-mā yakūn. Law natakallam fī hādhā al-maqām bi-lisān ahl al-malakūt la-naqūl qad khalaqa Allāh dhālika al-maktab qabla khalq al-samāwāt wa-l-arḍ wa-dakhalnā fīhi qabla an yaqtarina al-kāf bi-ruknihā al-nūn. Hādhā lisān ʿibādī fī malakūtī tafakkarū fīmā yanṭiqu bihi lisān ahl jabarūtī bi-mā ʿallamnāhum ʿilman min ladunnā wa-mā kāna mastūran fī ʿilm Allāh wa-mā yanṭiqu bihi lisān al-ʿaẓama wa-l-iqtidār fī maqāmihi al-maḥmūd.

Beware of disputing about God and His Cause. He has appeared in such a manner as to encompass all that has been and all that will be. Were We to speak of this matter in the language of the inhabitants of the Kingdom, We would say: God created that school before creating the heavens and the earth, and We entered it before the Kāf was joined to its counterpart, the Nūn. This is the language of My servants in My Kingdom. Reflect on what the tongue of the inhabitants of My realm of power utters through the knowledge We have taught them from Our presence, on what has been concealed in God’s knowledge, and on what the Tongue of grandeur and power utters in its praiseworthy station.

179

لیس هذا امر تلعبون به بأوهامکم و لیس هذا مقام یدخل فیه کلّ جبان موهوم تاللّه هذا مضمار المکاشفة و الانقطاع و میدان المشاهدة و الارتفاع لا یجول فیه الاّ فوارس الرّحمن الّذین نبذوا الامکان اولئک انصار اللّه فی الأرض و مشارق الاقتدار بین العالمین

Laysa hādhā amr talʿabūna bihi bi-awhāmikum wa-laysa hādhā maqām yadkhulu fīhi kull jabān mawhūm. Ta-Allāh hādhā miḍmār al-mukāshafa wa-l-inqiṭāʿ wa-maydān al-mushāhada wa-l-irtifāʿ lā yajūlu fīhi illā fawāris al-Raḥmān alladhīna nabadhū al-imkān. Ulāʾika anṣār Allāh fī al-arḍ wa-mashāriq al-iqtidār bayna al-ʿālamīn.

This is not a Cause with which you may toy through your imaginings, nor is this a station that every deluded coward may enter. By God! This is the course of unveiling and detachment, the arena of vision and ascent. None may ride within it but the horsemen of the All-Merciful who have cast aside the realm of existence. They are God’s helpers on earth and the daysprings of power among the worlds.

180

ایّاکم ان یمنعکم ما فی البیان عن ربّکم الرّحمن تاللّه انّه قد نزّل لذکری لو انتم تعرفون لا یجد منه المخلصون الاّ عرف حبّی و اسمی المهیمن علی کلّ شاهد و مشهود قل یا قوم توجّهوا الی ما نزّل من قلمی الأعلی ان وجدتم منه عرف اللّه لا تعترضوا علیه و لا تمنعوا انفسکم عن فضل اللّه و الطافه کذلک ینصحکم اللّه انّه لهو النّاصح العلیم

Iyyākum an yamnaʿakum mā fī al-bayān ʿan rabbikum al-Raḥmān. Ta-Allāh innahu qad nuzzila li-dhikrī law antum taʿrifūn. Lā yajidu minhu al-mukhliṣūn illā ʿarf ḥubbī wa-ismī al-muhaymin ʿalā kull shāhid wa-mashhūd. Qul yā qawm tawajjahū ilā mā nuzzila min qalamī al-aʿlā in wajadtum minhu ʿarf Allāh lā taʿtariḍū ʿalayhi wa-lā tamnaʿū anfusakum ʿan faḍl Allāh wa-alṭāfihi. Kadhālika yanṣaḥukum Allāh innahu la-huwa al-nāṣiḥ al-ʿalīm.

Beware lest what is in the Bayān keep you from your Lord, the All-Merciful. By God! It was sent down to make mention of Me, if only you knew. The sincere find in it only the fragrance of My love and of My name, which holds sway over all who witness and all that is witnessed. Say: O people! Turn toward what has been sent down from My Most Exalted Pen. If you find in it the fragrance of God, do not object to it or deprive yourselves of God’s bounty and loving kindness. Thus God counsels you. He is indeed the All-Knowing Counsellor.

181

ما لا عرفتموه من البیان فاسئلوا اللّه ربّکم و ربّ ابائکم الأوّلین انّه لو یشآء یبین لکم ما نزّل فیه و ما ستر فی بحر کلماته من لآلیٴ العلم و الحکمة انّه لهو المهیمن علی الأسمآء لا اله الاّ هو المهیمن القیوم

Mā lā ʿaraftumūhu mina al-Bayāni fa-sʾalū Allāha rabbakum wa-rabba ābāʾikumu al-awwalīna. Innahu law yashāʾu yubayyinu lakum mā nuzzila fīhi wa-mā sutira fī baḥri kalimātihi min laʾāliʾi al-ʿilmi wa-al-ḥikmati. Innahu la-huwa al-muhayminu ʿalā al-asmāʾi lā ilāha illā huwa al-muhayminu al-qayyūmu.

Whatever you have not understood in the Bayān, ask God, your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers. If He wishes, He will explain to you what has been sent down in it and the pearls of knowledge and wisdom concealed in the ocean of His words. He is indeed the Guardian over all names. There is no god but Him, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting.

182

قد اضطرب النّظم من هذا النّظم الأعظم و اختلف التّرتیب بهذا البدیع الّذی ما شهدت عین الابداع شبهه

Qadi iḍṭaraba al-naẓmu min hādhā al-naẓmi al-aʿẓami wa-ikhtalafa al-tartību bi-hādhā al-badīʿi alladhī mā shahidat ʿaynu al-ibdāʿi shibhahu.

The established order has been shaken by this Most Great Order, and its arrangement has been transformed by this wondrous new order, the like of which the eye of creation has never witnessed.

183

اغتمسوا فی بحر بیانی لعلّ تطّلعون بما فیه من لآلیٴ الحکمة و الأسرار ایّاکم ان توقّفوا فی هذا الأمر الّذی به ظهرت سلطنة اللّه و اقتداره اسرعوا الیه بوجوه بیضآء هذا دین اللّه من قبل و من بعد من اراد فلیقبل و من لم یرد فانّ اللّه لغنی عن العالمین

Ightamisū fī baḥri bayānī laʿalla taṭṭaliʿūna bi-mā fīhi min laʾāliʾi al-ḥikmati wa-al-asrāri. Iyyākum an tawaqqafū fī hādhā al-amri alladhī bihi ẓaharat salṭanatu Allāhi wa-iqtidāruhu. Asriʿū ilayhi bi-wujūhin bayḍāʾa. Hādhā dīnu Allāhi min qablu wa-min baʿdu. Man arāda fa-līuqbil wa-man lam yurid fa-inna Allāha la-ghaniyyun ʿani al-ʿālamīna.

Immerse yourselves in the ocean of My utterance, so that you may discover the pearls of wisdom and mysteries within it. Beware of hesitating in this Cause, through which God’s sovereignty and might have been revealed. Hasten to Him with radiant faces. This is the religion of God, before and hereafter. Whoever wishes, let him turn toward it; and whoever does not wish—God is indeed independent of all the worlds.

184

قل هذا لقسطاس الهدی لمن فی السّموات و الأرض و البرهان الأعظم لو انتم تعرفون قل به ثبت کلّ حجّة فی الأعصار لو انتم توقنون قل به استغنی کلّ فقیر و تعلّم کلّ عالمٍ و عرج من اراد الصّعود الی اللّه ایّاکم ان تختلفوا فیه کونوا کالجبال الرّواسخ فی امر ربّکم العزیز الودود

Qul hādhā la-qisṭāsu al-hudā li-man fī al-samāwāti wa-al-arḍi wa-al-burhānu al-aʿẓamu law antum taʿrifūna. Qul bihi thabata kullu ḥujjatin fī al-aʿṣāri law antum tūqinūna. Qul bihi istaghnā kullu faqīrin wa-taʿallama kullu ʿālimin wa-ʿaraja man arāda al-ṣuʿūda ilā Allāhi. Iyyākum an takhtalifū fīhi. Kūnū ka-al-jibāli al-rawāsikhi fī amri rabbikumu al-ʿazīzi al-wadūdi.

Say: This is indeed the balance of guidance for all who are in the heavens and on earth, and the greatest proof, if only you knew. Say: Through it every proof throughout the ages has been established, if only you were certain. Say: Through it every poor person has been enriched, every learned person has gained knowledge, and whoever has desired to ascend to God has risen. Beware of differing over it. Be like firmly rooted mountains in the Cause of your Lord, the Almighty, the All-Loving.

185

قل یا مطلع الاعراض دع الاغماض ثمّ انطق بالحقّ بین الخلق تاللّه قد جرت دموعی علی خدودی بما اراک مقبلاً الی هواک و معرضاً عمّن خلقک و سوّاک اذکر فضل مولاک اذ ربّیناک فی اللّیالی و الأیّام لخدمة الأمر اتّق اللّه و کن من التّائبین هبنی اشتبه علی النّاس امرک هل یشتبه علی نفسک خف عن اللّه ثمّ اذکر اذ کنت قائما لدی العرش و کتبت ما القیناک من ایات اللّه المهیمن المقتدر القدیر ایّاک ان تمنعک الحمیّة عن شطر الأحدیة توجّه الیه و لا تخف من اعمالک انّه یغفر من یشآء بفضل من عنده لا اله الاّ هو الغفور الکریم انّما ننصحک لوجه اللّه ان اقبلت فلنفسک و ان اعرضت انّ ربّک غنی عنک و عن الّذین اتّبعوک بوهم مبین قد اخذ اللّه من اغواک فارجع الیه خاضعاً خاشعاً متذلّلاً انّه یکفّر عنک سیئاتک انّ ربّک لهو التّوّاب العزیز الرّحیم

Qul yā maṭlaʿa al-iʿrāḍi daʿi al-ighmāḍa thumma inṭiq bi-al-ḥaqqi bayna al-khalqi. Ta-Allāhi qad jarat dumūʿī ʿalā khudūdī bi-mā arāka muqbilan ilā hawāka wa-muʿriḍan ʿamman khalaqaka wa-sawwāka. Udhkur faḍla mawlāka idh rabbaynāka fī al-layālī wa-al-ayyāmi li-khidmati al-amri. Ittaqi Allāha wa-kun mina al-tāʾibīna. Habnī ishtabaha ʿalā al-nāsi amruka hal yashtabihu ʿalā nafsika. Khaf ʿani Allāhi thumma udhkur idh kunta qāʾiman ladā al-ʿarshi wa-katabta mā alqaynāka min āyāti Allāhi al-muhaymini al-muqtadiri al-qadīri. Iyyāka an tamnaʿaka al-ḥamiyyatu ʿan shaṭri al-aḥadiyyati. Tawajjah ilayhi wa-lā takhaf min aʿmālika. Innahu yaghfiru man yashāʾu bi-faḍlin min ʿindihi lā ilāha illā huwa al-ghafūru al-karīmu. Innamā nanṣaḥuka li-wajhi Allāhi. In aqbalta fa-li-nafsika wa-in aʿraḍta inna rabbaka ghaniyyun ʿanka wa-ʿani alladhīna ittabaʿūka bi-wahmin mubīnin. Qad akhadha Allāhu man aghwāka fa-irjiʿ ilayhi khāḍiʿan khāshiʿan mutadhallilan. Innahu yukaffiru ʿanka sayyiʾātika inna rabbaka la-huwa al-tawwābu al-ʿazīzu al-raḥīmu.

Say: O source of rejection! Give up your willful blindness, then speak the truth among the people. By God! My tears have flowed down My cheeks because I see you turning toward your own desires and away from Him who created and fashioned you. Remember the bounty of your Lord, when We nurtured you through the nights and days for service to the Cause. Fear God and be among those who repent. Suppose your true condition is unclear to others: is it unclear to yourself? Fear God, then remember when you stood before the Throne and wrote down the verses of God, the All-Protecting, the All-Powerful, the Almighty, that We imparted to you. Beware lest pride keep you from turning toward the Divine Unity. Turn to Him and do not fear because of your deeds. He forgives whomever He wishes through His grace. There is no god but Him, the Ever-Forgiving, the Generous. We counsel you only for the sake of God. If you turn toward Him, it is for your own good; and if you turn away, your Lord has no need of you or of those who have followed you in manifest delusion. God has seized the one who led you astray, so return to Him in submission, humility, and lowliness. He will indeed efface your misdeeds. Your Lord is indeed the Ever-Relenting, the Almighty, the Merciful.

186

هذا نصح اللّه لو انت من السّامعین هذا فضل اللّه لو انت من المقبلین هذا ذکر اللّه لو انت من الشّاعرین هذا کنز اللّه لو انت من العارفین

Hādhā nuṣḥu Allāhi law anta mina al-sāmiʿīna. Hādhā faḍlu Allāhi law anta mina al-muqbilīna. Hādhā dhikru Allāhi law anta mina al-shāʿirīna. Hādhā kanzu Allāhi law anta mina al-ʿārifīna.

This is God’s counsel, if only you would listen. This is God’s grace, if only you would turn toward Him. This is God’s remembrance, if only you would perceive. This is God’s treasure, if only you would recognize it.

187

هذا کتاب اصبح مصباح القدم للعالم و صراطه الأقوم بین العالمین قل انّه لمطلع علم اللّه لو انتم تعلمون و مشرق اوامر اللّه لو انتم تعرفون

Hādhā kitābun aṣbaḥa miṣbāḥa al-qidami li-al-ʿālami wa-ṣirāṭahu al-aqwama bayna al-ʿālamīna. Qul innahu la-maṭlaʿu ʿilmi Allāhi law antum taʿlamūna wa-mashriqu awāmiri Allāhi law antum taʿrifūna.

This is a Book that has become the lamp of eternity for the world and His straightest path among all peoples. Say: It is indeed the dawning place of God’s knowledge, if only you knew, and the dayspring of God’s commandments, if only you recognized it.

188

لا تحملوا علی الحیوان ما یعجز عن حمله انّا نهیناکم عن ذلک نهیاً عظیماً فی الکتاب کونوا مظاهر العدل و الانصاف بین السّموات و الأرضین

Lā taḥmilū ʿalā al-ḥayawāni mā yaʿjizu ʿan ḥamlihi. Innā nahaynākum ʿan dhālika nahyan ʿaẓīman fī al-kitābi. Kūnū maẓāhira al-ʿadli wa-al-inṣāfi bayna al-samāwāti wa-al-arḍīna.

Do not load an animal with more than it can carry. We have most emphatically forbidden you to do so in the Book. Be manifestations of justice and fairness throughout the heavens and the earth.

189

من قتل نفساً خطأً فله دیة مسلّمة الی اهلها و هی مائة مثقال من الذّهب اعملوا بما امرتم به فی اللّوح و لا تکوننّ من المتجاوزین

Man qatala nafsan khaṭaʾan fa-lahu diyatun musallamatun ilā ahlihā wa-hiya miʾatu mithqālin mina al-dhahabi. Iʿmalū bi-mā umirtum bihi fī al-lawḥi wa-lā takūnanna mina al-mutajāwizīna.

Whoever kills a person by mistake must pay compensation to that person’s family, amounting to one hundred mithqāls of gold. Act according to what you have been commanded in the Tablet, and do not be among those who transgress.

190

یا اهل المجالس فی البلاد اختاروا لغة من اللّغات لیتکلّم بها من علی الأرض و کذلک من الخطوط انّ اللّه یبین لکم ما ینفعکم و یغنیکم عن دونکم انّه لهو الفضّال العلیم الخبیر هذا سبب الاتّحاد لو انتم تعلمون و العلة الکبری للاتّفاق و التّمدّن لو انتم تشعرون انّا جعلنا الأمرین علامتین لبلوغ العالم الأوّل و هو الاسّ الأعظم نزّلناه فی الواح اخری و الثّانی نزل فی هذا اللّوح البدیع

Yā ahla al-majālisi fī al-bilādi ikhtārū lughatan mina al-lughāti li-yatakallama bihā man ʿalā al-arḍi wa-kadhālika mina al-khuṭūṭi. Inna Allāha yubayyinu lakum mā yanfaʿukum wa-yughnīkum ʿan dūnikum. Innahu la-huwa al-faḍḍālu al-ʿalīmu al-khabīru. Hādhā sababu al-ittiḥādi law antum taʿlamūna wa-al-ʿillatu al-kubrā li-al-ittifāqi wa-al-tamadduni law antum tashʿurūna. Innā jaʿalnā al-amrayni ʿalāmatayni li-bulūghi al-ʿālami. Al-awwalu wa-huwa al-ussu al-aʿẓamu nazzalnāhu fī alwāḥin ukhrā wa-al-thānī nazala fī hādhā al-lawḥi al-badīʿi.

O members of assemblies in the countries of the world! Choose one language from among the languages for everyone on earth to speak, and likewise one script from among the scripts. God makes clear to you what will benefit you and make you independent of others. He is indeed the Most Bountiful, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed. This is a means of unity, if only you knew, and the greatest means of harmony and civilization, if only you perceived. We have made these two matters signs of the world’s maturity. The first, which is the greatest foundation, We have sent down in other Tablets, and the second has been sent down in this wondrous Tablet.

191

قد حرّم علیکم شرب الأفیون انّا نهیناکم عن ذلک نهیاً عظیماً فی الکتاب و الّذی شرب انّه لیس منّی اتّقوا اللّه یا اولی الألباب

Qad ḥurrima ʿalaykum shurbu al-afyūni. Innā nahaynākum ʿan dhālika nahyan ʿaẓīman fī al-kitābi wa-alladhī shariba innahu laysa minnī. Ittaqū Allāha yā ulī al-albābi.

Consuming opium has been forbidden to you. We have most emphatically forbidden you to do so in the Book, and whoever consumes it is not of Me. Fear God, O people of understanding.

Introduction
BH00003
